paper.title: Learning from Online User Feedback for Shopping Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model-based shopping agents are increasingly deployed in real-world e-commerce platforms, generating massive amounts of user interaction logs that provide valuable supervision for improving these agents. However, existing approaches primarily rely on offline training signals, such as user-item interactions or synthetic preference data, while largely overlooking the rich supervision contained in users' natural conversational feedback. Moreover, the available online feedback is hete

summary.core_problem: 购物agent的在线用户反馈异质、稀疏、噪声大，难以自动转化为可靠学习信号，现有方法依赖离线交互或合成偏好数据
summary.importance: 方法创新，从真实在线交互日志中直接学习，无需人工标注，结合RL与反馈感知蒸馏
summary.technical_approach: LOFA框架：对可验证购买结果做RL，同时用feedback-aware on-policy distillation识别用户对话中的指令并转化为token级密集监督
summary.experiments: 在真实电商平台在线交互日志上验证，结合RL（可验证购买结果）和feedback-aware on-policy distillation将用户自然反馈转化为监督信号

summary_en.core_problem: Online user feedback for shopping agents is heterogeneous, sparse, and noisy; existing methods rely on offline interactions or synthetic preference data
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: learns directly from real online interaction logs without human annotation, combining RL with feedback-aware distillation
summary_en.technical_approach: LOFA: RL over verifiable purchase outcomes plus feedback-aware on-policy distillation that extracts user in-dialogue directives into dense token-level supervision
summary_en.experiments: Validated on real e-commerce online interaction logs; combines RL on verifiable purchase outcomes with feedback-aware on-policy distillation to convert natural user feedback into supervision

recommendation.zh: 购物agent的在线反馈学习，领域特定；从自然对话中提取token级监督的思路有一定通用性，但不值得深读
recommendation.en: Shopping-agent online feedback learning is domain-specific; the idea of extracting token-level supervision from natural dialogue has some generality but not worth deep reading.

paper.title: Multi-View Relational Distillation for Spatial Reasoning with Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong image and video understanding, yet their visual-spatial representations remain geometrically fragile, leading to failures in spatial reasoning needed for embodied AI, robotics, and autonomous driving. Prior approaches to geometry grounding either fine-tune VLMs on spatial question answering, which can perpetuate spurious visual representations, or fuse features from large geometry-grounded vision models, which substantially increases model size

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 在空间推理中几何表征脆弱的问题，尤其是多视角场景下对象关系和空间对应不稳定。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM 表征蒸馏方法改进。它关注一个真实问题：直接引入几何模型特征会增加推理成本，直接特征蒸馏又可能破坏原有图文语义对齐。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Multi-View Relational Distillation，不直接匹配几何教师模型的特征，而是蒸馏跨视角 patch-wise cosine similarity。这样保留几何对应关系，同时减少对 VLM 原有视觉-文本对齐空间的扰动。
summary.experiments: 摘要称方法面向图像和视频理解中的空间推理，并与空间问答微调、几何特征融合、直接特征蒸馏等思路对比；未提供模型规模、数据规模和具体提升数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses fragile geometric representations in VLMs, especially unstable multi-view spatial correspondences needed for visual-spatial reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a representation distillation method for VLMs. The useful point is the trade-off: geometry-grounded teachers can help, but feature fusion increases inference cost and direct feature matching may damage vision-language alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Multi-View Relational Distillation, which distills patch-wise cosine similarity relations across views rather than matching teacher features directly. The goal is to transfer geometric correspondence while preserving the pretrained semantic alignment of the VLM.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports evaluations on image and video spatial reasoning, comparing against spatial QA fine-tuning, geometry-feature fusion, and direct feature distillation style baselines; exact model sizes, data scale, and numerical gains are not given.

recommendation.zh: 可略读方法图；关系蒸馏比特征蒸馏更稳这个点，对 VLM 预训练对齐有一点可迁移价值。
recommendation.en: Skim the method figure; relational distillation being safer than feature matching is mildly useful for VLM alignment work.

paper.title: MERA: Model Evolution and Routing with Skill Adaptation for Agentic Systems at Scale
paper.abstract: LLM agents execute heterogeneous sequences of model calls within a single task: some invocations require careful reasoning, while others are structured steps such as formatting or tool-argument construction. Prior routing methods exploit this asymmetry by assigning easy invocations to a cheaper small model and difficult ones to a large model. Such policies reduce inference cost, but they leave the small model's capability unchanged, so attainable savings remain bounded by the work the student ca

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM Agent路由方法仅按调用难度分配大小模型而不提升小模型本身能力，导致成本节约上限受限，且直接用线上trace调整服务策略存在静默失败、能力回归等风险。
summary.importance: 提出将线上Agent执行trace转化为小模型迭代提升信号的闭环机制，而非仅依赖路由调度，其路由、技能沉淀、模型适配的联合演化框架对生产Agent系统中小模型的持续后训练与部署优化有实际参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 以单次模型调用为适配单元，拆分线上服务与线下更新两条路径：线上用仅输入感知的路由器在强/弱/专用模型间选择，搭配SkillBook调度格式化、工具参数构造等重复结构化步骤，验证器失败时触发强模型回退并记录日志；线下按Skill→LLM→Router的依赖顺序循环更新，先更新SkillBook的重复模式统计，再用失败调用的教师演示结合当前SkillBook蒸馏小模型，最后用本轮小模型实际表现训练路由器，所有更新需经联合回放验证才上线，避免单独组件指标达标但端到端效果退化。
summary.experiments: 在582个留出的HumanEval++MBPP任务（3个种子）上，4轮适配将Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B的SFT准确率从28.7%提升至44.2%，搭配GRPO后提升至49.7%；部署时结合可执行验证与GPT-5.6 Luna回退，保持88.3%通过率的同时，成本仅为全程使用Luna的60.8%。TAU-2基准上，适配后的Qwen3.5-2B得分从14/35提升至18/35，追平未适配的4B端点，另有金融盈亏分析量化适配成本与服务节约的权衡关系。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：先看引言第2-3段理解现有路由方法的能力天花板问题，再看方法部分Algorithm 1的更新循环顺序与依赖逻辑，最后看实验中的成本-准确率权衡数据，预计阅读时间15-20分钟，重点理解路由、技能库、模型适配三者的联合演化逻辑，无需深挖单个组件的实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM agent routing methods only dispatch invocations to models of different sizes based on difficulty without improving the small model's intrinsic capability, capping potential cost savings, while directly adjusting serving policies with raw online traces carries risks of silent failures and capability regression.
summary_en.importance: It proposes a closed-loop mechanism that converts online agent execution traces into signals for iterative small-model improvement instead of relying solely on routing scheduling, and its joint evolution framework of routing, skill distillation, and model adaptation provides practical reference for continuous post-training and deployment optimization of small models in production agent systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: Takes individual model invocations as the adaptation unit and splits the system into online serving and offline update pipelines. The online path uses an input-only router to select among strong, cheap, and specialized models, pairs with a SkillBook to dispatch reusable templates for recurring structured steps such as formatting and tool argument construction, and triggers fallback to stronger models plus event logging when verification fails. The offline update cycle follows a dependency-respecting Skill → LLM → Router schedule: first update SkillBook statistics for recurring patterns, then distill the small model using teacher demonstrations from failed invocations paired with the current SkillBook, finally train the router on actual small-model outcomes from the current cycle. All updates are admitted only after joint replay verification to avoid end-to-end degradation despite isolated component improvements.
summary_en.experiments: On 582 held-out HumanEval++MBPP tasks (3 seeds), 4 adaptation cycles lift Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B accuracy from 28.7% to 44.2% with SFT, and to 49.7% with combined SFT+GRPO. The deployed policy with executable verification and GPT-5.6 Luna fallback retains 88.3% pass rate at 60.8% of the cost of using Luna for all invocations. On TAU-2, adapted Qwen3.5-2B improves from 14/35 to 18/35, matching the performance of an unadapted 4B endpoint. A financial break-even analysis quantifies the tradeoff between adaptation cost and serving savings.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the 2nd-3rd paragraphs of Introduction to understand the capability ceiling of existing routing methods, then Algorithm 1 in Method for the update cycle order and dependency logic, finally the cost-accuracy tradeoff results in Experiments. Expected reading time: 15-20 minutes. Focus on the joint evolution logic of routing, skill repository, and model adaptation instead of implementation details of individual components.

recommendation.zh: 看 adaptation loop 和 cost model 即可；亮点是把 routing 从静态分流改成持续蒸馏，实验数字需查是否有干净消融。
recommendation.en: Skim the adaptation loop and cost model; the useful idea is turning static routing into continual distillation, but check whether the ablations are clean.

paper.title: LLM Agents Factory: Retrieval of Domain-Specific LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents improve task performance by decomposing problems into role-specialized behaviors. However, their practical deployment is often limited by the computational cost and instability associated with the on-the-fly agent design for each user request. To address this, we present LLM Agents Factory, a retrieval-based framework that constructs domain-specific and Wikipedia-grounded agents on demand using a base of over 20K predetermined agent profiles. Our framework suppo

summary.core_problem: 解决按用户请求临时生成 LLM agent 角色配置时成本高、稳定性差的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 系统方法改进：把 agent 设计从在线生成改为从结构化 agent profile 库检索，目标是降低推理成本并提升部署稳定性。对基座预训练的直接信息量有限，但对 agent scaffold 的缓存化、检索化有一定工程参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 LLM Agents Factory，预先构建超过 2 万个 Wikipedia-grounded、domain-specific agent profiles。系统支持两种模式：一是用语义搜索按任务检索合适的 agent profile；二是把 agent 生成能力蒸馏到一个小模型中，直接生成 agent profile。方法主要是把在线 agent 规划转化为离线 profile 资产加检索或蒸馏。
summary.experiments: 在 MMLU、BIG-bench、BIG-bench Hard 上做单 agent 场景实验。论文声称检索式 agent 构造优于 non-agent baseline，并且在使用 120B backbone 时接近 AutoGen 的生成质量，同时显著降低推理成本。摘要未给出具体参数、profile 构建细节和成本数字。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Sber AI、Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology、NUST MISIS、Skoltech 和 Artificial Intelligence Research Institute。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the cost and instability of designing LLM agent roles on the fly for each user request.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-systems contribution: it replaces online agent design with retrieval from a structured repository of precomputed profiles. It has limited direct value for foundation-model pretraining, but it is relevant to the engineering pattern of caching and retrieving agent scaffolds.
summary_en.technical_approach: LLM Agents Factory builds a repository of more than 20K Wikipedia-grounded, domain-specific agent profiles. It supports semantic retrieval of profiles and a distilled compact model for direct profile generation. The main move is to turn dynamic agent construction into an offline asset plus retrieval or distillation problem.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are reported on MMLU, BIG-bench, and BIG-bench Hard in a single-agent setting. The paper claims the retrieval-based setup beats non-agent baselines and matches AutoGen-like generation quality with a 120B backbone at lower inference cost. The abstract does not provide detailed cost numbers or profile-construction ablations.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Sber AI, Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology, NUST MISIS, Skoltech, and the Artificial Intelligence Research Institute.

recommendation.zh: 可看作 agent scaffold 缓存化的工程样例；不改 pretrain prior，扫一下 profile 检索实验即可。
recommendation.en: Treat it as an engineering example of cached agent scaffolds; it does not change pretraining priors, so skim the profile-retrieval setup only.

paper.title: Matryoshka Language Model Suites
paper.abstract: Training a language model suite classically requires training each model separately and serving them independently. We improve both training and inference efficiency by stacking sub-models of increasing size into a single nested architecture trained end-to-end. This Matryoshka training framework reduces the total parameter count of the suite, enables low-cost distillation from the largest to all smaller sub-models at every training step, and is well-suited for speculative decoding as the draft m

summary.core_problem: 传统LLM模型族（面向不同部署场景的一组不同参数量模型）需要为每个尺寸单独训练，总训练成本高、参数冗余度大；小模型通常需在训练完成后从大模型做离线蒸馏，流程割裂；推理时使用推测解码需要单独维护draft模型，带来额外内存开销，且独立训练的draft模型与verifier预测一致性低，token接受率不足，往往难以拿到实际加速。
summary.importance: Matryoshka嵌套训练框架将多个尺寸的子模型整合到单次端到端预训练流程中，总训练成本接近仅训练最大模型的开销，同时解决了训练冗余、蒸馏流程成本、推测解码效率三个生产中的实际问题，对模型族的生产、部署效率有直接实用价值，是参数复用、嵌套架构预训练方向的重要进展。和固定宽度的early exit方案不同，每个子模型拥有适配自身尺寸的宽度和深度，可独立切出部署，设计可直接落地到生产模型工作流。
summary.technical_approach: 架构采用严格的参数嵌套规则：更小的子模型的所有参数都被包含在更大的子模型中，同时每个子模型可以设置独立的隐藏维度（宽度）和层数（深度），实现更灵活的尺寸设计。无参数的连接（junction）机制负责将小子模型的输出传递给更大的子模型：大子模型隐藏状态的前D_m维直接用小子模型的输出初始化，大子模型新增维度的对应位置填入token embedding；通过简单的归一化操作解决Transformer输出和输入embedding的模长不匹配问题，避免训练不稳定。训练目标在每个子模型出口同时计算两项loss：一是标准的下一词预测交叉熵，二是以最大模型的logits为软标签的蒸馏loss，所有子模型的loss加权求和作为总目标，在每一步训练中无额外前向开销地完成从大模型到所有小模型的在线蒸馏。推理阶段，任意子模型都可以被独立切出部署，拥有独立的KV cache占用；做推测解码时，小子模型本身就是大模型的内置组件，二者共享权重和KV cache，无需额外加载draft模型权重，参数共享的特性也会提升跨模型的预测一致性。
summary.experiments: 在35B FineWeb-Edu tokens上训练了包含500M、1.5B、3B三个子模型的Matryoshka套件：1）总训练计算量比单独训练三个同尺寸基线模型低36%，三个尺寸的子模型在验证集困惑度、域外困惑度、标准基准测试上的性能，和独立训练的基线差距均在0.5个平均分以内，基本持平；2）消融实验显示，无参数连接机制、逐出口蒸馏loss两个设计对小模型性能至关重要，移除任意一项都会导致小模型性能明显下降；在50M/100M/200M的小规模套件上的系统消融，明确了宽度、深度拆分方式对子模型性能的影响；3）推测解码场景下，嵌套模型对的token接受率显著高于独立训练的模型对：1.5B嵌套draft搭配3B verifier可以获得实际加速，而同样尺寸的独立训练模型对因为接受率过低，加速效果甚至不如原生自回归推理。项目开源了训练好的checkpoint和HuggingFace Transformers兼容的实现代码。
summary.reading_guide: 需要精读。重点关注三部分内容：一是连接机制的具体设计，尤其是如何在不引入额外参数的情况下处理宽度过渡、解决激活模长不匹配带来的训练不稳定问题；二是训练目标设计，包括逐出口蒸馏loss的作用、不同子模型的loss权重配置逻辑；三是小规模消融中关于宽度/深度配置权衡的结论，这些结论对将方案扩展到更大尺寸模型套件有直接指导意义。另外需要关注推测解码部分的分析，理解参数共享提升跨模型一致性的机制，注意方案目前的已知限制（如不同子模型间训练步分配的平衡、更大参数量级下的scaling表现尚未验证）。阅读时可以结合开源的3B checkpoint和兼容实现，验证实际部署的行为和开销。预计阅读时间45分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Conventional LLM model suites—collections of models at varying parameter scales built for diverse deployment scenarios—require separate training runs for each model size, leading to high total training cost and redundant computation. Smaller models in the suite typically require offline distillation from larger models after training completes, adding pipeline complexity. For speculative decoding, independently trained draft models incur extra memory overhead, and low prediction agreement between separate draft and verifier models often erases potential speedups.
summary_en.importance: The Matryoshka LM framework nests sub-models of increasing scale into a single end-to-end training run, with total training cost comparable to training only the largest model in the suite. It addresses three core pain points in model suite production: redundant training compute, distillation pipeline overhead, and low speculative decoding efficiency. Unlike fixed-width early-exit approaches, each nested sub-model has tailored width and depth and can be served as a standalone model, making the design immediately applicable to production model workflows.
summary_en.technical_approach: The architecture enforces strict parameter nesting: all parameters of smaller sub-models are contained within larger sub-models, while each sub-model uses its own hidden dimension (width) and layer count (depth) for flexible size design. A parameter-free junction mechanism connects outputs from smaller sub-models to the inputs of larger sub-models: the first D_m dimensions of the larger sub-model’s hidden state are populated directly from the smaller sub-model’s output, while dimensions added for the larger sub-model are filled with corresponding token embeddings. A simple normalization step resolves activation magnitude mismatch between Transformer outputs and input embeddings that would otherwise destabilize training. The training objective combines standard next-token cross-entropy at every sub-model exit with an in-line distillation loss that uses the largest model’s logits as soft labels for all smaller sub-models, providing per-step distillation with no extra forward pass cost. At inference, any sub-model can be extracted and served independently with its own KV cache footprint. For speculative decoding, smaller sub-models act as draft models natively contained within the verifier, sharing weights and KV cache to eliminate extra memory overhead and improve prediction agreement.
summary_en.experiments: A 3B-parameter suite with 500M, 1.5B, and 3B sub-models is trained on 35B tokens from FineWeb-Edu: (1) Total training compute is 36% lower than training three equivalent independent baseline models, and all sub-models match independent baseline performance within 0.5 average points across standard benchmarks, as well as on in-domain and out-of-domain validation perplexity. (2) Ablations show the parameter-free junction mechanism and per-exit distillation loss are both critical for small sub-model performance; removing either leads to clear quality degradation in smaller models. Small-scale ablations on 50M/100M/200M suites characterize how width and depth partitioning choices affect sub-model performance. (3) For speculative decoding, nested model pairs have substantially higher token acceptance rates than independently trained pairs: a 1.5B nested draft paired with the 3B verifier delivers meaningful speedup, while an equivalently sized independent draft/verifier pair yields no speedup over standard autoregressive decoding due to low agreement. Trained checkpoints and a HuggingFace Transformers-compatible implementation are open-sourced.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read in depth. Focus on three core components: (1) the junction mechanism design, particularly how it handles width transitions and resolves activation magnitude mismatch without additional parameters; (2) the training objective design, including the role of per-exit distillation and loss weighting across sub-models; (3) small-scale ablation results on width/depth configuration tradeoffs, which provide direct guidance for scaling the design to larger model suites. Pay close attention to the speculative decoding analysis on how weight sharing improves cross-model agreement, and note open limitations (e.g., balancing training step allocation across sub-models, untested scaling behavior at larger parameter counts). Pair reading with the open-source 3B checkpoint and compatible implementation to validate deployment behavior. Estimated reading time: 45 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻复现小规模 ablation；它把模型族训练、步内蒸馏和投机解码合成一个 recipe，动作很明确。
recommendation.en: Run a small internal ablation; it turns model-family training, step-wise distillation, and speculative decoding into one actionable recipe.

paper.title: CuteTTS: Efficient and High-Quality Speech Synthesis via Autoregressive Modeling of Continuous Latents
paper.abstract: Zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) now supports interactive assistants, personalized media, and accessibility tools. All TTS systems require faithful linguistic rendering, consistent speaker identity, and low-latency response. Yet compact streaming systems must preserve sufficient acoustic detail in a predictable low-rate latent sequence, while iterative diffusion sampling and classifier-free guidance multiply inference cost at every autoregressive step. To strike a balance between high-fidelity syn

summary.core_problem: 小参数量流式零样本TTS系统长期面临声学重建保真度、低帧率潜变量自回归可预测性、推理延迟三者的权衡，扩散/流匹配生成头的多步采样与分类器无关引导（CFG）会在每一步生成时引入显著计算开销，难以同时满足音质、音色相似度和低延迟要求。
summary.importance: 属于语音语言建模与跨模态生成范畴，验证了语义对齐因果VAE+patch级自回归+流匹配头的紧凑架构可行性，提出的引导-步联合蒸馏思路对AR+扩散联合建模范式的推理加速有通用参考价值，无需分开执行CFG蒸馏和采样步蒸馏两次流程。
summary.technical_approach: 系统由四个核心模块构成：1）训练帧率12.5Hz的因果σ-VAE，引入冻结WavLM的语义对齐损失避免连续潜变量后验坍缩，在降低自回归序列长度的同时保证重建质量；2）单独蒸馏轻量ECAPA说话人编码器，显式注入说话人条件提升零样本音色克隆相似度；3）采用每patch含2帧的分块设计，因果主干自回归预测连续patch序列，双向流匹配头负责建模patch内的局部声学依赖；4）提出引导-步联合蒸馏方法，沿着CFG引导的教师轨迹对区间平均速度做监督，训练单个学生模型同时吸收CFG分支计算和多步数值积分的效果，推理时单次前向即可完成生成，无需额外引导计算和多步采样。
summary.experiments: 模型总参数量约0.2B，在LibriSpeech和Seed-TTS基准上的可懂度、说话人相似度达到同体量模型可比水平，主观音质测试中听感偏好优于同参数基线；蒸馏后首包音频延迟降低23.3%，实时率（RTF）提升40.8%，合成音质与未蒸馏基座模型几乎持平；消融实验验证语义对齐目标可显著提升可懂度，显式说话人条件可增强零样本克隆效果，针对潜变量帧率、patch大小的对照实验给出了重建保真度、自回归序列长度、patch内生成难度三者权衡的定量关系。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注引言部分的问题拆解、引导-步联合蒸馏的设计逻辑、以及帧率和patch大小的消融实验表格，可跳过VAE和判别器的底层实现细节；核心关注点有二：一是连续潜变量做自回归建模时的坍缩缓解方案，二是将CFG计算与多步采样合并蒸馏的加速思路，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Compact streaming zero-shot TTS systems face a three-way tradeoff between acoustic reconstruction fidelity, autoregressive predictability of low-rate latents, and end-to-end inference latency. Multi-step sampling for diffusion/flow matching heads and classifier-free guidance introduce non-trivial compute overhead at every generation step, making it difficult to simultaneously meet audio quality, speaker similarity, and low-latency requirements.
summary_en.importance: This work falls in the domain of speech language modeling and cross-modal generation. It validates the feasibility of a compact architecture combining semantically aligned causal VAE, patch-level autoregression, and flow matching heads. The proposed guidance-step distillation design provides general reference for inference acceleration in joint AR+diffusion modeling paradigms, eliminating the need for two separate distillation passes for CFG removal and sampling step reduction.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system is built on four core components: 1) A causal σ-VAE operating at 12.5 Hz frame rate, trained with a semantic alignment loss against a frozen WavLM teacher to avoid posterior collapse of continuous latents, reducing autoregressive sequence length while preserving reconstruction quality; 2) A lightweight distilled ECAPA speaker encoder, with explicit speaker conditioning injected to improve zero-shot voice cloning similarity; 3) A patching scheme with 2 frames per patch, where a causal backbone autoregressively predicts sequences of continuous patches, and a bidirectional flow matching head models within-patch local acoustic dependencies; 4) Guidance-step distillation, which trains a single student model on interval-averaged velocities along the CFG-guided teacher trajectory, absorbing both CFG branch computation and multi-step numerical integration into a single forward pass at inference time, with no extra guidance calculation or multi-step sampling required.
summary_en.experiments: The 0.2B parameter model achieves comparable intelligibility and speaker similarity on LibriSpeech and Seed-TTS benchmarks, and is preferred over same-sized baselines in subjective listening tests. After distillation, mean first-audio latency drops by 23.3%, real-time factor improves by 40.8%, and synthesis quality remains nearly identical to the undistilled base model. Ablations confirm the semantic alignment objective significantly improves intelligibility, explicit speaker conditioning boosts zero-shot cloning performance, and controlled experiments on latent rate and patch size quantify the tradeoff between reconstruction fidelity, autoregressive sequence length, and within-patch generation difficulty.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the problem breakdown in the introduction, the design of guidance-step distillation, and ablation tables for latent rate and patch size. Skip low-level implementation details of the VAE and discriminators. Focus on two core takeaways: the collapse mitigation scheme for continuous autoregressive latent modeling, and the joint distillation approach for CFG and multi-step sampling. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看 latent 设计和 guidance-step distillation；它不是通用语音 LM，但 AR+flow 接口值得借鉴。
recommendation.en: Read the latent design and guidance-step distillation; it is not a general speech LM, but the AR-plus-flow interface is worth borrowing.

paper.title: Distilling Physical Priors into Streaming World Models
paper.abstract: Streaming world models predict future visual states online while maintaining physically coherent dynamics over long horizons. However, their rollouts often violate basic physical constraints. A common approach distills pretrained bidirectional DiTs into few-step causal generators. However, this paradigm suffers from two fundamental limitations: generic bidirectional teachers acquire limited physical priors from visually oriented pretraining, and the limited priors suffer further loss during bidi

summary.core_problem: 流式世界模型在长时程 rollout 中常违反物理约束，且从双向 DiT 蒸馏到因果生成器时物理先验会进一步损失。
summary.importance: 数据贡献 + 方法改进：构建 120K 真实物理交互视频数据集 PhyS-120K，并提出三阶段物理先验蒸馏框架 PhyS。
summary.technical_approach: 三阶段框架：(1) 用 PhyS-120K 对双向 DiT 做物理感知 SFT 以获取物理先验；(2) 蒸馏为少步因果生成器；(3) 用结构化物体属性与因果状态转换描述做监督。
summary.experiments: 数据集 120K 视频，覆盖刚体、软体、流体、相变；未给出具体模型规模与定量提升数字。
summary.authors_note: Cohere 团队（Liangliang Zhao 等），Cohere 在多模态与世界模型方向有持续投入。

summary_en.core_problem: Streaming world models often violate physical constraints over long rollouts, and physical priors are further lost when distilling bidirectional DiTs into causal generators.
summary_en.importance: Data contribution + method improvement: PhyS-120K dataset of 120K real-world physical-interaction videos, plus a three-stage physics-prior distillation framework PhyS.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three-stage pipeline: (1) physics-aware SFT of a bidirectional DiT on PhyS-120K to acquire physical priors; (2) distillation into a few-step causal generator; (3) supervision via structured object-property and causal state-transition descriptions.
summary_en.experiments: 120K videos covering rigid-body, soft-body, fluid, and phase-transition dynamics; no explicit model size or quantitative improvement numbers provided.
summary_en.authors_note: Cohere team (Liangliang Zhao et al.); Cohere has ongoing investment in multimodal and world-model research.

recommendation.zh: 世界模型方向的物理先验蒸馏思路，对 LLM 预训练研究员主要价值在数据构建与蒸馏 recipe，看摘要和数据集描述即可。
recommendation.en: A physics-prior distillation recipe for world models; mainly useful for its data construction and distillation pipeline—skim the abstract and dataset section.

paper.title: RL-Native Distillation: Exploiting Scored Trajectories for Few-Step Image Generation
paper.abstract: Efficient text-to-image generation requires both reinforcement-learning (RL)-based reward alignment and few-step distillation, yet these procedures are typically performed sequentially, increasing training cost and risking the loss of reward gains during compression. We instead take an RL-native perspective: diffusion RL already generates reward-scored finite-step trajectories, whose intermediate states provide a natural source of distillation supervision rather than a disposable byproduct of sa

summary.core_problem: 解决文本到图像模型中 RL 奖励对齐和少步蒸馏通常分阶段进行，导致训练成本高且压缩后奖励收益可能丢失的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是把扩散 RL 采样过程中已有的带分数轨迹直接用作蒸馏监督，属于图像生成训练流程改进。对 LLM 预训练不直接，但对“RL 信号如何和蒸馏/压缩共用轨迹”有可借鉴的训练接口思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 REST，即 Reward-Enhanced Scored-Trajectory Distillation，在不改变 RL teacher 优化的前提下挂接一个解耦 student，让 student 从 teacher 演化中的 rollout trajectory 做分段蒸馏；同时提出 Advantage-Modulated Distillation，用 advantage 调节模仿强度，避免平均模仿低奖励行为。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明方法可接入任意 RL teacher，并面向少步文本到图像生成；给出的片段未提供具体基础模型、训练数据、采样步数、奖励模型、基线或定量提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tries to merge reward alignment and few-step distillation for text-to-image diffusion models, avoiding the cost and reward loss of a sequential pipeline.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a training interface: reuse reward-scored RL trajectories as distillation supervision. This is not LLM pretraining, but the idea is relevant to how RL signals and compression can share rollouts.
summary_en.technical_approach: REST attaches a decoupled student to an RL teacher and trains it segment-wise from the teacher’s evolving scored trajectories, without changing the teacher optimization. Advantage-Modulated Distillation weights imitation by advantage so that low-reward behavior is not copied uniformly.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that the method is designed for few-step text-to-image generation and can work with arbitrary RL teachers. The provided excerpt does not specify model scale, datasets, reward models, baselines, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 不是 LM 论文，但“带分数轨迹直接蒸馏”值得记；只看方法图和 AMD 公式。
recommendation.en: Not an LM paper, but scored-trajectory distillation is worth noting; read the method diagram and AMD equation only.

paper.title: Vorch-Streamer: Extending Human Audio-Visual Generation to Real-Time Long-Form Streaming
paper.abstract: Real-time long-form avatar audio--video generation requires causal, continuous synthesis while maintaining audiovisual synchronization and visual consistency. Adapting a pretrained bidirectional model to this setting presents two key dilemmas. First, autoregressively reusing generated blocks as context creates exposure bias, causing errors and visual drift to accumulate over long rollouts. Second, a global speech utterance does not indicates a causal generator which portion should be spoken next

summary.core_problem: 把预训练双向音频-视频生成模型改成实时长时流式生成时，存在自回归上下文复用导致的曝光偏差/视觉漂移，以及全局语音无法指示因果生成器当前应生成哪一段的问题。
summary.importance: 工程与训练方法结合的流式数字人生成工作；对长时因果生成、self-forcing 与蒸馏有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 80K、12–21 秒的合成数字人语料；先用混合 Teacher Forcing 与 Diffusion Forcing 训练因果生成器，再用 long-horizon Self Forcing 加 DMD 蒸馏，让模型暴露在自身 rollout 分布下。
summary.experiments: 80K avatar clips；摘要未给基线模型或量化对比，强调实时长时流式 T2AV。

summary_en.core_problem: Adapting a pretrained bidirectional audio-video model to real-time long-form streaming causes exposure bias and visual drift from autoregressive context reuse, and global speech does not tell a causal generator which portion to produce next.
summary_en.importance: A combined engineering and training-method effort for streaming avatars; relevant to long-horizon causal generation, self-forcing, and distillation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds an 80K-clip synthetic avatar corpus (12–21 s), trains a causal generator with mixed Teacher Forcing and Diffusion Forcing, then applies long-horizon Self Forcing with DMD distillation to expose the model to its own rollout distribution.
summary_en.experiments: Uses 80K avatar clips; the abstract gives no baseline models or quantitative comparisons, emphasizing real-time long-form T2AV streaming.

recommendation.zh: Self Forcing + DMD 缓解长时 rollout 漂移的思路可借鉴，但属音视频生成应用，看方法段即可。
recommendation.en: The Self-Forcing-plus-DMD remedy for long-horizon drift is transferable, but this is an AV-generation application—read the method section only.

paper.title: Scaffold-Mediated Post-Training: Co-Evolving Model Parameters and Procedural Scaffold Graphs
paper.abstract: Post-training of large language models optimizes only parameters, while inference-time procedural scaffolds are typically designed independently of parameter training. This disconnect makes it difficult to automatically acquire and internalize complex strategies. We propose scaffold-mediated post-training: procedural scaffolds are organized into an evolvable graph structure that co-evolves with model parameters through discovery, distillation, and dynamic recompilation. We instantiate this parad

summary.core_problem: 解决后训练只优化模型参数、而推理时脚手架策略独立设计，导致复杂程序化技能难以被自动发现并内化的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一类 post-train 与 inference scaffold 联合优化的尝试，贡献点不在常规 SFT/RL 配方，而在把“外部程序结构”纳入训练闭环。对预训练研究员的价值在于：它提供了一个观察 post-train 信号如何被模型吸收、以及外部工具链如何蒸馏回参数的具体范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 scaffold-mediated post-training：把 procedural scaffolds 组织成可演化图结构，并与模型参数共同演化。具体实例 Skill Training 包含三步：技能发现、带 scaffold 的训练/执行、以及 progressive distillation 与 dynamic recompilation，使模型逐步把外部 scaffold 中的策略压回参数内部，最终在无外部 scaffold 时保留较高能力。
summary.experiments: 论文在 FeatureBench 上评测。自动发现的 skills 将 passed rate 提升 8.1 个百分点；经过渐进蒸馏后，去掉外部 scaffold 仍有 27.7% passed rate，蒸馏保留率 85.2%（定义为 distillation 后 / 带 skill 时的通过率），显著优于同数据上的标准 SFT。摘要未给出模型规模、训练 token 或更强 baseline 的完整细节，因此结论更适合作为方法信号而非定论。
summary.authors_note: 清华大学团队。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles the disconnect between parameter-only post-training and separately hand-designed inference scaffolds, which makes complex procedural strategies hard to discover and internalize.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is not another standard SFT/RL recipe, but a closed-loop view where external procedural structure becomes part of training. For pretraining researchers, the value is in how post-training signals can be absorbed into parameters and how inference-time structure can be distilled back into the model.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes scaffold-mediated post-training: procedural scaffolds are organized as an evolvable graph and co-evolved with model parameters. The instantiated framework, Skill Training, includes skill discovery, scaffolded training/execution, progressive distillation, and dynamic recompilation so that strategies encoded in external scaffolds are gradually internalized by the model.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation is on FeatureBench. Automatically discovered skills improve pass rate by 8.1 percentage points. After progressive distillation, the model still reaches 27.7% pass rate without any external scaffold, with an 85.2% retention rate (post-distillation / with-skill pass rate), outperforming standard SFT on the same data. The abstract does not expose model size, training tokens, or stronger baselines, so the result is more a promising signal than a settled conclusion.
summary_en.authors_note: From Tsinghua University.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是“脚手架能否被蒸馏回参数”这个接口问题；先读方法图和 retention 指标，若 baseline 不够强，就把它当成 post-train→pretrain 闭环的早期信号。
recommendation.en: Read it for the interface question—can scaffolded procedures be distilled into weights; check the method diagram and retention metric first, and treat it as an early signal unless the baselines are unusually clean.

paper.title: Woodpecker Distillation: Weak Models Diagnose Reasoning Bugs in Strong Models
paper.abstract: Large language models often fail on reasoning tasks despite possessing the capability to solve them. We argue that many such failures arise from localized reasoning bugs in intermediate steps rather than from global incompetence. We show that these bugs are frequently repairable: inserting a short patch generated by a weak probe model after the same strong-model reasoning prefix can redirect the trajectory toward a correct solution.   However, this corrective effect is not reliably internalized

summary.core_problem: 强模型在推理题上经常不是完全不会，而是在中间轨迹进入了可修复的错误分支。论文研究一个更细的问题：弱模型生成的短局部 patch 能否诊断并修复强模型的中间推理 bug，以及这种修复信号如何被训练进强模型，而不是只在推理时临时插入。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，更接近 reasoning post-training 和 weak-to-strong supervision。但它有一个有用启发：推理能力的训练信号不一定来自完整解答，也可以来自“某个局部干预如何改变后续分布”。这和传统 SFT 学答案、学 CoT 文本不同，更接近对模型内部推理动力学做局部校正。对研究 pretrain ↔ posttrain 接口、推理数据构造、过程监督和弱监督蒸馏的人有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: Woodpecker Distillation 的关键不是让强模型模仿弱模型 patch，而是学习 patch 对强模型后续 token 分布的影响。给定问题 x 和强模型 A 生成的中间前缀 c，弱探针模型 B 生成多个短 reasoning patch。每个 patch 插入到同一个前缀后，再让强模型继续生成，并根据最终答案是否正确把 patch 分成正干预和负干预。训练时保留一个可训练强模型 A_theta 和一个冻结参考模型 A_ref，用参考模型估计不同干预下的未来 token 分布，再比较正负干预诱导出的分布差异，构造偏向成功修复方向的 contrastive teacher distribution。A_theta 被训练去匹配这个 teacher。这样避免了两个直接模仿方案的问题：模仿 patch 会学到弱模型的表面表达，模仿完整 patched trajectory 会把局部修复信号稀释在长续写里。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 作为强模型 A，Gemma-3-4B-IT 作为弱探针模型 B。评测覆盖 AIME 2024、AIME 2025、MATH-500、Olympiad 和 Omni-Hard，其中 Omni-Hard 来自高难度 Omni-MATH 题。论文先只分析强模型 greedy decoding 失败的样本，并比较同一中间前缀下的直接续写与插入弱模型 patch 后的续写。表 1 显示 A-B-A 形式的局部干预能提高 Pass@16，在 AIME 2025 和 Omni-Hard 这类更难集合上提升更明显。消融重点是直接微调 patch、直接微调修复后完整轨迹都不稳定，效果弱于学习正负干预诱导出的未来分布差异。这支持论文的核心判断：有用信号主要在“干预改变了什么续写分布”，不在 patch 的字面文本。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 和 Motivation，重点确认“reasoning bug”的操作性定义：原轨迹失败，但短局部干预能把后续生成导向正确答案。再看 Method 中正负干预集合、冻结参考模型、contrastive teacher distribution 的构造方式。实验部分重点看表 1 以及 imitation baseline 的对比，它们决定这篇工作的可信度。若只关心预训练，可重点思考这种局部分布校正能否迁移到大规模 reasoning mid-training 或 verifier-guided pretraining，而不是关注具体数学题成绩。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a local failure mode in reasoning: a strong model may have enough capability to solve a problem, but its intermediate trajectory enters a recoverable wrong branch. The question is whether a weaker model can expose and repair such local reasoning bugs, and how to train the strong model to internalize the repair signal rather than relying on test-time patch insertion.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly in reasoning post-training and weak-to-strong supervision, not in base pretraining. Its useful signal for pretraining researchers is the training target: supervision can be derived from how a local intervention changes the model’s future distribution, instead of from complete solutions or surface-form chain-of-thought imitation. This is relevant to process supervision, reasoning data generation, and the interface between pretraining, mid-training, and reasoning-oriented fine-tuning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Woodpecker Distillation treats the weak model as a diagnostic probe rather than a teacher that provides full solutions. Given a problem x and an intermediate prefix c produced by a strong model A, a weak probe model B samples several short reasoning patches. Each patch is inserted after the same prefix, and A continues generation. Patches are labeled as positive or negative according to whether the final continuation reaches the correct answer. The method keeps a trainable strong model A_theta and a frozen reference model A_ref. It uses A_ref to estimate the future token distributions induced by positive and negative interventions, then builds a contrastive teacher distribution that emphasizes continuations associated with successful repair. A_theta is trained to match this teacher. This differs from patch imitation, which only copies weak-model text, and from full-trajectory imitation, which can dilute the local correction signal over many downstream tokens.
summary_en.experiments: The paper instantiates the strong model as Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 and the weak probe as Gemma-3-4B-IT. Evaluation covers AIME 2024, AIME 2025, MATH-500, Olympiad, and Omni-Hard, with Omni-Hard containing high-difficulty Omni-MATH problems. The initial analysis focuses on problems where the strong model fails under greedy decoding, then compares direct continuation from the same prefix against continuation after inserting a weak-model patch. Table 1 reports Pass@16 improvements from the A-B-A intervention, with larger gains on harder sets such as AIME 2025 and Omni-Hard. The important ablation is that directly fine-tuning on weak patches or full repaired trajectories is less reliable than distilling the contrast between successful and unsuccessful intervention-induced future distributions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25–35 minutes. Start with the Introduction and Motivation sections to understand the operational definition of a reasoning bug: a failed trajectory that can be redirected by a short local intervention. Then read the Method section for the construction of positive and negative intervention sets, the frozen reference model, and the contrastive teacher distribution. In the experiments, focus on Table 1 and the imitation baselines. For pretraining-oriented readers, the main question is whether this local distribution-correction signal can be scaled into reasoning mid-training or verifier-guided training, rather than the benchmark scores themselves.

recommendation.zh: 弱到强蒸馏的新角度，核心发现'直接微调修复轨迹无效，有效信号在未来分布差异'很有启发性，建议重点读§3的对比实验和§4的蒸馏方法。
recommendation.en: A new angle for weak-to-strong distillation; the core finding that direct fine-tuning on repaired trajectories is ineffective and the useful signal lies in future distribution differences is insightful, focus on §3 comparative experiments and §4 distillation method.

paper.title: The Next Screenshot Knows: Gated Hindsight Distillation for Mobile GUI Agents
paper.abstract: GUI agents are commonly trained offline from successful interaction trajectories. Standard training decomposes each trajectory into prefix-action pairs: the agent predicts an action from the current screen and interaction history, while the subsequent observation is discarded. This removes the rationale of why an action is correct: the evidence often appears only on the subsequent screen. For example, to enable Soft Wrap, the agent should click Edit or View, but nothing reveals this until the me

summary.core_problem: 解决移动 GUI agent 离线模仿学习只看当前屏幕和历史轨迹、无法利用动作后截图解释动作为何正确的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是 agent 训练中的 privileged-information distillation：训练时使用下一帧截图作为教师信息，推理时学生仍只用可见前缀。这对过程监督、离线轨迹学习和 GUI agent 训练有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Gated Hindsight Distillation。学生从可观察轨迹前缀预测动作；参数共享教师额外看到 next screenshot，并重新评分学生的 on-policy responses；只在下一帧确实提供动作正确性证据时启用蒸馏门控，避免把无关 hindsight 噪声注入学生。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体移动 GUI benchmark、模型规模、数据量或提升幅度。实验应比较标准 prefix-action imitation、无门控 hindsight 蒸馏和 GHD，在离线成功轨迹训练的 GUI agent 上评估任务完成率或动作准确率。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses offline training of mobile GUI agents where standard imitation uses only the current screen and history, discarding the next screenshot that often explains why an action is correct.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a privileged-information distillation method for agent training. The teacher can use the next observation during training, while the student remains causal at inference time. This is relevant to process supervision, offline trajectory learning, and GUI-agent training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Gated Hindsight Distillation trains a student on observable trajectory prefixes and a parameter-sharing teacher that additionally observes the next screenshot. The teacher re-scores the student's on-policy responses, and distillation is applied only when the next screenshot provides useful evidence for the action.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report the specific mobile GUI benchmarks, model sizes, dataset scale, or numerical gains. The expected comparisons are standard prefix-action imitation, ungated hindsight distillation, and GHD, evaluated by task success or action accuracy.

recommendation.zh: 这类 hindsight teacher 对离线 agent 数据很实用；看门控条件和 ablation 即可，不必深读应用细节。
recommendation.en: The hindsight-teacher idea is practical for offline agent data; read the gating rule and ablations, skip the app specifics.

paper.title: When Privileged Guidance Misaligns: State-Matched Routing and Contextualized Self-Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents
paper.abstract: Privileged on-policy distillation provides dense supervision for multi-turn agents by allowing a synchronized teacher to re-score the student's response at every turn with access to training-only references, such as successful trajectories. In interactive environments, however, the student's preceding actions continually change the execution state. As the student takes different actions or completes subgoals in a different order, its rollout may reach states not covered by the reference, making

summary.core_problem: 多轮 agent 训练中，特权 on-policy 蒸馏因学生执行状态偏离参考轨迹而产生状态-参考错配，导致指导信号不可靠。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出状态匹配路由 + 上下文自蒸馏，解决多轮 agent 蒸馏中的状态错配问题。
summary.technical_approach: SMRC-SD 显式判断特权轨迹何时/如何指导当前 on-policy 状态，并通过上下文自蒸馏让学生在无可靠参考时自我学习。
summary.experiments: 在交互式多轮 agent 环境中验证，对比普通特权蒸馏，减少状态错配带来的训练噪声。

summary_en.core_problem: In multi-turn agent training, privileged on-policy distillation suffers from state-reference mismatch as the student's rollout diverges from the reference trajectory.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: state-matched routing + contextualized self-distillation to fix state-reference mismatch in multi-turn agent distillation.
summary_en.technical_approach: SMRC-SD explicitly decides when and how a privileged trajectory should guide the current on-policy state, and uses contextualized self-distillation when no reliable reference exists.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated in interactive multi-turn agent environments, reducing training noise from state mismatch compared to vanilla privileged distillation.

recommendation.zh: agent 蒸馏方法的小改进，状态匹配思路对 RL 训练有借鉴，但非预训练核心，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: A small improvement in agent distillation; the state-matching idea is mildly relevant to RL training but not core to pretraining—read abstract only.

paper.title: JoyAI-Video-Edit: Real-Time Open-Ended Video Editing with Autoregressive Diffusion
paper.abstract: Real-time video editing requires low-latency causal generation with bounded computational resources while preserving source fidelity and long-term temporal consistency. We present JoyAI-Video-Edit, a 16B-parameter autoregressive diffusion framework for real-time, open-ended video editing without access to future frames or a predefined video duration. Our method combines chunk-wise autoregressive adaptation, Source-Anchored Distribution Matching Distillation (SA-DMD), and Long-Horizon Autoregress

summary.core_problem: 实时流式视频编辑需要同时满足因果生成（无法访问未来帧）、低延迟、计算/内存有界、长时一致性，还要保留源视频保真度。现有离线编辑器依赖双向注意力与全序列处理，不满足因果要求；直接分块处理会引入边界不连续；自回归生成存在训练-推理不匹配（训练用真值历史、推理用自生成历史）导致的累积漂移；实时要求的少步生成与多步扩散训练之间也存在性能差距。
summary.importance: 验证了自回归扩散（AR+diffusion）统一建模范式在长序列流式生成场景的可行适配路径。分块因果注意力设计、训练-推理不匹配校正、源约束少步蒸馏等思路，可迁移至长视频/语音流式生成、跨模态统一预训练、AR+diffusion联合建模的训练recipe设计中。16B参数大模型实现实时视频编辑的工程方案，也为多模态大模型的部署优化提供参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出16B参数的自回归扩散框架JoyAI-Video-Edit，由MLLM条件编码器、因果视频VAE、多模态扩散Transformer（MM-DiT）组成，支持指令引导的视频到视频编辑与参考条件的图像+视频到视频编辑。以经过渐进式图像-视频生成-编辑课程训练的强双向编辑器为基础，转换为分块因果编辑器，核心包含三项技术：1）分块自回归适配：块内双向注意力，块间因果注意力，滑动时间窗口保留固定数量的最近块+首个块作为全局锚点，保证计算/内存不随流长度增长；训练先采用教师强制（真值历史），再用重采样强制（分离的模型生成历史）减少训练-推理不匹配。2）源锚定分布匹配蒸馏（SA-DMD）：将多步扩散蒸馏为2步生成，沿文本条件和源保真度两个轴引导教师模型，用时间对齐的源块抵消自回归历史漂移，蒸馏后部署模型仅用单条件分支即可保留源保真度。3）长时自回归蒸馏：对扩展的生成rollout做分段优化，直接监督累积自回归误差影响的状态，同时控制训练内存上限。
summary.experiments: 构建长视频编辑基准LongV2VBench，覆盖典型的全局与局部编辑任务。自动与人工评测显示，模型显著优于现有流式编辑器，与强离线系统在短/长视频编辑任务上性能相当。SA-DMD将扩散去噪步骤压缩至2步，仍保留高质量编辑效果与时间一致性。结合有界历史KV缓存、FP8量化、优化的VAE流水线，单张Nvidia B200 GPU上可实现720p视频编辑端到端约30FPS。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看引言中提出的流式编辑三项核心挑战，模型章节的分块注意力设计与三项核心技术的思路，以及实验部分的实时性能指标。可跳过扩散蒸馏的数学推导细节与VAE的具体实现，预计阅读时间25-35分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Real-time streaming video editing requires simultaneous causal generation (no access to future frames), low latency, bounded compute/memory, long-term consistency, and source fidelity preservation. Existing offline editors rely on bidirectional attention and full-sequence processing which violate causality; naive chunk-wise processing introduces boundary discontinuities; autoregressive generation suffers from train-inference mismatch (ground-truth history in training vs self-generated history in inference) causing accumulated drift; and there is a performance gap between the few-step generation required for real-time throughput and multi-step diffusion training.
summary_en.importance: Validates a practical adaptation path for autoregressive diffusion (AR+diffusion) unified modeling in long-sequence streaming generation scenarios. The chunk-wise causal attention design, train-inference mismatch correction, and source-constrained few-step distillation approach can transfer to long video/audio streaming generation, cross-modal unified pretraining, and AR+diffusion joint modeling training recipe design. The 16B-parameter real-time video editing implementation also provides actionable engineering references for multimodal LLM deployment optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes JoyAI-Video-Edit, a 16B-parameter autoregressive diffusion framework consisting of an MLLM condition encoder, causal video VAE, and multimodal diffusion Transformer (MM-DiT), supporting instruction-guided V2V and reference-conditioned IV2V editing. The framework is built by first converting a strong bidirectional editor (pretrained via a progressive image and video generation-editing curriculum) into a chunk-wise causal editor, then applying three core techniques: 1) Chunk-wise autoregressive adaptation: bidirectional attention within chunks, causal attention across chunks, a sliding temporal window retaining a fixed number of recent chunks plus the first chunk as a global anchor to bound compute/memory regardless of stream length; training first uses teacher forcing (ground-truth history) then resampling forcing (detached model-generated history) to reduce train-inference mismatch. 2) Source-Anchored Distribution Matching Distillation (SA-DMD): distills multi-step diffusion into a 2-step generator, guides the teacher model along text-conditioning and source-fidelity axes separately, uses temporally aligned source chunks to counteract autoregressive history drift, so the deployed model retains source fidelity with only a single conditional branch. 3) Long-Horizon Autoregressive Distillation: performs segmented optimization over extended rollouts to directly supervise states affected by accumulated autoregressive errors, while keeping training memory bounded.
summary_en.experiments: Constructs LongV2VBench, a long-video editing benchmark covering representative global and local editing tasks. Automatic and human evaluations show the model substantially outperforms existing streaming editors and remains competitive with strong offline systems on both short and long video editing. SA-DMD reduces diffusion denoising to 2 steps while retaining high editing quality and temporal consistency. Combined with bounded-history KV caching, FP8 quantization, and an optimized VAE pipeline, the full system delivers ~30 FPS end-to-end 720p video editing on a single Nvidia B200 GPU.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the three core streaming editing challenges outlined in the introduction, the chunk-wise attention design and three core techniques in the model section, and the real-time performance metrics in experiments. Skip detailed mathematical derivations of diffusion distillation and VAE implementation details; estimated reading time 25-35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 自回归扩散长序列生成的时序漂移缓解思路，对AR+diffusion统一建模有参考，重点看方法部分的蒸馏设计。
recommendation.en: Temporal drift mitigation for long-sequence autoregressive diffusion, useful for AR+diffusion unified modeling; focus on the distillation design in the method section.

paper.title: Stuck on "A": Diagnosing and Repairing Interface Injury in Attention-to-KDA Linearization of a 0.6B Language Model
paper.abstract: We convert 21 of 28 full-attention layers of Qwen3-0.6B-Base into KDA (Kimi Delta Attention) linear-attention layers on a single consumer-grade GPU budget, and ask a simple question: what exactly does the conversion break? After surgery, hidden-state alignment and end-to-end KL distillation drive the student close to its teacher in perplexity, yet multiple-choice accuracy stays near random chance (25-29% vs. the teacher's 50.6% on C-Eval). Using a four-permutation diagnostic that rotates answer

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的不是“线性化能不能把困惑度做回来”，而是“把全注意力 LLM 改造成 KDA 线性注意力后，究竟坏在什么地方”。作者把 Qwen3-0.6B-Base 的 28 层里 21 层替换成 KDA，发现即便通过逐层 hidden-state 对齐和端到端 KL 蒸馏，语言建模损失已经接近教师，多项选择能力却仍接近随机。全文给出的核心诊断是：模型未必丢了全部知识，而是损伤了把内部知识映射到选项接口上的能力，也就是论文所说的 interface injury。这个问题比一般的“能力退化”更细，因为标准 CE / PPL / KL 指标几乎看不出来。
summary.importance: 对预训练和模型改造研究的意义主要有三点。第一，它给出一个很具体的反例：低 perplexity gap 不等于任务能力保留，尤其不等于离散决策接口仍然正常。这对架构替换、蒸馏、压缩、量化后再训练都很重要。第二，它把“知识丢失”和“接口损伤”区分开来，提出了可操作的诊断方法，而不是停留在现象描述。第三，它展示了一个预算很紧的 conversion recipe，并把失败细节公开出来，包括错误的 teacher init、gate 初始化、bf16 更新吞噬、cache bug 等。这类负结果和排障记录，对做架构 surgery 的人比单纯报一个最终分数更有用。量级上，这不是提出新预训练范式的工作，但它对‘如何评估和修复架构改造后的能力错位’有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分三段。第一段是架构转换。作者从 Qwen3-0.6B-Base 出发，保留每 4 层中的 1 层原生 GQA，共保留 7 层，其余 21 层替换为 KDA。KDA 配置包括 16 heads、head dim 128、短卷积 k=4、q/k L2 norm、低秩 forget gate、beta write gate、gated RMSNorm、NoPE。这样做不是纯线性模型，而是混合结构：75% 层用 O(1) recurrent state，剩余层仍保留线性增长 KV cache。作者还详细分析了 forget gate 初始化，指出几乎不遗忘会让 recurrent state 爆炸，遗忘过强又会比随机还差，最终采用 g6 初始化，forget half-life 中位数约 6.3 tokens。

第二段是两级蒸馏。先做 layer-wise hidden alignment：每个 KDA 层对齐对应 teacher hidden state，teacher 冻结，误差跨层 detach，只训练 KDA 参数 193.6M，学习率 1e-4 到 1e-5，batch 为 8192 tokens/step。这个阶段把 CE 从 9.48 拉到 4.125，但 C-Eval 仍只有 25.5%。随后做 end-to-end forward KL distillation，在预训练文本上最小化 teacher-student next-token 分布的 forward KL，不混 CE；训练范围扩大到 KDA + 全部 MLP + LayerNorm，共 457.9M 参数，embedding、lm_head 和保留的 7 个 attention 层冻结。为适配单卡显存，作者实现了 chunked fp32 KL，避免物化全量 logits。7000 steps、总计 57.3M tokens 后，valid CE 到 2.9385，teacher 为 2.8108，gap 仅 +0.128 nats，valid KL 0.160，但 C-Eval 只有 28.8%。

第三段是诊断与修复。诊断上，作者构造了 161 道来自训练语料、与 benchmark 零重叠的四选一题，每题做四次 cyclic option rotation，内容不变，只旋转 A/B/C/D 标签。若模型跟随内容，正确标签应随 rotation 改变；若只是知识丢失，预测应更接近均匀随机。实际结果是学生模型 81.06% 时间选 A，161 题中有 106 题在四次 rotation 下都保持同一标签，且正确选项平均 margin 为 -0.117 nats。这说明它不是单纯不会，而是输出接口塌缩到了标签偏置。修复上，作者加入一个 1000-step 的 Stage 3b，用 completion-only KL 在 teacher 验证过的 MCQ permutations、诗歌、翻译 QA 上做格式修复。这个阶段不追求全面分布拟合，而是专门修补“问题-选项-答案”接口。之后再做 persona alignment，包括 SFT、identity booster 和一轮 on-policy DPO，并用 15 个 benchmark guard points 监控遗忘。
summary.experiments:
最关键的结果有四组。第一，转换初始状态下，采用最终选定的 g6 gate 初始化时，held-out ruler CE 为 9.48；teacher 为 3.01，说明直接 surgery 损伤很大。作者还比较了极端遗忘和极端保留，前者性能比随机还差，后者 recurrent state 不稳定。第二，逐层 hidden alignment 把 overall CE 从 9.48 降到 4.13 左右，但 C-Eval 仍在 25% 随机线附近，证明 hidden trajectory 对齐不足以恢复决策能力。第三，端到端 KL 蒸馏 7000 steps、57.3M tokens 后，valid CE 2.9385 对 teacher 2.8108，gap +0.128；valid KL 0.160；但 C-Eval 仅 28.8%，依然远低于 teacher 的 50.6%。这是全文最有信息量的数字：LM loss 几乎追平，任务能力却没有回来。第四，格式修复阶段后，C-Eval 从 28.8% 提升到 41.3%，最终 persona 对齐后到 41.83%；label stickiness 约减半，correct-option margin 由负转正，但 valid KL 从 0.160 变差到 0.196，说明接口修复和通用分布拟合之间存在可测的 trade-off。

一些消融也值得看。作者追查了两代失败的 projection transplant：v1 实际没有成功 transplant，和 teacher cosine 约为 0、和随机初始化 cosine 约 0.69；v2 虽然做了 transplant，但功能上与 teacher 近乎正交，mean cosine 仅 0.007。v3 放弃 projection transplant，functional probe cosine 反而升到 0.434。这个结果说明在 attention→KDA 这种异构替换里，参数形状可对齐不代表功能可迁移。另一个工程细节是 bf16 update swallowing 和 cache bug，这些问题如果不排掉，很容易把“架构不行”和“实现有错”混在一起。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议先抓三处。第一看引言和 Figure 1 附近，理解作者为什么说 perplexity 会“撒谎”，以及 interface injury 与普通知识遗忘的区别。第二看四-permutation diagnostic 的定义和结果表，这是全文最值得带走的方法资产；如果只记一个点，就记这个。第三看 conversion pipeline 里关于 gate 初始化、projection transplant 取舍、chunked KL 实现的部分，这些是做架构改造时真正会踩到的坑。

如果时间有限，优先顺序可以是：Introduction → 四-permutation 诊断结果 → Stage 3b repair → failure audit。预计 25 到 35 分钟能抓住主要信息。若准备复现或做类似 linearization，建议细看附录里的实现审计、数值误差验证、训练超参和 bug 记录，因为这篇工作的价值有一半在这些“为什么前两版失败”的细节里。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a sharper question than whether linearization preserves perplexity: after replacing most full-attention layers with KDA linear attention, what exactly breaks? Starting from Qwen3-0.6B-Base, the authors convert 21 of 28 layers to KDA and show that hidden-state alignment plus end-to-end KL distillation can recover language-modeling loss surprisingly well, yet multiple-choice accuracy remains near random. Their central claim, supported by targeted diagnostics, is that the model may retain part of the underlying knowledge while losing the interface that maps that knowledge onto answer-option labels. This “interface injury” is largely invisible to standard CE/PPL/KL metrics.
summary_en.importance: The main value is methodological rather than scale-driven. First, it provides a concrete failure case where a small perplexity gap does not imply preserved task ability, which matters for architecture conversion, distillation, compression, and post-hoc model surgery more broadly. Second, it separates knowledge loss from interface corruption with an operational diagnostic instead of a vague qualitative story. Third, it documents a budget-constrained conversion pipeline together with failure forensics: broken teacher initialization, gate-init pathologies, bf16 update swallowing, and cache bugs. For researchers working on pretraining-adjacent architecture changes, these negative results and debugging notes are more useful than a single final score.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three stages. Stage 1 is architecture conversion. From Qwen3-0.6B-Base, every fourth layer remains native GQA, leaving 7 full-attention layers and replacing the other 21 with KDA. The KDA stack uses 16 heads, head dimension 128, causal short convolution with k=4, L2-normalized q/k, low-rank forget gates, beta write gates, gated RMSNorm, and NoPE. This yields a hybrid model rather than a pure linear-attention model: 75% of layers use O(1) recurrent state, while the retained GQA layers still have linearly growing KV cache. A notable engineering point is gate initialization. The paper shows that near-total retention destabilizes the recurrent state, while excessive forgetting performs worse than random; their adopted g6 initialization gives a median forget half-life of about 6.3 tokens.

Stage 2 is two-step distillation. The first step is layer-wise hidden-state alignment: each KDA layer is trained against the corresponding teacher hidden state, with the teacher frozen and errors detached across layers. Only KDA parameters are updated in this phase, 193.6M trainable parameters total, at 8,192 tokens per step. This reduces CE from 9.48 to about 4.13, but C-Eval stays at chance. The second step is end-to-end forward-KL distillation on pretraining text. The objective is pure forward KL between teacher and student next-token distributions, without mixing in CE. Trainable parameters now include KDA, all MLPs, and all LayerNorms, 457.9M in total, while embeddings, tied lm_head, and the 7 retained attention layers remain frozen. To fit a single 32GB GPU budget, they implement chunked fp32 KL instead of materializing full logits. After 7,000 steps over 57.3M tokens, validation CE reaches 2.9385 versus the teacher’s 2.8108, a gap of only +0.128 nats, with validation KL 0.160, yet C-Eval is still only 28.8%.

Stage 3 is diagnosis and repair. The diagnostic is a four-permutation multiple-choice test: 161 clean four-option questions are constructed from the training corpus with zero benchmark overlap, and each question is evaluated under four cyclic rotations of option labels. A content-following model should track the correct option as labels rotate; a model that simply forgot should fail roughly uniformly. Instead, the converted model predicts “A” 81.06% of the time, and 106 of 161 questions keep the same predicted label under all four rotations. The average margin on the correct option is negative, -0.117 nats. This points to label-interface collapse rather than uniform forgetting. The repair stage then runs 1,000 steps of completion-only KL on teacher-verified MCQ permutations, poetry, and translation QA, explicitly targeting the question-option-answer interface. Persona alignment is added afterward via SFT, an identity booster, and one round of on-policy DPO, monitored with 15 benchmark guard points.
summary_en.experiments:
Four results matter most. First, immediately after conversion, the adopted g6 gate initialization gives held-out CE 9.48, versus 3.01 for the teacher, showing that naive surgery is highly lossy. The paper also compares extreme forgetting and extreme retention, showing that one collapses performance below random while the other destabilizes the recurrent state. Second, layer-wise hidden alignment reduces CE from 9.48 to roughly 4.13, but C-Eval remains around the 25% random baseline, demonstrating that hidden-trajectory matching is insufficient for restoring decision behavior. Third, end-to-end KL distillation over 7,000 steps and 57.3M tokens yields validation CE 2.9385 versus teacher 2.8108, only +0.128 nats apart, with validation KL 0.160, yet C-Eval reaches only 28.8% compared with the teacher’s 50.6%. This is the key empirical point: LM loss nearly recovers, but task ability does not. Fourth, the format-repair stage lifts C-Eval from 28.8% to 41.3%, and the final persona-aligned model reaches 41.83%. Label stickiness is roughly halved, and the correct-option margin turns positive, but validation KL worsens from 0.160 to 0.196, indicating a measurable trade-off between interface repair and general distribution matching.

The ablations are also informative. Two generations of projection transplant fail for different reasons: v1 did not actually transplant meaningful teacher projections at all, with cosine near 0 to the teacher and about 0.69 to random init; v2 performed a transplant that was functionally almost orthogonal to the teacher, with mean cosine only 0.007. In v3, abandoning projection transplant improves functional probe cosine to 0.434. This suggests that in heterogeneous replacements such as attention-to-KDA, parameter-shape compatibility does not imply functional transfer. The implementation notes on bf16 update swallowing and cache bugs are also useful because they isolate architecture failure from plain engineering mistakes.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and the early diagnostic framing to understand why perplexity can be misleading here and how interface injury differs from ordinary knowledge loss. Second, read the four-permutation diagnostic and its result tables carefully; this is the most reusable idea in the paper. Third, inspect the conversion pipeline sections on gate initialization, projection-transplant failure, and chunked KL implementation, since these are the parts most likely to matter in real architecture surgery.

A practical reading order is: Introduction → four-permutation diagnostic → Stage 3b repair → failure audit. That should take about 25–35 minutes for a solid skim. If you plan to reproduce or extend this kind of linearization, spend extra time on the appendices covering implementation audits, numerical checks, hyperparameters, and bug records. Much of the paper’s value lies in why earlier versions failed, not just in the final recipe.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是看 KDA，而是看 failure analysis：PPL/KL 好看不代表接口没坏，做架构替换或蒸馏时应立刻加这种 option-rotation 诊断。
recommendation.en: Read this for the failure analysis, not for KDA: good PPL/KL does not mean the interface survived, and option-rotation diagnostics should be added immediately to any architecture-surgery or distillation pipeline.

paper.title: Distill What the Student Can See: Fisher-Projected On-Policy Distillation for Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) samples trajectories from the current student policy and minimizes token-level divergence between student and teacher next-token distributions at prefixes along those trajectories. This aligns the distillation states with the student's own generation distribution. However, it still assumes that the complete teacher distribution is an appropriate target across student capacities. In vision--language reasoning, teacher corrections can depend on visual distinctions that

summary.core_problem: FP-OPD 解决的是 VLM on-policy distillation 中“状态对齐了，但目标不一定适合学生模型”的问题。OPD 用学生自己生成的轨迹做蒸馏，缓解了训练前缀与推理前缀不一致。但在视觉语言推理中，大教师的 token 分布可能依赖学生无法表征的视觉证据。直接让小学生匹配完整教师分布，可能要求它学习超出自身视觉表示能力的修正。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练和中后期训练的启发在于：教师信号不是越完整越好，训练目标需要匹配学生模型当前可表达的局部几何。这个结论适用于 VLM 蒸馏，也可能影响小模型继续预训练、multimodal mid-training、以及用强模型生成监督信号的流程。它提供了一个比简单调低 KL 权重更细的方案：不是整体削弱教师，而是保留学生能通过自身视觉通路表达的那部分修正。
summary.technical_approach: 方法沿用 OPD 的 on-policy 轨迹：学生先生成回答轨迹，教师和学生都在这些学生访问过的 prefix 上输出 full-vocabulary 分布。标准 OPD 直接最小化学生分布到教师分布的 token-level reverse KL。FP-OPD 改动的是 target，而不是训练轨迹或损失形式。它先把教师监督表示为相对于学生 log-probability 的 correction，然后用 detached perturbation probes 估计学生当前的局部视觉响应空间。KL 在局部诱导 Fisher metric，因此方法在 Fisher 几何下把教师 correction 投影到学生可表达的视觉响应空间中，得到 reachable target q^R。训练时仍使用标准 full-vocabulary reverse KL，只是把完整教师分布替换成 q^R。与简单温度、label smoothing 或统一缩放 teacher target 不同，FP-OPD 会按学生局部表示能力选择性保留教师修正。
summary.experiments: 论文先做 target-scaling 诊断实验。对于 8B 教师到 2B 学生的设置，当插值强度 α=0.5 时，学生一个 epoch 后能消除 56.3% 的指定 KL gap；使用完整教师目标 α=1 时只消除 46.6%。同一中间目标还将 MathVista Geometry 从 55.29 提升到 57.03，说明完整教师分布更难拟合，并且未必带来更好的下游推理。主实验显示，在 8B-to-2B 蒸馏中，FP-OPD 在 7 个 benchmark 上均有提升，平均分相比 base student 提高 2.77 分，相比标准 OPD 提高 1.60 分。论文还报告了不同教师规模和教师变体下的稳定收益。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读约 25 到 35 分钟。先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，重点是 target interpolation 实验，它是整篇工作的动机支点。然后看 Method 和 Figure 2，理解 Fisher projection 如何从教师分布构造 q^R。公式部分不需要逐行推导，但要看清楚 correction、visual response space、Fisher metric 三者的关系。实验部分重点看 8B-to-2B 主结果、target scaling、projection ablation，以及不同教师变体的结果。

summary_en.core_problem: FP-OPD addresses a target mismatch in on-policy distillation for vision-language models. OPD samples trajectories from the current student, so supervision is applied at prefixes the student actually visits. However, sharing the same prefix does not guarantee that the complete teacher distribution is a suitable target. In VLM reasoning, teacher corrections may rely on visual evidence that a compact student cannot represent.
summary_en.importance: The main training lesson is that stronger teacher targets are not always better for smaller multimodal students. The useful signal is the part of the teacher correction that lies within the student’s current response geometry. This matters for VLM distillation, multimodal mid-training, and synthetic supervision pipelines where large models provide dense token-level targets. The paper offers a more structured alternative to simply reducing the KL weight or interpolating the teacher distribution uniformly.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method keeps the OPD protocol: the student rolls out an on-policy trajectory, and both student and teacher are evaluated on the resulting prefixes. Standard OPD minimizes a full-vocabulary token-level reverse KL to the complete teacher distribution. FP-OPD changes only the target. It represents the teacher signal as a correction to the student log-probabilities, estimates the student’s local visual response space using detached perturbation probes, and projects the teacher correction onto that space under the Fisher metric induced locally by KL. The projected correction defines a reachable target q^R, which replaces the full teacher distribution in the same reverse-KL loss. Unlike temperature scaling or uniform target weakening, the projection selectively keeps corrections that the student can express through its current visual pathway.
summary_en.experiments: A diagnostic target-scaling study shows the mismatch clearly. In an 8B-to-2B setting, a target interpolation strength of α=0.5 lets the student remove 56.3% of the prescribed KL gap after one epoch, while the complete teacher target at α=1 removes only 46.6%. The intermediate target also improves MathVista Geometry from 55.29 to 57.03. In the main experiments, FP-OPD improves all seven reported benchmarks for 8B-to-2B distillation, with an average gain of 2.77 points over the base student and 1.60 points over standard OPD. The paper also reports consistent gains across teacher scales and teacher variants.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25 to 35 minutes. Read the introduction and Figure 1 first; the target interpolation experiment is the clearest evidence for the capacity-target mismatch. Then read the method figure and the projection derivation to understand how the reachable target q^R is constructed. The most informative experiments are the 8B-to-2B comparison, the target-scaling analysis, the projection ablations, and the teacher-variant results.

recommendation.zh: 这个 prior 值得改：蒸馏不该总追完整 teacher 分布；看 target-scaling 实验和投影定义。
recommendation.en: This changes a useful prior: distillation should not always chase the full teacher distribution; read the target-scaling study and projection definition.

paper.title: LeapTalk: Breaking the Latency-Quality Trade-off in Talking Head Generation
paper.abstract: Long-form and real-time talking-head generation remains challenging due to a latency-quality trade-off: inefficient multi-step diffusion prohibits streaming generation, whereas real-time autoregressive approaches suffer from error accumulation and identity drift. To address this drawback, we propose LeapTalk, a novel framework that achieves stable and real-time talking-head generation with a single forward step, scaling to arbitrarily long videos. At the heart of our approach lies a single-step

summary.core_problem: 解决长视频和实时说话人头部生成中存在的延迟-质量权衡问题（多步扩散太慢，自回归容易累积误差）。
summary.importance: 提出 LeapTalk 框架，通过单步前向传递实现稳定、实时的说话人头部生成，并能扩展到任意长度的视频。
summary.technical_approach: 核心是单步桥接蒸馏方案。引入基于布朗桥的数据到数据传输公式，以持久参考为锚点，减轻身份漂移。同时，探索异构蒸馏框架，将预训练扩散教师模型的知识平滑转移到学生桥接模型。
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中提供具体实验数据，但声称实现了单步实时生成并解决了身份漂移问题。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the latency-quality trade-off in long-form and real-time talking-head generation (multi-step diffusion is too slow, autoregressive accumulates errors).
summary_en.importance: Proposes the LeapTalk framework for stable, real-time talking-head generation with a single forward step, scalable to arbitrarily long videos.
summary_en.technical_approach: Core is a single-step bridge distillation scheme. Introduces a data-to-data transport formulation based on a Brownian bridge, anchored by a persistent reference to mitigate identity drift. Explores a heterogeneous distillation framework to transfer knowledge from a pre-trained diffusion teacher to the student bridge model.
summary_en.experiments: No specific experimental data in the abstract, but claims to achieve single-step real-time generation and solve identity drift.

recommendation.zh: 视频生成领域的单步蒸馏工作，利用布朗桥解决长视频生成的身份漂移问题，对多模态生成研究者有一定参考价值，预训练研究员可跳过。
recommendation.en: Single-step distillation work in video generation using Brownian bridge to solve identity drift; useful for multimodal generation researchers, pretraining researchers can skip.

paper.title: Distill Where You Fail: Recovering Learning Signals of Negative RL-Groups from Adaptive Teacher Guidance
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard paradigm for post-training large language models (LLMs). While Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely adopted, it suffers from sparse reward signals and loses gradients entirely when all responses within a group receive identical rewards. On-policy distillation (OPD) offers a natural remedy by providing dense, token-level supervision from a teacher model. However, naively combining GRPO with OPD leads to deg

summary.core_problem: RSTG 解决的是 RLVR 中 GRPO 学习信号稀疏的问题，尤其是 group 内样本全错时的 negative zero-variance prompts。GRPO 在这种情况下没有相对优势，梯度会消失。直接加入 on-policy distillation 虽然能提供 token-level dense signal，但会带来 teacher-boundedness、样本不适配、token advantage 大量为负和局部前缀误差传播等问题，实际效果可能差于标准 GRPO。
summary.importance: 这项工作对 post-train 与 pretrain 接口有明确参考价值。它说明 dense teacher signal 不能无差别加入 RL，而应该只在 RL 无法给出有效梯度的位置补信号。这个思想对 RL 数据效率、verifier-based training、reasoning model 的失败样本挖掘都有启发。贡献量级属于方法级改进，不是新训练范式，但抓住了 GRPO+distillation 中一个常见且实际的问题：什么时候应该蒸馏，蒸馏哪些 token，以及如何避免过快贴近 teacher。
summary.technical_approach: RSTG 先把 GRPO、OPD 和 SFT 放到统一 policy-gradient 视角下分析。GRPO 用 group reward 的均值和方差估计 advantage；当组内 reward 相同，advantage 退化。OPD 在学生自己采样的轨迹上最小化 student 到 teacher 的 reverse KL，可写成 token-level advantage，其中 advantage 与 teacher-student log-prob gap 相关。问题是多数学生生成 token 在 teacher 下概率低，负 advantage 过多，会压制探索。RSTG 的处理有三部分。第一，sample selection：只在 student 失败但 teacher 能成功的样本上施加 OPD，重点覆盖 negative zero-variance prompts，并按 teacher mastery 加权。文中指出，仅使用全量数据的 3.63% 做这类 OPD，效果反而优于对所有样本蒸馏。第二，token selection：只更新学生高熵 token 或 teacher-student divergence 较大的 token，减少噪声，也减缓过早收敛到 teacher。第三，auxiliary SFT：在 negative zero-variance prompts 上使用 teacher 预生成的正确轨迹做 SFT，补充全局正向轨迹信号，缓解 OPD 只沿学生错误前缀给局部梯度的问题。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen2.5 和 Qwen3 系列，在数学和代码 benchmark 上验证。相对于 naive GRPO+OPD，RSTG 在数学任务上提升 4.02%，在代码任务上提升 3.05%。文中还报告了几个训练动态层面的现象：选择性 OPD 能缓解 advantage asymmetry；token selection 会减缓向 teacher 的过快收敛；辅助 SFT 可以减少负样本组完全无梯度的问题；RSTG 还避免了 response length 的突然膨胀。由于给出的全文片段未包含完整实验表格，无法确认具体模型尺寸、每个 benchmark 的绝对分数和训练 token 数。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 naive GRPO+OPD 失败原因的拆解，再看 Preliminaries 中把 OPD 写成 policy-gradient advantage 的推导，这部分决定了后续方法为什么要做 sample/token selection。方法部分重点看三件事：negative zero-variance prompts 的筛选规则、teacher mastery weighting、token-level mask 的定义。实验部分优先看 Qwen2.5/Qwen3 上的主结果、OPD 数据比例 3.63% 的消融、response length 曲线和 advantage distribution。若在做 RLVR recipe，这项工作最值得复用的是“只在 RL 失效处补 teacher signal”的训练调度，而不是简单叠加蒸馏 loss。

summary_en.core_problem: RSTG addresses the loss of learning signal in RLVR with GRPO, especially on negative zero-variance prompts where every sampled response in the group is wrong. In that case, group-relative advantages vanish. On-policy distillation can provide dense token-level supervision from a teacher, but a naive GRPO+OPD objective often performs worse because distillation is not useful for every sample, it can make the student converge too quickly to the teacher, and its token-level advantages are often negative on student-generated trajectories.
summary_en.importance: The work is useful for the interface between RL post-training and pretraining-style learning signals. It argues that dense teacher supervision should not be applied uniformly; it should be used where RL has no useful gradient. This is relevant to RL data efficiency, verifier-based reasoning training, and failure-driven data construction. The contribution is a targeted recipe rather than a new training paradigm, but it addresses a practical failure mode in GRPO plus distillation: when to distill, which tokens to update, and how to avoid collapsing exploration toward the teacher too early.
summary_en.technical_approach: RSTG first analyzes GRPO, OPD, and SFT under a shared policy-gradient view. GRPO estimates advantages from group rewards; when all rewards in a group are identical, the advantage disappears. OPD minimizes reverse KL from the student to the teacher on student-generated trajectories and can be written as a token-level advantage based on the teacher-student log-probability gap. This dense signal is noisy and asymmetric because many student tokens have low teacher probability, producing mostly negative advantages. RSTG uses three controls. First, sample selection applies OPD only when the student fails and the teacher succeeds, focusing on negative zero-variance prompts and weighting the signal by teacher mastery. The paper reports that using only 3.63% of the full data in this way outperforms standard OPD over all samples. Second, token selection restricts updates to high-entropy student tokens or tokens with large teacher-student divergence, reducing noisy gradients and slowing premature teacher imitation. Third, auxiliary SFT uses teacher-generated correct trajectories on negative zero-variance prompts, adding a global positive trajectory signal that OPD lacks when it conditions on erroneous student prefixes.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 model families on mathematical and code benchmarks. Compared with naive GRPO+OPD, RSTG improves math performance by 4.02% and code performance by 3.05%. The reported training dynamics support the method design: selective OPD mitigates advantage asymmetry, token selection slows convergence toward the teacher, auxiliary SFT restores positive learning signals for all-failed groups, and the full recipe avoids abrupt response-length inflation. The provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete result tables, so exact model sizes, per-benchmark absolute scores, and training-token counts cannot be verified here.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25–30 minutes. Start with the introduction, especially the three failure modes of naive GRPO+OPD. Then read the preliminaries where OPD is rewritten as a policy-gradient objective; this derivation explains why sample and token selection are needed. In the method section, focus on the definition of negative zero-variance prompts, teacher mastery weighting, and the token-level update mask. In the experiments, prioritize the Qwen2.5/Qwen3 main results, the 3.63% data-ratio ablation, response-length curves, and advantage-distribution analysis. For RLVR recipe design, the reusable idea is to inject teacher signals only where RL has failed to produce gradients, rather than simply adding a distillation loss everywhere.

recommendation.zh: 不是范式突破，但它把“RL 缺梯度时该不该蒸馏、蒸馏到哪一层粒度”讲得比多数 RLVR 论文更干净；重点看失败分析和 selective guidance 设计。
recommendation.en: Not a paradigm shift, but it is cleaner than most RLVR papers on when distillation should rescue missing RL gradients; read the failure analysis and the selective-guidance design.

paper.title: MAGA: Multi-Platform Self-Fusion of GUI Agents via Structured Action Distillation
paper.abstract: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents based on large language models are increasingly deployed across mobile, web, and desktop environments. However, existing agents are typically domain-specific, limiting the deployment and user experience. This motivates the consolidation of specialized models into a single cross-environment policy. Weight merging directly merges domain-specific experts but can corrupt executable actions under expert disagreement, while on-policy distillation (OPD) avoids conf

summary.core_problem: 解决 GUI agent 在移动端、Web、桌面等不同环境中各自训练、难以合并为统一跨平台策略的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 训练与蒸馏方法改进。它关注的是多环境 GUI policy 的融合，而不是单一平台上继续堆 prompt 或工具规则；对通用 agent 训练信号如何分配有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MAGA，通过结构化动作蒸馏替代普通 token-level distillation。方法根据生成动作的正确性重新分配监督信号：对不必要或无效的蒸馏信号做抑制，把学习压力集中到错误动作相关 token；同时引入 training-only hint 来优化监督信号。相比直接权重合并，它避免不同专家动作冲突导致可执行性受损；相比 on-policy distillation，它不再把所有响应 token 等权处理。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据、具体平台集合、baseline 数量或提升幅度。可确认的实验目标应是跨移动端、Web、桌面 GUI agent 的融合效果，并与权重合并和 on-policy distillation 类方法比较。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to consolidate GUI agents trained for mobile, web, and desktop environments into a single cross-platform policy.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent training and distillation method. Its useful part is the treatment of action tokens as the real interface to the environment, rather than treating the full response as uniformly important supervision.
summary_en.technical_approach: MAGA performs structured action distillation. It reallocates distillation loss according to action correctness, suppresses unnecessary or invalid teacher signals, and focuses learning on erroneous executable actions. A training-only hint is also used to refine the supervision signal. This is positioned against direct weight merging, which can corrupt actions under expert disagreement, and standard on-policy distillation, which weights all response tokens equally.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, data scale, exact baselines, or numerical gains. The intended evaluation is cross-environment GUI agent consolidation against weight merging and on-policy distillation baselines.

recommendation.zh: 只看动作 token 重加权的 loss 设计即可；GUI 场景偏应用，结论别外推到通用 agent 训练。
recommendation.en: Read only the action-token loss reweighting idea; the GUI setup is applied enough that broad agent-training claims should be treated cautiously.

paper.title: OPLD: On-Policy Latent Distillation for Multimodal Reasoning
paper.abstract: Interleaved multimodal Chain-of-Thought (CoT) improves visual reasoning by incorporating auxiliary visual evidence into intermediate reasoning. However, existing approaches remain constrained by externally defined reasoning traces and visual operations, limiting their ability to develop flexible and abstract visual thinking. Reasoning with latent has recently offered a promising direction by internalizing intermediate computation into continuous representations. Nevertheless, existing visual-lat

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究如何让多模态模型在没有显式视觉 CoT、裁剪图、工具观察等辅助信息的情况下，把 interleaved multimodal CoT 中的中间推理过程内化到连续 latent states 里。
summary.importance: 它对预训练方向的启发在于 latent reasoning 的训练信号设计。已有视觉 latent 方法常把 latent token 对齐到压缩后的辅助视觉特征，这容易把 latent state 变成“视觉证据缓存”，而不是可泛化的推理状态。OPLD 的思路是用带有多模态 CoT 的 teacher 监督 student 的内部轨迹，把监督对象从特征级对齐转到过程级蒸馏。这对后续做 CoT-free reasoning、隐式推理 token、以及多模态统一建模都有参考价值。
