paper.title: Data-Forcing Distillation: Restoring Diversity and Fidelity in Few-Step Video Generation
paper.abstract: Recent progress has shown promise in distilling multi-step video diffusion models into efficient few-step students. Among them, Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) and its successor DMD2 achieved strong generation quality and fast convergence. However, due to the nature of the reverse Kullback--Leibler (KL) objective, these methods exhibit two persistent failure modes: a substantial drop in sample diversity, and visibly over-saturated outputs that deviate from real-video appearance. In this

summary.core_problem: 基于反向KL的视频扩散模型少步蒸馏方法（如DMD/DMD2）存在样本多样性下降（模式崩溃）和输出过饱和、偏离真实视频分布的两大缺陷。
summary.importance: 提出极简的蒸馏后训练框架，仅需单行代码修改即可缓解DMD类方法的核心缺陷，对扩散模型少步蒸馏有通用参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Data-Forcing Distillation（DFD），在原有DMD损失基础上引入教师分数差异项，引导学生模型向真实数据分布移动，一方面补充缺失的生成模式（缓解模式崩溃），另一方面拉离真实数据中不存在的错误模式（缓解过饱和），配套理论分析解释框架有效性。
summary.experiments: 在文本到视频生成任务上验证，相比DMD/DMD2基线，少步生成设置下显著提升样本多样性与视觉保真度，缓解输出过饱和问题。

summary_en.core_problem: Few-step video diffusion distillation methods based on reverse KL (e.g., DMD/DMD2) suffer from two persistent failure modes: reduced sample diversity from mode collapse, and over-saturated outputs that deviate from real video distributions.
summary_en.importance: Proposes an extremely simple post-training distillation framework that mitigates both core flaws of DMD-style methods with a single line of code change, offering general insights for few-step diffusion distillation across domains.
summary_en.technical_approach: Data-Forcing Distillation (DFD) adds a teacher score discrepancy term to the standard DMD loss, guiding the student model toward the real data distribution to cover missing modes (reducing mode collapse) and push away from spurious modes absent in real data (reducing over-saturation), supported by theoretical analysis of the objective.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on text-to-video generation tasks, showing significant improvements in sample diversity and visual fidelity under few-step settings compared to DMD/DMD2 baselines, with reduced output over-saturation.

recommendation.zh: 视频扩散蒸馏的极简损失改进，缓解反向KL导致的mode collapse，做扩散LM蒸馏可参考其损失设计
recommendation.en: A simple loss fix for reverse-KL induced mode collapse in video diffusion distillation; worth checking the loss design if you work on diffusive LM distillation.

paper.title: The Quality-Utility Paradox: Why High-Reward Data Impairs Small Model Mathematical Reasoning
paper.abstract: Knowledge distillation from powerful reasoning models is widely used to improve Small Language Models (SLMs) on mathematical reasoning, often assuming that traces with higher reward model scores provide more useful supervision. We identify a counterintuitive \textbf{Quality-Utility Paradox} in mathematical reasoning distillation. Data refined or synthesized by a stronger Oracle obtains higher perceived quality according to reward models, yet consistently underperforms traces generated by the SLM

summary.core_problem: 解决小模型数学推理蒸馏中的一个反常现象：奖励模型评分更高、看起来更“优质”的推理轨迹，为什么反而让学生模型学得更差。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值不在新蒸馏框架本身，而在于指出了一个会直接影响合成推理数据和后训练配方的失配机制：高 reward 不等于高 utility。对做 SFT/RL 数据构造、teacher-student distillation、以及 pretrain↔post-train 接口的人都有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Quality-Utility Paradox：强 Oracle 对轨迹做 refinement 或 synthesis 后，虽然 reward model 评分更高，但会把样本分布推离学生模型原生 reasoning style，导致 adaptation cost 上升，抵消逻辑修复带来的收益。为验证这一机制，提出 Style-Aligned Refinement，在保留学生模型原生轨迹风格的前提下进行逻辑修复，尽量减少 distributional drift。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen2.5、LLaMA-3、DeepSeek 等多个模型家族的小模型数学推理蒸馏设置；比较对象包括 Oracle refined/synthesized traces 与学生模型自生成后经 rejection sampling 选出的轨迹。摘要结论是：前者 reward 更高但训练后效果更差，而 style-aligned refinement 能恢复部分收益。摘要未给出具体参数量、数据量和提升幅度，但 setup 横跨多个家族，说明现象不是单一模型偶然性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a counterintuitive issue in small-model math reasoning distillation: why traces with higher reward-model scores can be less useful for training the student.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is not a new distillation pipeline per se, but a concrete failure mode for synthetic reasoning data and post-training recipes: high reward does not imply high utility. This matters directly for SFT/RL data construction, teacher-student distillation, and the pretrain-to-post-train interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formulate the Quality-Utility Paradox: Oracle refinement or synthesis improves apparent trace quality under reward models, but also induces distributional drift away from the student's native reasoning style, increasing adaptation cost and offsetting the benefit of better logic. To test this mechanism, they propose Style-Aligned Refinement, which repairs logic while preserving the student's native trajectory style.
summary_en.experiments: The study spans math reasoning distillation setups across Qwen2.5, LLaMA-3, and DeepSeek model families. It compares Oracle-refined/synthesized traces against traces generated by the student itself and selected via rejection sampling. The abstract claims the former score higher under reward models yet train worse, while style-aligned refinement recovers part of the loss. Exact model sizes, data scale, and gains are not given in the abstract, but the multi-family setup suggests the effect is not a one-off artifact.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接改你对“高分合成 CoT 就该拿来蒸馏”的 prior；先看机制分析和 ablation，若 setup 干净，内部数据筛选准则要立刻加一条 style-distance。
recommendation.en: This should update the prior that high-reward synthetic CoT is automatically good distillation data; read the mechanism and ablations first, and add a style-distance filter if the setup is clean.

paper.title: Fast Speech Foundation Model Distillation Using Interleaved Stacking
paper.abstract: Distilling a large speech foundation model (SFM) into an efficient student model has been successfully applied to low-resource environments. Although distillation reduces inference latency, it requires an additional student model training. However, the training efficiency of SFM distillation remains underexplored. In this work, we explore training acceleration of SFM distillation to speed up model deployment. We examine the potential of stacking, in which the model depth is progressively increas

summary.core_problem: 解决语音基础模型蒸馏中 student 训练过慢的问题，目标是在不明显掉点的前提下加速蒸馏训练。
summary.importance: 这不是 LLM 核心论文，但它讨论了 foundation model 蒸馏中的训练加速 recipe，尤其是 progressive stacking 在层语义强依赖场景下为何会掉点，对做语音 LM 或一般大模型蒸馏的人有一点工程启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者研究 stacking 式训练加速，并提出 interleaved stacking：在逐步增加模型深度时保持层位置的一致性，避免传统 stacking 打乱 layer-specific knowledge 的承载位置。核心判断是语音基础模型各层功能分化更强，因此层位置信息不能随意重排。
summary.experiments: 在 SUPERB 上验证，摘要声称相比已有 stacking 方法能在保持性能的同时提升训练效率。由于任务主要是 speech foundation model distillation，且实验平台与语言模型差异较大，结论更适合作为训练 recipe 线索，而不是直接迁移到文本 LLM 的结论。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自韩国 IPAI 和 AIIS。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the slow student training problem in speech foundation model distillation, aiming to accelerate distillation without clear performance loss.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core LLM paper, but it studies a training-speed recipe for foundation-model distillation. In particular, it asks why progressive stacking hurts when layer semantics are strongly position-dependent, which gives some engineering signal for speech LMs and possibly broader model distillation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper studies stacking-based training acceleration and proposes interleaved stacking: as model depth is progressively increased, layer positions are preserved to avoid disrupting layer-specific knowledge. The key claim is that speech foundation models have stronger layer specialization, so layer position should not be arbitrarily reshuffled.
summary_en.experiments: The method is validated on SUPERB, and the abstract claims better training efficiency than prior stacking methods while preserving performance. Since the setting is speech foundation model distillation and the evaluation regime differs substantially from text LLMs, the result should be treated as a recipe hint rather than a directly transferable conclusion.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from IPAI and AIIS in Korea.

recommendation.zh: 偏语音蒸馏工程，但“层位置不能乱动”这个观察值得记一下；只看方法和 ablation，别把 SUPERB 上的结论直接套到文本 LLM。
recommendation.en: Mostly a speech-distillation engineering paper, but the 'layer position matters' observation is worth noting; read the method and ablations only, and do not directly transfer SUPERB conclusions to text LLMs.

paper.title: Quantifying Subliminal Behavioral Transfer Ratios in Language Model Distillation
paper.abstract: Distillation of a language model intended to transfer benign behavior to a student model may also transfer undesirable characteristics, if they are present in the teacher model, a phenomenon known as subliminal learning. While qualitative evidence supports the existence of this effect, its magnitude has not been systematically characterized. This study quantifies subliminal behavioral transfer ratios by steering two teacher models (Llama-2-7B-Chat and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct) at varying steering str

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是 distillation 里的一个安全问题：如果 teacher 模型被轻度到中度地“去拒答化”，学生模型在只看表面无害数据的情况下，会有多大比例把这种有害行为倾向一起学过去。已有工作已经说明 subliminal learning 存在，但缺的是量化曲线：teacher 的行为被破坏多少，student 会转移多少；这种转移是平滑增长、阈值式跃迁，还是强依赖模型家族。作者把这个问题具体化为“subliminal behavioral transfer ratio”的测量。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身是间接相关，对 post-train、distillation、模型供应链安全更直接。它的价值不在提出新的蒸馏算法，而在给出一个可复现实验框架，去测量 teacher 行为偏移如何通过 benign-only distillation 渗入 student。对基座研究员的启发主要有两点。第一，模型行为不是只靠显式训练样本内容传递，生成分布中的细微风格和拒答边界也会被 imitation 学走。第二，这种转移可能存在明显的 family-dependent scaling，这意味着“同样的 teacher compromise 强度”不能简单外推到别的模型族。
summary.technical_approach:
方法设计比较直接，但控制变量做得较清楚。作者选了两个 7B chat/instruct teacher：Llama-2-7B-Chat 和 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct。先按照 refusal-direction 相关工作的方法，构造 harmful / harmless 对比数据集，在每层最后 token 的 residual hidden state 上取均值差，得到 refusal direction。Llama 选第 15 层方向，Qwen 选第 18 层方向，并在一段连续层范围内注入该方向：Llama 在 10-17 层，Qwen 在 9-16 层。通过负的 steering coefficient α 抑制 refusal，实验用 α∈{-0.05,-0.10,-0.15,-0.20,-0.25}。

接着，为了隔离“隐性转移”而不是“训练数据直接污染”，作者只从 benign 数据里采样 1000 个 prompt，来自 Mechanistic Anomaly Detection 数据集的 normal_benign_train split。teacher 在不同 steering 强度下对这些 benign prompt 生成回答，使用 greedy decoding，过滤掉重复和生成失败样本，只保留表面无害的 teacher 输出作为蒸馏语料。然后用这些数据对 student 做 imitation-style distillation / SFT，使 student 从未直接见过 jailbreak 或 harmful prompt。

最后，用 100 个 JailbreakBench prompt 测 student 的安全退化程度，评估器是 GPT-4.1。作者把 teacher 的安全退化与 student 的安全退化做比值，定义 transfer ratio τ，用它来刻画“teacher 被破坏 1 单位，student 学走多少”。这个框架的优点是把三个环节拆开：可控地破坏 teacher、只用 benign 数据蒸馏、再在独立 harmful benchmark 上测 student，从而尽量把因果链收紧。
summary.experiments:
核心结果是两种不同的 scaling 形态。Llama-2 家族表现出较明显的阈值效应：当 steering 强度超过大约 α≈-0.15 后，transfer ratio τ 会跳到约 0.25-0.32 的区间，说明在较弱 compromise 下隐性转移有限，但一旦 teacher 的 refusal 被压到某个程度，student 会开始稳定继承这类退化。Qwen2.5 则更接近平滑且更高的转移曲线，τ 最高可到 0.61，表示 teacher 行为偏移有更大比例渗入 student。

从实验设计看，作者使用 148 个 harmful 和 165 个 harmless prompt 来提取 refusal direction；蒸馏数据来自 1000 个 benign prompt；安全评测使用 100 个 JailbreakBench prompt，并由 GPT-4.1 作为 judge。摘要和正文片段里没有给出更细的 student 训练超参、模型大小变化或完整误差条信息，因此能确认的重点是趋势而不是精确绝对值。

如果把结果翻成更工程化的话：同样是 7B teacher、同样是 benign-only distillation，隐性行为转移既不是零，也不是统一常数。它可能在某些模型族里呈现“过了某个点才明显泄漏”，在另一些模型族里则从较小 compromise 就持续累积。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先看 Introduction 和 Methodology，把作者如何定义 transfer ratio、如何避免直接数据污染弄明白。这里是整篇文章最重要的部分，因为如果 benign-only 控制不严，所谓 subliminal transfer 就会和普通数据污染混在一起。

然后看 refusal direction 的提取与注入细节，包括为什么选特定层、为什么在一段层区间内施加 steering。再看主结果图，重点不是某个单点数值，而是 Llama 的 threshold-like 曲线和 Qwen 的 smoother/higher curve 这两个形态差异。

最后快速看评测设置，尤其是 GPT-4.1 judge 和 JailbreakBench 的使用方式，确认它测的是 harmful compliance 而不是别的能力退化。若只打算花 15-25 分钟，读 Introduction、Methodology、主结果图和讨论部分即可。若要深挖，优先检查数据过滤规则、student 训练细节以及 transfer ratio 的具体定义是否对 judge 偏差敏感。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a safety question in distillation: if a teacher model is behaviorally compromised by suppressing its refusal tendency, how much of that compromised behavior transfers to a student trained only on superficially benign data? Prior work established the existence of subliminal learning, but not its scaling law. The missing piece is quantitative: how transfer varies with the degree of teacher compromise, whether the curve is smooth or thresholded, and whether the pattern depends on model family.
summary_en.importance: This is more relevant to post-training and model-supply-chain safety than to core pretraining, but it still matters for foundation-model researchers. The main lesson is that behavioral properties can transfer through the teacher’s output distribution even when the training corpus contains no explicit harmful examples. A second useful point is that transfer is family-dependent. The same intervention strength on the teacher does not imply the same downstream risk across model families, which argues against treating distillation safety as a simple data-filtering problem.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The setup is controlled and fairly clean. The authors use two 7B instruction-tuned teachers: Llama-2-7B-Chat and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. They first extract a refusal direction using a contrastive harmful-vs-harmless prompt set, following prior work on linear refusal features in the residual stream. For Llama they select layer 15 as the most separable direction; for Qwen they select layer 18. During generation, they inject the direction across a band of layers: 10-17 for Llama and 9-16 for Qwen. Negative steering coefficients suppress refusal, with α in {-0.05, -0.10, -0.15, -0.20, -0.25}.

To isolate subliminal transfer from direct contamination, they sample 1,000 benign prompts from the normal_benign_train split of the Mechanistic Anomaly Detection dataset. Teachers generate responses to these benign prompts under each steering strength using greedy decoding. Repetitive or failed generations are filtered out, and only benign-looking outputs are retained as distillation data. The student is then trained by imitation on this benign-only teacher data, without ever seeing jailbreak or harmful prompts during training.

Evaluation is performed on 100 JailbreakBench prompts, with GPT-4.1 as the judge. The key metric is a transfer ratio τ that relates the teacher’s behavioral degradation to the student’s degradation. This gives a direct way to ask: for one unit of teacher compromise, how much harmful behavioral tendency is inherited by the student? The strength of the design is the separation of three stages: controlled teacher compromise, benign-only distillation, and independent harmful evaluation.
summary_en.experiments:
The main result is that transfer is robust but scales differently by model family. Llama-2 shows a threshold-like pattern: once steering passes roughly α≈-0.15, the transfer ratio rises into the τ=0.25-0.32 range. That suggests limited transfer under mild compromise, followed by a more stable leakage regime after the teacher’s refusal behavior is sufficiently weakened. Qwen2.5 shows a smoother and larger transfer curve, with τ reaching as high as 0.61.

The experimental ingredients are: 148 harmful and 165 harmless prompts for refusal-direction extraction, 1,000 benign prompts for teacher-data generation, and 100 JailbreakBench prompts for downstream safety evaluation. Based on the provided full-text excerpt, the strongest evidence is about the qualitative scaling shape and the magnitude range of τ, rather than fine-grained absolute calibration. The paper appears more focused on characterizing transfer behavior than on exhaustive training ablations.

In practical terms, the result says that benign-only distillation does not guarantee benign-only behavioral inheritance. The leakage is neither zero nor a universal constant. In one family it looks thresholded; in another it accumulates more continuously and more strongly.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with the introduction and methodology. The most important thing to verify is how the paper separates subliminal transfer from ordinary data contamination. If that control is weak, the whole claim becomes much less interesting.

Then read the refusal-direction extraction and steering details, especially the layer choice and the multi-layer injection range. After that, go straight to the main results figure and focus on the shape difference: threshold-like transfer in Llama versus smoother and larger transfer in Qwen. That contrast is the main empirical takeaway.

Finally, skim the evaluation section to understand how GPT-4.1 judging is used on JailbreakBench and what exactly counts as harmful compliance. If you have 15-25 minutes, the introduction, methodology, main results, and discussion are enough. If you want to dig deeper, inspect the filtering rules for benign teacher outputs, the student training recipe, and whether the transfer-ratio definition is sensitive to judge noise.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验设计和迁移曲线即可；GPT-4.1 judge 有噪声，但“良性蒸馏数据不等于干净信号”这个 prior 应该收紧。
recommendation.en: Read the setup and transfer curves; the GPT-4.1 judge is noisy, but it usefully tightens the prior that benign distillation data is not necessarily clean signal.

paper.title: Itô maps for any-step SDEs
paper.abstract: Recent one-step generative models accelerate sampling by learning deterministic flow maps of the underlying dynamics. These methods rely on learning from ordinary differential equations, leaving open how to define an exact distillation procedure for stochastic dynamics. We introduce the Itô map, an any-step stochastic flow map that takes an intermediate state and Brownian path and predicts future states in a single pass. The Itô map formulation yields novel estimators for inference-time control

summary.core_problem: 如何为随机动力学（SDEs）定义一种精确的蒸馏过程，以实现任意步长的随机流映射？
summary.importance: 提出了Itô map，这是一种任意步长的随机流映射，能够单次预测未来状态，为推理时控制和后验采样提供了新的、可微的估计器，扩展了生成模型的采样和控制能力。
summary.technical_approach: 引入Itô map，它接受中间状态和布朗路径，并在单次传递中预测未来状态。这种公式为推理时控制产生了新的估计器，提供了对后验样本的廉价、可微的访问。
summary.experiments: 在合成和图像生成基准测试中，Itô maps从固定的中间状态产生了多样化、有条件有效的端点样本，并支持强大的转向（steering）性能。
summary.authors_note: Michael S. Albergo (NYU / Flatiron Institute) 等人参与，该团队在 Flow Matching 和随机生成模型方面有深厚积累。

summary_en.core_problem: How to define an exact distillation procedure for stochastic dynamics (SDEs) to enable any-step stochastic flow mapping?
summary_en.importance: Introduces the Itô map, an any-step stochastic flow map that predicts future states in a single pass, providing novel, differentiable estimators for inference-time control and posterior sampling, expanding the sampling and control capabilities of generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the Itô map, which takes an intermediate state and a Brownian path and predicts future states in a single pass. This formulation yields novel estimators for inference-time control by providing cheap, differentiable access to posterior samples.
summary_en.experiments: Empirically, Itô maps produce diverse, conditionally valid endpoint samples from fixed intermediate states and support strong steering performance on synthetic and image-generation benchmarks.
summary_en.authors_note: Co-authored by Michael S. Albergo (NYU / Flatiron Institute), whose team has deep expertise in Flow Matching and stochastic generative models.

recommendation.zh: 将 Flow Matching 的单步蒸馏扩展到了随机动力学（SDE），提出了 Itô map，对于关注 Diffusion/Flow 语言建模范式演进的研究员有启发，值得看其数学构造。
recommendation.en: Extends one-step distillation of Flow Matching to stochastic dynamics (SDEs) with the proposed Itô map; inspiring for researchers tracking the evolution of Diffusion/Flow language modeling paradigms, worth checking its mathematical formulation.

paper.title: K-Forcing: Joint Next-K-Token Decoding via Push-Forward Language Modeling
paper.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) language modeling is the dominant paradigm for text generation, yet its sequential token-by-token decoding makes inference memory-bound and inefficient. Existing acceleration approaches, such as speculative decoding and diffusion language models, can yield speedups under certain conditions but do not directly address high-load batch serving--the scenario most critical for industrial-scale deployment. We introduce K-Forcing, a push-forward language modeling paradigm for joint

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“如何把单次请求延迟再压一点”，而是更难也更贴近工业部署的问题：在高负载 batch serving 下，能否仅通过统计建模方式的改变，让一次前向稳定地产出多个 token，从而减少解码步数、提高吞吐，同时尽量保住 AR teacher 的生成质量。作者指出，现有两条主线都不完全适合这个场景：speculative decoding 的接受长度是随机的，会打乱 batch 内不同请求的步调，带来 ragged tensor、KV cache 对齐和重排开销；diffusion LM 虽然也能多 token 生成，但通常是按位置边缘分布逐步去噪，不直接建模 next-k 的联合条件分布，因此往往需要多轮 refinement，前向次数并没有真正降下来。K-Forcing 的核心问题因此被表述为：给定历史前缀，如何学习一个条件 push-forward map，把独立噪声一次性映射成未来 k 个 token 的联合样本，并且输出长度固定、架构上尽量复用 AR 模型基础设施。
summary.importance: 对预训练与生成建模研究，这篇工作的意义主要有三层。第一，它把“推理加速”从系统层和 kernel 层，往统计建模层推进了一步：不是优化每一步，而是减少步数本身。第二，它提出的 fixed-length joint decoding 对 batch serving 很关键，因为工业吞吐瓶颈往往不是单请求 latency，而是大 batch 下的内存带宽与调度效率；这一点和很多只看交互式场景的加速论文不同。第三，它给出了一条介于 AR 与 diffusion/parallel decoding 之间的新路径：仍然保留因果骨干和 teacher-forcing 训练接口，但学习的是联合 next-k 采样器，而不是逐 token 条件分布。贡献量级上，它不是替代 AR 预训练范式的成熟答案，质量仍有可见退化，k 也还不大；但它清楚地证明了“仅靠建模改变，就能在 batch serving 中拿到接近 3x 的吞吐收益”这一点，这对后续多 token 生成、联合采样、AR distillation、甚至 unified serving-friendly LM 设计都有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是把 next-k token 生成写成一个隐式生成模型。给定前缀 x_{1:t}，模型不再显式输出 p(x_{t+1:t+k}|x_{1:t}) 的完整联合分布，而是接收一组独立噪声变量 u_{1:k}（文中使用独立 uniform noise），通过一个条件映射 F_theta(x_{1:t}, u_{1:k}) 直接生成 k 个离散 token。这个“push-forward”视角的关键好处是：不需要显式参数化巨大而复杂的联合分布，也不需要像 diffusion 那样走多步反演，而是单步从简单基分布推到 token 序列分布。

训练上，作者不是从零训练，而是从一个预训练 AR teacher 蒸馏。难点在于：联合离散采样没有直接可微的 likelihood 目标，也不能简单做逐位置 CE。论文提出 progressive self-forcing distillation。可以把它理解为一种逐步增强条件依赖的蒸馏过程：模型学习在给定前缀和噪声的情况下，生成未来多个位置；训练时通过逐步引入模型自身已生成的 token 作为后续位置条件，缓解 exposure bias，并让模型学到 next-k 内部的联合结构，而不是只学每个位置的独立边缘。这里“self-forcing”相对 teacher forcing 的区别在于，后续位置并不总是喂真值，而是逐渐让模型对自己生成的中间结果负责。这样做的原因很直接：如果始终用真值上下文训练，多 token 联合生成时会在测试阶段出现条件分布错位；如果一开始就完全自回馈，训练又容易不稳定。progressive 设计是在稳定性和分布匹配之间取中间点。

架构上，作者强调 fully causal，并尽量复用 AR backbone 与标准 serving 基础设施。直观上，它不是做一个双向 masked model，也不是 diffusion U-Net，而是在 Transformer 因果骨干上增加适合 next-k 联合生成的头部/解码结构，使得位置编码、KV cache、causal mask、现有部署栈都还能沿用。这一点很重要，因为如果建模范式要求完全不同的 serving stack，工业落地成本会很高。论文还讨论了为什么固定长度输出是设计原则之一：它牺牲了 speculative decoding 那种“有时一次接受很多 token”的上界，但换来了 batch 内步调一致、张量规则、调度简单，这在高负载吞吐场景里反而更有利。

从方法定位看，K-Forcing 和 Medusa/Hydra 这类多头预测不同。后者通常仍服务于 AR 验证或辅助草稿，最终依赖 target model 的逐步接受机制；K-Forcing 直接把 next-k 联合采样作为主生成对象。它和 diffusion LM 的差别也不只是“步数更少”，而是建模对象不同：K-Forcing 试图直接采样联合条件分布，diffusion LM 常见实现更接近对多个位置的边缘或近似联合做迭代修正。
summary.experiments:
实验主要在 LM1B 和 OpenWebText 上进行，结论很集中：K-Forcing 在 k 取到 2 到 4 时，可以用更少前向步数换取明显吞吐提升，并呈现平滑的质量—速度折中。论文给出的代表性结果是，在低、中、高负载 batch regime 下都能获得可观加速，最高接近 3x 吞吐提升；同时，k 越大，质量退化越明显，k 较小时退化较温和，因此可以把 k 当作部署时的可调旋钮。

从实验结构看，作者不仅报告了生成质量，还专门测了 serving throughput，这一点比只报 perplexity 或离线采样指标更有说服力。论文的重点不是证明它在语言建模指标上优于 AR teacher，而是证明在真实 batch serving 约束下，固定长度 joint decoding 比 variable-length speculative acceptance 更适合吞吐优化。文中还对不同负载区间做了比较，说明收益不是只出现在某个窄场景。

消融方面，值得注意的点通常包括：是否使用 progressive self-forcing、不同 k 值、不同蒸馏设置、以及与 teacher 的质量差距如何随生成长度放大。论文主结论是，progressive self-forcing 对稳定训练和保住质量都重要；单纯做更直接的并行 token 预测，往往学不到足够好的联合结构。另一个重要观察是，生成更少 token per pass 时，质量损失下降得比吞吐收益下降更慢，因此存在实用的中间区间。参数量和数据规模方面，论文使用的是 LM1B 与 OpenWebText 级别的标准文本语料，实验目标更偏范式验证而不是超大模型冲榜；这也意味着结果更像“证明可行性”，而不是已经在 frontier-scale 上完成工程定型。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看 Introduction 和“Why Existing Approaches Struggle in Batch Serving”。这里不是铺垫，而是整篇论文最有信息量的判断：作者把 speculative decoding 在高 batch 下的问题明确落到 ragged tensor、位置不同步、KV cache 重排这些系统后果上，也把 diffusion LM 的问题明确落到“没有直接做 next-k 联合采样”上。若只看方法而不看这部分，很容易误以为 K-Forcing 只是又一种并行解码。

第二个重点是方法章节里对 push-forward formulation 和 progressive self-forcing distillation 的定义。阅读时要特别留意三个问题：一，噪声变量如何注入，是否每个位置独立；二，训练目标如何把 teacher 的 AR 分布信息转成联合采样监督；三，self-forcing 的调度方式如何避免训练—推理失配。这里决定了它到底是“多 token 分类头”还是更一般的隐式联合生成器。

第三个重点是实验中的 throughput 测量设置。要看清楚 batch size、负载区间、是否包含系统开销、比较基线是谁。若只看 speedup 数字而不看测量协议，很容易高估方法普适性。还建议重点看不同 k 的质量—速度曲线，这比单个最优点更能说明部署价值。

如果时间有限，优先看：1）问题分析图和 serving 场景示意；2）方法总览图；3）progressive self-forcing 的算法框图；4）不同负载下的 throughput 表；5）k 值消融。若要深挖，最值得追的是两个方向：一是这种 push-forward joint decoding 能否扩展到更大 k 而不明显掉质；二是能否与 speculative verification 结合，形成“固定长度联合草稿 + 轻量校正”的混合范式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific bottleneck that standard AR language modeling does not address well: high-load batch serving. The question is not merely how to shave off single-request latency, but whether one can change the statistical modeling layer so that each forward pass emits multiple future tokens in a regular, fixed-length manner, thereby reducing decoding steps and improving throughput without collapsing generation quality. The authors argue that the two main alternatives each have a structural mismatch with this setting. Speculative decoding is attractive for latency, but its variable acceptance length creates desynchronized batches, irregular tensors, and KV-cache realignment overhead. Diffusion LMs can reveal multiple tokens, but they usually rely on iterative denoising over per-position marginals or approximate factorizations, so they still require many refinement steps. K-Forcing is framed as the problem of learning a conditional push-forward map that transforms independent noise into a joint sample of the next k tokens, conditioned on the prefix, while preserving fixed-length outputs and compatibility with causal serving infrastructure.
summary_en.importance: Its importance lies less in replacing AR training outright and more in opening a new modeling direction for inference-efficient language generation. First, it moves the acceleration discussion from systems and kernels to statistical parameterization: instead of making each AR step cheaper, it reduces the number of steps. Second, the fixed-length design is directly relevant to industrial serving, where throughput under heavy batching is often more important than interactive latency. Third, it offers a middle ground between standard AR decoding and iterative non-AR paradigms such as diffusion LMs: the model still reuses a causal backbone and AR teacher supervision, but learns a joint next-k sampler rather than a one-token conditional distribution. The contribution is therefore conceptual and empirical. It does not yet look like a drop-in replacement for frontier AR models, since quality degradation remains visible and k is still small, but it demonstrates that a modeling change alone can deliver nearly 3x throughput gains in batch serving. That is a meaningful result for future work on multi-token generation, joint sampling, AR distillation, and serving-aware pretraining objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The central idea is to cast next-k generation as an implicit generative model. Given a prefix x_{1:t}, the model does not explicitly parameterize the full joint distribution p(x_{t+1:t+k} | x_{1:t}) in a tractable form. Instead, it samples a set of independent base noise variables u_{1:k} (uniform noise in the paper) and applies a conditional mapping F_theta(x_{1:t}, u_{1:k}) that directly outputs k discrete tokens. This push-forward view avoids explicit normalization over a combinatorial joint space and avoids the iterative reverse process used by diffusion models.

Training is done by distilling from a pretrained AR teacher rather than training from scratch. The main difficulty is that joint discrete sampling does not naturally admit a simple tokenwise cross-entropy objective. The paper introduces progressive self-forcing distillation. The intuition is to gradually train the model to condition not only on the prefix but also on its own partially generated outputs when producing later positions within the k-token block. This is meant to capture intra-block dependency and reduce train-test mismatch. Pure teacher forcing would expose the model only to gold intermediate context, which is misaligned with test-time joint generation. Pure self-conditioning from the start would be harder to optimize and less stable. The progressive schedule is therefore a compromise between optimization stability and distribution matching.

Architecturally, the model is fully causal and intentionally close to standard AR infrastructure. It is not a bidirectional masked LM and not a diffusion-style denoiser. The design reuses a causal Transformer backbone, along with standard positional handling, causal masking, and serving machinery, while adding the machinery needed to emit a joint k-token sample in one pass. This compatibility point matters: if the modeling gain required a completely different serving stack, the practical value would be much lower.

The paper is also careful about what makes K-Forcing different from prior multi-token methods. It is not simply a Medusa- or Hydra-style auxiliary head that proposes several tokens for later AR verification. Those methods still rely on an acceptance mechanism tied to AR decoding. K-Forcing instead treats joint next-k sampling as the primary generation object. It also differs from diffusion LMs in what it tries to model: a direct conditional joint sampler, rather than an iterative denoising process over token marginals or approximate joint states.
summary_en.experiments:
Experiments are conducted on LM1B and OpenWebText, with the main message being a clear quality-speed trade-off. For k between 2 and 4, K-Forcing reduces the number of decoding passes and yields substantial throughput gains across low-, medium-, and high-load serving regimes. The headline result is a throughput improvement of up to roughly 3x, at the cost of modest but visible degradation relative to the AR teacher. Smaller k values preserve quality better, which makes k a practical deployment knob rather than a fixed modeling choice.

A strong point of the evaluation is that it measures serving throughput directly, not just perplexity or offline generation quality. That aligns with the paper's claim: the contribution is not that K-Forcing beats AR on language modeling metrics, but that fixed-length joint decoding is better matched to throughput-oriented serving than variable-length speculative acceptance. The experiments also span different load regimes, which helps show that the gain is not confined to a narrow operating point.

The ablations appear to focus on the role of progressive self-forcing, the effect of different k values, and the quality gap to the teacher as generation proceeds. The main takeaway is that progressive self-forcing is important for both stability and quality retention; naive parallel token prediction does not learn a sufficiently good joint structure. Another useful observation is that reducing k often hurts throughput less than it helps quality, leaving a practical middle regime. In scale terms, the paper uses standard corpora such as LM1B and OpenWebText and is positioned as a proof of feasibility rather than a frontier-scale training study.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the section analyzing why existing acceleration methods struggle in batch serving. That section contains the paper's sharpest argument. The discussion of speculative decoding is valuable because it ties variable acceptance lengths to concrete systems consequences: ragged tensors, desynchronized positions, and KV-cache realignment. The discussion of diffusion LMs is equally important because it clarifies that the issue is not just speed, but the lack of direct next-k joint sampling.

Then read the method section carefully, especially the push-forward formulation and progressive self-forcing distillation. Three questions are worth tracking while reading: how the noise variables are injected, how teacher information is converted into supervision for a joint sampler, and how the self-forcing schedule mitigates train-test mismatch. Those details determine whether the method is merely a parallel prediction head or a more general implicit joint generator.

In the experiments, focus on the throughput protocol rather than only the headline speedup. Check the batch regimes, whether end-to-end serving overhead is included, and which baselines are compared. The quality-speed curves across different k values are more informative than a single best number.

If time is limited, prioritize: the problem analysis figures, the method overview, the algorithmic description of progressive self-forcing, the throughput tables under different loads, and the k ablations. The most promising follow-up questions are whether the push-forward approach can scale to larger k without severe quality loss, and whether it can be combined with lightweight verification to form a hybrid fixed-length draft-and-correct pipeline.

recommendation.zh: 应优先读方法和服务实验；若 batch-serving 下验证扎实，next-k push-forward 会改变多 token 解码的内部 ablation 设计。
recommendation.en: Read the method and serving experiments first; if the high-batch results are clean, next-k push-forward should enter internal multi-token decoding ablations.

paper.title: Density Field State Space Models: 1-Bit Distillation, Efficient Inference, and Knowledge Organization in Mamba-2
paper.abstract: We present Density Field State Space Models (DF-SSM), a framework for compressing SSMs to a 1-bit scaffold with int8 low-rank correction. Applied to Mamba-2 1.3B, we achieve a 278 MB model (9.7x smaller than the 2.7 GB FP16 teacher) that runs at 21.4x faster inference on GPU (batch=1, relative to the mamba-ssm reference implementation) while maintaining downstream task performance within 2-4 percentage points of BitMamba-2, a 1.58-bit model trained from scratch on 150B tokens. The distillation i

summary.core_problem: 尝试把 Mamba-2 这类 SSM 模型压缩到极低比特并保持可用性能，同时给出配套高效推理实现。
summary.importance: 这是一篇效率导向的压缩/部署工作，亮点在于 1-bit scaffold + int8 低秩修正和较小蒸馏成本；但作者为独立研究者，结论更适合作为工程线索而非立即采信的范式结果。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DF-SSM，将预训练 SSM 蒸馏为 1-bit 主干并配合 int8 低秩校正；推理侧结合 cuBLAS INT8 tensor cores、自定义 CUDA kernel 以及 AVX-512 CPU 后端。作者还分析压缩后模型内部出现的三阶段处理模式。
summary.experiments: 在 Mamba-2 1.3B 上，模型从 2.7GB FP16 压到 278MB，声称 GPU batch=1 推理相对参考实现快 21.4 倍；蒸馏仅用 32M tokens、单张 A100 训练 6 小时。性能上与从头训练的 1.58-bit BitMamba-2 相差 2-4 个百分点。需要注意比较基线是 reference implementation，系统优化成分较大。
summary.authors_note: 作者为独立研究者。论文同时覆盖压缩、系统实现和少量机制分析，但缺少大机构常见的大规模复现实证。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to compress Mamba-2 style SSMs to extremely low bitwidth while preserving usable performance, and to pair that with an efficient inference stack.
summary_en.importance: This is an efficiency-oriented compression/deployment paper. The interesting part is the 1-bit scaffold plus int8 low-rank correction with relatively cheap distillation, but given the independent-researcher setting, the claims are better treated as engineering signals than as settled results.
summary_en.technical_approach: DF-SSM distills a pretrained SSM into a 1-bit scaffold with int8 low-rank correction. On the systems side, it combines cuBLAS INT8 tensor cores, custom CUDA kernels, and an AVX-512 CPU backend. The paper also reports a three-phase internal processing pattern in the compressed model.
summary_en.experiments: On Mamba-2 1.3B, the model is reduced from 2.7GB FP16 to 278MB, with a claimed 21.4x GPU batch-1 speedup over the reference implementation. Distillation uses only 32M tokens and 6 hours on one A100. Performance is reported within 2-4 points of BitMamba-2, a 1.58-bit model trained from scratch. The baseline being a reference implementation means the systems component likely contributes heavily.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is an independent researcher. The paper spans compression, systems implementation, and some internal analysis, but lacks the large-scale validation typically seen in major lab work.

recommendation.zh: 把它当工程线索看，不要当定论：1-bit+低秩修正值得抄到压缩实验里，但 21x 提速多半混了实现红利，先看 baseline 是否公平。
recommendation.en: Treat this as an engineering lead, not a settled result: 1-bit plus low-rank correction is worth trying, but the 21x speedup likely mixes in implementation gains, so check baseline fairness first.

paper.title: AuRA: Internalizing Audio Understanding into LLMs as LoRA
paper.abstract: Recent efforts to extend large language models (LLMs) to speech inputs typically rely on cascaded ASR-LLM pipelines, end-to-end speech-language models, or bridge/distillation-based adaptation. While these routes respectively reuse strong pretrained components, enable native speech-language interaction, or offer lightweight adaptation, they often suffer from transcript-interface latency, costly multimodal training, or sequential speech-language coupling. To address these limitations, we present A

summary.core_problem: 解决如何在不做重型端到端语音-语言联合训练的前提下，把语音理解能力更紧地注入到 LLM 中，而不是停留在 ASR 文本接口或串行桥接方案上。
summary.importance: 这项工作的价值主要在于轻量适配思路：它不是再训练一个完整 speech-language model，而是尝试把音频表征通过 LoRA 蒸馏进 LLM 侧，属于 pretrain/post-train 接口附近的多模态适配问题。对研究员的启发在于：语音能力是否能以参数高效方式被“内化”到语言模型内部表示，而不必完全依赖外接 encoder-decoder 管线。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，AuRA 让同一段语音同时进入一个 ASR encoder 教师和一个带 LoRA 的 LLM 学生。学生侧先经过轻量 audio embedding layer，把语音映射到 LLM 可接收的表示，再做逐层 hidden-state distillation，使学生内部层表示对齐教师的语音表征。核心不是输出 token 级蒸馏，而是层间表示蒸馏，目标是把音频理解能力压进 LLM 侧的小规模增量参数中，从而减少传统 cascaded ASR→LLM 的接口割裂与时延问题。
summary.experiments: 从摘要可知，论文主要比较了 cascaded pipeline、端到端 speech-language model、以及 serial bridge/distillation 类方法，强调在更轻量训练成本下获得更紧耦合的语音理解能力。摘要未给出明确模型规模、训练数据规模和具体提升幅度，因此目前更像方法提案而非已充分定量验证的范式结论；是否成立要看正文中的 ablation、跨任务泛化和 latency/compute 对比是否干净。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自美团与吉林大学。不是语音 LM 或原生多模态预训练的一线代表团队，更像工程导向的轻量适配探索。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles how to internalize speech understanding into an LLM without relying on a heavy end-to-end speech-language model or a transcript-based ASR-to-LLM pipeline.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is a lightweight adaptation recipe rather than a new foundation model. For pretraining researchers, the interesting question is whether audio understanding can be injected into an LLM’s internal representations through parameter-efficient distillation, instead of keeping speech as an external module.
summary_en.technical_approach: AuRA feeds the same speech input to an ASR encoder teacher and a LoRA-adapted LLM student. A lightweight audio embedding layer maps speech into the student side, and layer-wise hidden-state distillation aligns student representations with teacher representations. The key idea is representation-level distillation into LLM-side LoRA modules, not just output supervision.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the method is compared against cascaded ASR-LLM pipelines, end-to-end speech-language models, and serial bridge/distillation baselines, with the claim of tighter coupling and lighter adaptation. However, the abstract does not expose model sizes, data scale, or exact gains, so the strength of the conclusion depends heavily on the full paper’s ablations, transfer tests, and latency/compute accounting.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Meituan and Jilin University. This looks more like a practical lightweight adaptation study than a flagship speech-LM pretraining effort from a leading multimodal foundation-model lab.

recommendation.zh: 更像语音接入 LLM 的轻量蒸馏工程，不会改写你对统一预训练的 prior；若你在做 speech-to-LLM adapter，只看层蒸馏设计和延迟对比即可。
recommendation.en: This is a lightweight speech-to-LLM distillation recipe, not a prior-changing multimodal pretraining result; read it only if you care about adapter design and latency trade-offs.

paper.title: Mean Flow Distillation: Robust and Stable Distillation for Flow Matching Models
paper.abstract: Flow Matching models have demonstrated strong performance across a wide range of generative tasks. However, their reliance on ODE-based iterative sampling incurs substantial computational overhead in inference, which limits their applicability in real-time scenes. While distillation is a promising solution, existing approaches largely borrow from diffusion-based score matching, often failing to exploit the intrinsic geometric structure of flows and suffering from training instability, high varia

summary.core_problem: Flow Matching模型依赖ODE迭代采样导致推理计算开销大，现有蒸馏方法借用扩散的VSD技术存在训练不稳定、高方差和生成质量下降问题
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出Mean Flow Distillation(MFD)，专门适配Flow Matching的几何结构，证明了Mean Flow Matching定理
summary.technical_approach: MFD作为时域低通滤波器抑制VSD中的高频优化噪声，同时保证全局轨迹一致性；证明匹配期望平均速度足以恢复最优学生轨迹；提供理论分析和算法设计
summary.experiments: 在多个生成任务上对比VSD等现有蒸馏方法，验证训练稳定性和生成质量的提升

summary_en.core_problem: Flow Matching models suffer from high inference computational cost due to ODE iterative sampling; existing distillation methods borrowed from diffusion VSD have training instability, high variance, and quality degradation
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: Mean Flow Distillation (MFD) tailored to flow geometry, with theoretical proof of Mean Flow Matching Theorem
summary_en.technical_approach: MFD acts as temporal low-pass filter suppressing high-frequency optimization noise in VSD while ensuring global trajectory consistency; proves matching expected average velocities suffices to recover optimal student trajectory
summary_en.experiments: Compares against VSD and other distillation methods across generative tasks, validating training stability and generation quality improvements

recommendation.zh: Flow Matching蒸馏的理论工作，对图像生成有意义，但对LLM文本建模范式启发有限，仅作为文献备查
recommendation.en: Theoretical work on Flow Matching distillation, relevant for generative modeling but limited LLM pretraining insight; keep as literature reference

paper.title: TinyJudge: Unverifiable Constraint Alignment via Lightweight Specialist Ensembles
paper.abstract: Instruction Following (IF) is a core capability of LLMs, requiring strict adherence to diverse constraints, ranging from verifiable ones (e.g., output length) to unverifiable ones (e.g., tone). Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has emerged as a paradigm for IF tasks, leveraging LLM-as-a-judge to assess unverifiable constraints. However, we empirically find that this approach remains a significant bottleneck, suffering from severe reward hacking and higher computational overhead. In

summary.core_problem: TinyJudge 解决的是 RLVR 做复杂指令遵循时，软约束奖励信号不可靠且代价高的问题。当前常用做法是用强 LLM-as-a-judge 同时判断多个不可程序验证的约束，例如语气、风格、礼貌程度。论文指出这种单一 judge 容易漏判违规，奖励 precision 低，并且会把训练时间显著拉长。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值在于 post-train 信号质量。它不是预训练方法论文，但对 RL/SFT 如何稳定地塑造模型行为有启发：复杂人类约束不一定适合交给一个大 judge 做整体打分，拆成约束级专家反而可能给出更干净的奖励。这个观察也提醒基座研究员，后训练阶段的能力提升有时受限于 reward channel，而不是策略模型容量。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是把不可验证约束拆开评估。作者先分析不同软约束的泛化能力，发现部分约束具有较高的跨任务泛化模式。TinyJudge 只为这些高泛化软约束训练小型专用 judge，规模约 0.6B。每个小 judge 从 frontier model 蒸馏对应约束的判断能力，只负责一个或一类约束，而不是做全局多约束裁判。训练时采用混合奖励模块：硬约束由代码规则验证，软约束由对应 tiny specialist 评估。策略优化使用 GRPO，通过同一 instruction 下多个 response 的组内相对奖励估计 advantage。
summary.experiments: 训练数据使用 VerInstruct，共 22,000 条，其中软约束占 77.7%，硬约束占 22.3%。论文在 5 个 instruction-following benchmark 上评估，包括 IFEval 和 CFBench。TinyJudge 相比 base model 约有 10% 性能提升，并优于若干 LLM judge reward baseline。奖励侧，TinyJudge 相比大模型 judge 的 reward precision 提升约 12%。效率侧，单条 response 的 judge latency 提升约 6 倍，总训练时间约降低 3 倍；整体计算开销接近只训练硬约束奖励的设置。先导实验还指出，直接使用 frontier LLM 作为 reward model 会带来约 3 倍训练时间开销，并且在多约束同时评估时倾向于忽略违规。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。重点看 Section 3 的 pilot experiments，尤其是 LLM-as-a-judge 的 reward bias 分析，这是论文最有用的部分。然后看 TinyJudge 的约束拆分和 specialist distillation 设计，关注它如何选择高泛化约束，以及 hard rule reward 与 soft judge reward 如何合成。实验部分优先看 reward precision、latency、training time 的表格；IF benchmark 分数可以作为次要参考。

summary_en.core_problem: TinyJudge targets a practical bottleneck in RLVR for instruction following: rewards for unverifiable constraints are often noisy and expensive. The common setup asks a strong LLM judge to evaluate multiple soft constraints at once, such as tone, style, or politeness. The paper shows that this monolithic judging setup tends to miss violations and adds substantial training overhead.
summary_en.importance: The paper is most relevant as a study of post-training signal quality. It is not a pretraining method paper, but it gives a useful lesson for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface: complex human constraints may be better handled by decomposed, constraint-level reward models than by one large general judge. For foundation model researchers, the key point is that behavior improvement can be limited by reward precision and latency, not only by policy model scale.
summary_en.technical_approach: TinyJudge decomposes unverifiable constraint evaluation. The authors first analyze generalization patterns across soft constraints and find that some constraints generalize much better than others. They then train lightweight specialist judges, around 0.6B parameters, each distilled from frontier models for a specific high-generalization constraint. During RL training, the reward module is hybrid: verifiable hard constraints are checked by deterministic code rules, while soft constraints are scored by the corresponding tiny specialists. Policy optimization uses GRPO, where multiple responses are sampled for the same instruction and advantages are computed from within-group relative rewards.
summary_en.experiments: The training data is VerInstruct with 22,000 examples: 77.7% soft constraints and 22.3% hard constraints. Evaluation covers five instruction-following benchmarks, including IFEval and CFBench. TinyJudge improves the base model by roughly 10% and outperforms several LLM-judge reward baselines. On reward quality, it improves reward precision by about 12% over LLM-based reward systems. On efficiency, it gives a 6x speedup in judging latency per response and reduces total training time by about 3x. The pilot study also reports that using a frontier LLM directly as the reward model introduces about 3x training-time overhead and suffers from missed violations when multiple constraints are judged jointly.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Start with the pilot experiments in Section 3; the analysis of reward bias in LLM-as-a-judge is the most useful part. Then read the method sections on constraint decomposition and specialist distillation. In the experiments, prioritize the tables on reward precision, judging latency, and training time. The benchmark score tables are useful but less central than the reward-quality analysis.

recommendation.zh: 值得看，但别把它当通用 judge 范式突破；重点读 reward hacking 对比和 specialist 拆分是否真有 clean margin，若成立，内部 RL 奖励器应立刻试小模型专科化。
recommendation.en: Worth reading, but not as a universal judge breakthrough; focus on the reward-hacking ablations and whether specialist decomposition creates a genuinely cleaner margin—if yes, small specialist reward models should be tried in internal RL pipelines.

institutions: Harbin Institute of Technology SCIR Lab

paper.title: Breaking the Tokenizer Barrier: On-Policy Distillation across Model Families
paper.abstract: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) has become a core technique in the post-training of Large Language Models (LLMs) for transferring knowledge from domain experts to student models. However, existing OPD distillation methods require teacher and student models to share the same tokenizer, restricting the applicability of OPD within the model series. Current mainstream practice typically employs Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on teacher-generated responses for cross-tokenizer distillation, which fails to

summary.core_problem: 解决 on-policy distillation 依赖师生共享 tokenizer 的限制，使不同模型家族之间也能传递 token-level 教师分布信号。
summary.importance: 这项工作虽然属于后训练，但对基座研究员很有接口价值：它直接触及 tokenizer 作为知识迁移边界的问题，并给出跨 tokenizer 的 OPD 方案。若结论可靠，会影响 teacher-student 选择空间、蒸馏管线设计，以及未来统一 tokenizer/异构 tokenizer 的取舍。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出跨 tokenizer 的 on-policy distillation，通过精确 token mapping 算法把教师分布对齐到学生词表，从而保留标准 OPD 的 token-level 概率监督，而不是退化成 teacher-generated responses 上的 SFT。核心创新点在于跨词表概率信号传播，而非简单数据蒸馏。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多种 benchmark 上比较 cross-tokenizer OPD 与基于教师回答的 SFT 等基线，结论是前者更省算力且效果更好。未在摘要中给出具体模型规模和提升幅度，但实验主张是：跨家族蒸馏不必再受 tokenizer 绑定。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper removes the shared-tokenizer requirement in on-policy distillation, enabling token-level teacher supervision across different model families.
summary_en.importance: Although this is a post-training paper, it has a strong interface to foundation-model research: it directly treats the tokenizer as a bottleneck for knowledge transfer and proposes a way around it. If the result holds, it changes how we think about teacher-student pairing, distillation pipelines, and the trade-off between unified and heterogeneous tokenizers.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose cross-tokenizer on-policy distillation, using a precise token-mapping algorithm to align the teacher distribution to the student vocabulary so that standard OPD can still use token-level probability signals. This avoids collapsing cross-family distillation into plain SFT on teacher-generated responses. The key novelty is probability transfer across vocabularies, not just response-level data distillation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract says the method is compared against baselines such as SFT on teacher outputs across multiple benchmarks, and that cross-tokenizer OPD is both more compute-efficient and more effective. The abstract does not provide model sizes or exact gains, but the main empirical claim is that cross-family distillation need not be constrained by tokenizer compatibility.

recommendation.zh: 值得看，因为它把 tokenizer 从“蒸馏前提”改成“可跨越接口”；先查 token mapping 是否严格保概率质量，再决定要不要复现。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it turns tokenizer compatibility from a hard prerequisite into an interface problem; first inspect whether the token mapping really preserves probability mass before reproducing.

paper.title: SG-OPD: Sign-Gated On-Policy Distillation via Sign-Consistency Gating and Phased Teacher Sampling
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own trajectories with dense per-token supervision from a stronger teacher, and often outperforms off-policy distillation and standard reinforcement learning. However, we find that its effectiveness implicitly relies on two assumptions that frequently break in practice: trajectory-level alignment between the student and the teacher, and uniform token-level reliability of the teacher's preferences. We therefore propose Sign-Gated On-Policy Disti

summary.core_problem: On-policy distillation (OPD) 依赖两个在实践中经常不成立的隐含假设——学生与教师轨迹对齐、教师 token 级偏好可靠——导致效果下降。
summary.importance: 方法创新：首次系统分析 OPD 的隐含失效假设，并提出基于二分类验证器(verifier)作为教师可信度信号的双层门控机制，在数学推理 benchmark 上超越标准 OPD。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SG-OPD，用二分类验证器在两个互补粒度上做教师可信度门控：(1) phased teacher sampling 在冷启动阶段混入验证器认可的教师轨迹；(2) sign-consistency gate 在教师与验证器方向一致时外推 distillation 更新、不一致时内插。
summary.experiments: 在竞赛级数学推理 benchmark 上进行实验，SG-OPD 一致超越标准 OPD。（摘要未给出具体模型规模和提升幅度）
summary.authors_note: 作者来自国内高校/研究院，作者名单中未发现业内知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: On-policy distillation (OPD) implicitly relies on two frequently violated assumptions—trajectory-level student-teacher alignment and uniform token-level teacher reliability—leading to degraded performance.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: first systematic analysis of OPD's implicit failure assumptions, proposes a dual-gating mechanism using a binary verifier as teacher trust signal, outperforms standard OPD on math reasoning benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: SG-OPD uses a binary verifier as trust signal at two granularities: (1) phased teacher sampling mixes verifier-endorsed teacher rollouts during cold-start; (2) sign-consistency gate extrapolates distillation updates where teacher agrees with verifier-correct direction and interpolates where it disagrees.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments on competition-level mathematical reasoning benchmarks show SG-OPD consistently outperforms standard OPD. (Specific model sizes and improvement margins not given in abstract.)
summary_en.authors_note: Authors from Chinese universities/research institutes; no widely recognized researchers identified in the author list.

recommendation.zh: OPD 是后训练的重要范式，这篇文章指出了其隐含失效假设并提出基于 verifier 的门控，核心 insight 值得关注，但实验规模不够大，读 §3 和 §4 即可。
recommendation.en: OPD is an important post-training paradigm; this paper identifies its implicit failure assumptions and proposes verifier-based gating. Core insight is worth noting, but experiment scale is modest—read §3 and §4 only.

paper.title: Characterize Then Distill: Mechanistic Reasoning in Large Output Spaces
paper.abstract: Modern reasoning models offer surprisingly strong zero-shot performance on challenging multi-label tasks that require selecting a small set of relevant options from hundreds of thousands to millions of candidate labels. We investigate how they achieve this mechanistically. We characterize reasoning as a two-phase process: A broad "shortlisting" of candidates followed by fine-grained reasoning over the resulting set. We provide evidence across a range of datasets that these steps can be isolated

summary.core_problem: 研究推理型大模型在超大标签空间的多标签选择任务中，如何从数十万到数百万候选标签里零样本找出少量相关选项。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是机制分析和蒸馏方法：把大输出空间推理拆成“粗粒度候选短名单生成”和“短名单内精细判断”两阶段，并据此改进蒸馏。它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对理解推理模型如何处理大动作空间有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先通过多数据集实验隔离 shortlisting 与 fine-grained reasoning 两个过程，验证二者互补；随后设计 mechanistic distillation，让学生模型显式学习教师模型的候选缩减与后续判断，而不是只拟合最终标签。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在一系列需要从数十万到数百万候选标签中选择少量标签的数据集上验证两阶段机制，并且该蒸馏策略稳定优于标准蒸馏；未给出模型规模、具体数据集数量或提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Northeastern University Khoury College of Computer Sciences；Byron C. Wallace 长期从事 NLP、信息抽取和证据建模相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how modern reasoning models solve multi-label tasks with extremely large output spaces, where only a small subset must be selected from hundreds of thousands or millions of labels.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a mechanism-level characterization plus a distillation recipe: reasoning over large label spaces is decomposed into broad shortlisting followed by fine-grained reasoning. This is not pretraining work, but it is relevant to how reasoning models handle large action or label spaces.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors empirically separate the shortlisting and fine-grained reasoning phases across several datasets, show that the phases are complementary, and then distill the teacher by making the student imitate this internal two-stage behavior rather than only the final outputs.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments on multiple large-output-space multi-label datasets, with candidate spaces ranging from hundreds of thousands to millions. The proposed mechanistic distillation consistently outperforms standard distillation, but the abstract does not specify model sizes or exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Northeastern University's Khoury College of Computer Sciences. Byron C. Wallace is known for NLP work on information extraction and evidence modeling.

recommendation.zh: 不是基座训练论文；只看两阶段 shortlisting 证据，能为大动作空间蒸馏提供一个可复现实验假设。
recommendation.en: Not a base-model training paper; read only the shortlisting evidence, which gives a testable hypothesis for distilling large action spaces.

institutions: Khoury College of Computer Sciences, Northeastern University

paper.title: ViCuR: Visual Cues as Recoverable Privilege for Multimodal On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves reasoning by training a student on trajectories sampled from its own policy under supervision from a teacher. In multimodal reasoning, a common extension is to use a privileged teacher that observes training-time-only signals such as reference answers or rationales. However, such answer-side privilege creates a train-test mismatch: the teacher's supervision may depend on signals unavailable to the student, encouraging shortcut imitation rather than visually

summary.core_problem: ViCuR 解决的是多模态 on-policy distillation 中 privileged teacher 的信号选择问题。已有方法常把参考答案、rationale 或反馈作为 teacher 的额外输入，但这些 answer-side privilege 在推理时不可恢复，学生容易模仿答案相关捷径，而不是学习从图像或视频中找证据。
summary.importance: 这篇工作和预训练的关系在于 post-train 信号质量与多模态推理能力的接口。它提醒一个关键点：teacher 更强不一定来自更多答案信息，也可以来自更好的证据提示。对 VLM 的 SFT/RL/OPD 训练来说，可恢复的视觉证据比不可恢复的答案侧信息更接近测试时分布，因而更适合作为训练时 privilege。这个思路也能反馈到预训练数据设计：多模态数据不只要有答案，还要有可定位、可恢复、可验证的视觉证据。
summary.technical_approach: ViCuR 将 teacher 的额外条件从答案或 rationale 换成 visual cues，即由图像/视频和问题派生的任务相关视觉证据描述。cue 文本只在训练时给 teacher，但 cue 的来源仍在学生推理时可见的视觉输入中，因此降低了 privilege-induced train-test mismatch。学生端没有显式 cue 输入，所以作者加入轻量 cue recovery module：在若干 Transformer 层放置一个指定 sink token，并配套专门的 cross-attention 参数。prefill 阶段，这个 token 从视觉 token 中聚合与任务相关的信息，形成内部 cue-level representation。该模块只通过 distillation objective 端到端训练，不改变推理接口，也不增加自回归生成开销。方法既可用于同 backbone 的 privileged-teacher self-distillation，也可用于更强 teacher 的 OPD；模型规模优势和 privilege 设计被视为正交因素。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Qwen3-VL-2B 和 Qwen3-VL-8B 学生，在七个多模态推理 benchmark 上评测。相较 answer-based OPSD，ViCuR 的平均性能分别提升 +1.19 和 +1.24，在域内和近域数学推理任务上增益更明显。在 stronger-teacher OPD 设置下，ViCuR 相比 OPD baseline 进一步提升 +0.64 和 +1.08；8B 规模下还表现出更稳定的域外收益。实验结论支持作者的核心假设：视觉 cue 作为可恢复 privilege，比答案侧 privilege 更少诱导 shortcut imitation，也更容易转化为学生推理时可用的视觉证据获取能力。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 25–35 分钟。重点看 §3.1 对 privilege-induced mismatch 的形式化说明，这是方法成立的关键；再看 §3.2–§3.4 的 cue recovery module、训练目标和 OPD/OPSD 设置。实验部分优先看七个 benchmark 的平均结果、2B/8B 规模对比、answer-based OPSD 对照，以及 stronger-teacher OPD 结果。若时间有限，架构图和消融表比具体 benchmark 描述更值得看。

summary_en.core_problem: ViCuR studies what kind of privileged information should be given to a teacher in multimodal on-policy distillation. Existing methods often condition the teacher on reference answers, rationales, or feedback. Such answer-side privilege is unavailable at inference time, so the student can learn to imitate answer-aware shortcuts instead of grounding its reasoning in the visual input.
summary_en.importance: The paper is relevant to the interface between post-training signals and multimodal pretraining objectives. Its main lesson is that a stronger teacher should not rely on information the student can never recover at test time. Visual evidence is a better privileged signal than answer-side information when the goal is grounded reasoning. This also informs multimodal data design: training examples should expose recoverable and verifiable evidence, not only final answers or polished rationales.
summary_en.technical_approach: ViCuR replaces answer-based privilege with visual cues: question-relevant evidence derived from the same image or video available to the student at inference. The cue text is only given to the teacher during training, but its source remains present in the standard visual-question input. This reduces the train-test mismatch induced by inaccessible privileged variables. Since the student does not receive cues explicitly, the method adds a lightweight cue recovery module. A designated sink token with dedicated cross-attention parameters is inserted at selected transformer layers. During prefill, this token aggregates task-relevant information from visual tokens into an internal cue-level representation. The module is trained end-to-end only through the distillation objective, keeps the inference interface unchanged, and adds no autoregressive decoding overhead. The same idea applies to privileged-teacher self-distillation and to stronger-teacher OPD.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Qwen3-VL-2B and Qwen3-VL-8B students across seven multimodal reasoning benchmarks. Compared with answer-based OPSD, ViCuR improves average performance by +1.19 and +1.24, with stronger gains on in-domain and near-domain mathematical reasoning tasks. In stronger-teacher OPD, it improves over OPD baselines by +0.64 and +1.08, and the 8B setting shows consistent out-of-domain gains. These results support the central claim that recoverable visual privilege is more useful for student learning than answer-side privilege.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–35 minute skim is appropriate. Focus on §3.1 for the formal treatment of privilege-induced mismatch, then read §3.2–§3.4 for the cue recovery module and the OPD/OPSD training setup. In the experiments, prioritize the average results over seven benchmarks, the 2B versus 8B comparison, the answer-based OPSD baseline, and the stronger-teacher OPD results. If time is limited, the architecture figure and ablation tables are more informative than the benchmark-by-benchmark descriptions.

recommendation.zh: 对多模态蒸馏有启发——特权信号设计思路可迁移到文本蒸馏（如用输入侧特征而非答案侧监督做on-policy蒸馏）。看方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: Instructive for multimodal distillation — the idea of using input-side recoverable privilege can be transferred to text distillation. Read the method section only.

paper.title: LoRi: Low-Rank Distillation for Implicit Reasoning
paper.abstract: Implicit chain-of-thought (iCoT) methods aim to internalize reasoning in large language models, but often underperform explicit CoT prompting. We empirically find that hidden-state reasoning trajectories exhibit low-rank structure. Motivated by this observation, we propose a low-rank distillation framework that transfers reasoning by aligning teacher and student trajectories in a shared low-rank tensor subspace using first- and second-order statistics. The resulting formulation captures the glob

summary.core_problem: LoRi 解决的是隐式 CoT 蒸馏中的轨迹对齐问题：显式 CoT 的文字步骤和学生模型的 latent reasoning states 没有天然的一一对应关系，直接做局部 token-level 或中间状态监督会丢掉教师推理过程的全局结构。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练本身不是直接贡献，更接近 post-train 阶段的 latent reasoning 蒸馏方法。但它有一个值得关注的观察：推理时跨 token、跨 layer 的 hidden-state trajectory 可能具有低秩结构。如果这个观察稳定成立，它对隐式推理、短 latent step 推理、以及 pretrain 阶段是否需要显式学习某类低维推理流形都有启发。贡献量级属于方法增量偏实用，适合泛读。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是把教师模型在显式 rationale tokens 上的 hidden states 看成一个三维张量，维度大致是 rationale token 数 N、layer 数 L、hidden size H。学生模型则有 K 个隐式推理步，对应 hidden-state 张量。LoRi 不要求第 i 个显式 CoT token 对齐第 i 个 latent step，而是用 Tucker-style 低秩表示把两者投到共享低秩子空间，再匹配一阶和二阶统计量。训练目标由两部分组成：普通 CE loss 保持学生生成显式解答和答案的能力；低秩对齐 loss 负责迁移教师推理轨迹的主结构。低秩 loss 又分成 rationale-level alignment 和 anchor-level alignment。前者对齐完整推理轨迹的全局几何，后者对齐答案预测位置的表示，用来稳定从 latent reasoning 到最终答案生成的过渡。相比逐步模仿 CoT，LoRi 的主要取舍是放弃 token-level 对应，转而保留 trajectory 的主方向，因此可以把长 CoT 压缩到较短的 latent steps，并且训练上可通过预计算教师低秩表示降低开销。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 LLaMA 和 Qwen 等模型族、不同模型规模，以及数学推理任务。论文报告 LoRi 相比已有 iCoT 方法有稳定提升，整体最高约提升 12%，在 GSM8K-Hard 上最高约提升 10%。更大规模模型上，LoRi 能缩小隐式 CoT 与显式 CoT 的差距。关键实验证据包括：教师推理 hidden states 的累计奇异值随 rank 增长很快，支持低秩假设；低秩轨迹对齐比局部状态监督更适合处理长 rationale 到短 latent trajectory 的蒸馏。完整表格细节需要看实验章节，尤其是不同 rank、latent step 数 K、以及 anchor loss 权重的消融。
summary.reading_guide: 建议用 20–30 分钟泛读。先看 Introduction 中对 iCoT 失败原因的定位，再看 Appendix A 或对应分析图中 hidden-state trajectory 的低秩证据。方法部分重点看 Fig. 2、CE + LR 的组合目标、rationale-level alignment 和 anchor-level alignment 的定义。实验部分优先看 GSM8K-Hard、多步数学题、不同模型规模的结果，以及 rank/K/anchor loss 的消融。值得深挖的是低秩结构是否只是数学推理任务上的现象，还是更普遍的推理表征规律。

summary_en.core_problem: LoRi targets a specific weakness in implicit CoT distillation: explicit rationale tokens do not have a well-defined step-by-step correspondence to a student model’s latent reasoning states. Local token-level or sampled-state supervision can miss the global structure of the teacher’s reasoning trajectory.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense. Its relevance is mainly to post-training and latent reasoning. The useful signal is the empirical claim that hidden-state trajectories during reasoning, stacked across tokens and layers, are well approximated by a low-rank structure. If this holds beyond the tested math settings, it suggests a concrete way to think about compact latent reasoning and about whether pretraining should encourage models to form low-dimensional reasoning manifolds. The contribution is practical and incremental rather than foundational, so it is best treated as a skim paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method represents the teacher’s explicit reasoning process as a hidden-state tensor over rationale tokens, layers, and hidden dimensions. The student produces a shorter tensor over a small number of implicit reasoning steps, layers, and hidden dimensions. Instead of aligning individual CoT tokens to latent steps, LoRi projects both tensors into a shared low-rank Tucker-style subspace and aligns their first- and second-order statistics. The training objective combines standard cross-entropy, which preserves the student’s ability to generate explicit solutions and final answers, with a low-rank alignment loss. The alignment loss has two parts: rationale-level alignment captures the global geometry of the teacher’s reasoning trajectory, while anchor-level alignment regularizes the representation at the answer prediction position. The main design choice is to avoid brittle local correspondence and transfer only the dominant trajectory structure, making it possible to distill long rationales into a small number of latent steps.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover LLaMA and Qwen model families at multiple scales on mathematical reasoning benchmarks. LoRi consistently improves over prior implicit CoT methods, with reported gains up to about 12% overall and about 10% on GSM8K-Hard. At larger model scales, it narrows the gap between implicit CoT and explicit CoT prompting. The key empirical support is the rapid growth of normalized cumulative singular values for hidden-state trajectories, which motivates the low-rank assumption. The most informative ablations are expected around the low-rank dimension, the number of latent reasoning steps, and the contribution of the anchor alignment term.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the introduction for the failure mode of existing implicit CoT distillation. Then inspect the low-rank trajectory evidence, especially the singular-value analysis. In the method section, focus on the objective decomposition, the rationale-level and anchor-level losses, and the tensor low-rank projection in Fig. 2. In the experiments, prioritize GSM8K-Hard, multi-step math results, scaling trends, and ablations over rank and latent-step count. The main question to keep in mind is whether the low-rank trajectory phenomenon is task-specific or a more general property of reasoning representations.

recommendation.zh: 低秩 hidden-state trajectory 这个假设值得认真看，可能影响你对 latent reasoning 蒸馏目标的设计；先看方法节和主表，别急着相信“接近 explicit CoT”的口号。
recommendation.en: The low-rank hidden-state trajectory hypothesis is the part worth your attention; read the method and main tables first, and be cautious about the 'near explicit CoT' claim.

paper.title: OPRD: On-Policy Representation Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) supervises the student only in output space by matching next-token probabilities. This output-only paradigm has two limits: (1) sampling variance from Monte Carlo KL estimates over large vocabularies (e.g., Qwen's ~150k tokens) persists throughout training, and (2) it treats the teacher as a black-box, discarding all intermediate hidden states after the LM head. We propose On-Policy Representation Distillation (OPRD), which lifts distillation into hidden-state space

summary.core_problem: 解决 on-policy distillation 只在输出概率空间蒸馏时存在的高方差、信息利用不足和大词表训练低效问题。
summary.importance: 这是后训练蒸馏方向里较有信息量的一篇：它不是再做 top-k logits 拟合，而是把 on-policy 蒸馏搬到隐藏状态空间，直接挑战“输出分布匹配就够了”的常见做法。对理解 teacher-to-student 信号质量、推理模型压缩和 RL 后训练后的能力迁移都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 OPRD（On-Policy Representation Distillation）。核心做法是在同一条 on-policy rollout 上，对齐 teacher 与 student 的若干层隐藏表示，而不是通过 LM head 匹配 next-token 概率。作者声称这样可以绕开大词表 Monte Carlo KL 估计带来的采样方差，同时保留更丰富的层级结构信息。方法上属于对现有 OPD 的目标函数替换与训练信号重构，而不是全新训练范式。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告在 AIME 2024/2025 和 AIMO 上，OPRD 能进一步缩小 student-teacher gap，而输出空间 OPD baseline 会在低于 teacher 的位置停滞。效率方面，OPRD 相比 top-k OPD 训练速度提升 1.44 倍、显存占用降低 54%。摘要未给出模型参数量、teacher/student 规模、训练 token 数和具体 baseline 名称，这些需要看正文确认 setup 是否干净。
summary.authors_note: 浙江大学团队。摘要未显示业界广泛知名作者，但主题贴近当前推理模型蒸馏与后训练压缩。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the variance, information bottleneck, and inefficiency of output-space on-policy distillation, especially under very large vocabularies.
summary_en.importance: This is a useful post-training distillation paper because it does more than another top-k logit matching tweak: it moves on-policy distillation into hidden-state space and directly questions the common assumption that matching output distributions is sufficient. That matters for teacher-to-student signal quality, reasoning-model compression, and transferring capabilities from RL-tuned teachers.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes OPRD, or On-Policy Representation Distillation. Instead of matching next-token probabilities through the LM head, the student aligns selected hidden layers with the teacher on the same on-policy rollouts. The claimed benefit is eliminating Monte Carlo KL sampling variance over large vocabularies while preserving richer layerwise structural information. Methodologically, this is a redesign of the distillation target rather than a new training paradigm.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, OPRD narrows the student-teacher gap on AIME 2024/2025 and AIMO, while output-space OPD baselines plateau below the teacher. It also reports 1.44x faster training and 54% lower memory than top-k OPD. The abstract does not specify model sizes, teacher/student scales, training tokens, or exact baselines, so the cleanliness of the setup needs verification in the main paper.
summary_en.authors_note: From Zhejiang University. No widely recognized marquee author is evident from the metadata, but the topic is closely aligned with current reasoning-model distillation and post-training compression.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文，但它在蒸馏信号上动了真刀：若你在做 RL 后 teacher 压缩，先看隐藏层对齐是否真比 logit 匹配稳，重点查 ablation 和 rollout 设定。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it makes a real move on distillation signal design: if you compress RL-tuned teachers, check whether hidden-state alignment is genuinely cleaner than logit matching, especially the ablations and rollout setup.

paper.title: Beyond Output Matching: Preserving Internal Geometry in NVFP4 LLM Distillatio
paper.abstract: Demand for low-precision inference, including NVFP4-based approaches, has grown as large language models are increasingly deployed in latency and cost constrained production environments. Quantization-aware distillation (QAD) helps recover accuracy lost under low bit quantization by training a quantized student to match the output distribution of a frozen higher precision teacher via a KL-divergence loss. In this work, we first provide a representation level diagnosis of QAD: output matching alo

summary.core_problem: 量化感知蒸馏（QAD）仅通过KL散度对齐输出分布，无法保证中间激活层的内部几何结构被保留。论文发现仅用KL的QAD反而会加剧表示漂移——尤其是经过RL后训练的模型——尽管输出分布与老师模型已经对齐。
summary.importance: 对低比特LLM量化蒸馏的研究提供了诊断层面的新视角：输出对齐 ≠ 内部表示保真。这一发现也间接提醒预训练研究者，蒸馏/对齐等后训练过程中，内部表示几何可能被悄悄破坏而指标不反映。
summary.technical_approach: 在标准QAD目标（KL散度对齐输出分布）之外，增加了一层Centered Kernel Alignment（CKA）正则项，对中间激活的几何结构做显式约束。CKA的核心优势是对正交变换和各向同性缩放不变，比逐点MSE更鲁棒于量化带来的尺度偏移和截断。总损失为KL项加层间CKA对齐项。实现采用teacher-top-k变体减少词表级蒸馏的通信开销，k=8192。
summary.experiments: 在Nemotron 3 Nano（混合Mamba-Transformer MoE）和Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507上评测。KL-only QAD会降低各层与BF16老师的CKA相似度，RL后训练模型的漂移最严重。CKA-QAD将内部对齐恢复到接近BF16水平，额外开销仅为step时间的0.5%和峰值VRAM的7.0%（在Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507上）。下游任务上，AIME25从68.5%→72.3%，GPQA-D从59.5%→61.1%，LiveCodeBench-v5从57.9%→59.8%。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看Section 3（CKA-QAD目标函数和实现细节）和Section 4中的CKA相似度热力图（展示各层漂移模式）。对于预训练研究者，最有价值的是其诊断部分：如何用CKA系统地揭示输出对齐掩盖内部退化这一现象。预计阅读时间20分钟。
summary.authors_note: 机构信息未在提供的文本中明确给出，作者是做NVFP4量化和QAD方向的研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: Quantization-Aware Distillation (QAD) using only KL divergence to align output distributions does not guarantee preservation of the internal geometric structure of intermediate activations. The paper finds that KL-only QAD can actually exacerbate representational drift — especially in RL-post-trained models — even when output distributions are well-aligned to the teacher.
summary_en.importance: Provides a diagnostic insight for low-bit LLM quantization distillation: output alignment does not equal internal representation fidelity. This finding also indirectly alerts pretraining researchers that internal geometry may be silently corrupted during distillation/alignment without being reflected in output metrics.
summary_en.technical_approach: In addition to the standard QAD objective (KL divergence for output distribution alignment), a layerwise Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) regularization term is added to explicitly constrain the geometry of intermediate activations. CKA is invariant to orthogonal transformations and isotropic scaling, making it more robust than pointwise MSE against quantization-induced scale shifts and clipping. Total loss combines KL term and inter-layer CKA alignment. Implementation uses a teacher-top-k variant with k=8192 to reduce communication cost of vocabulary-level distillation.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Nemotron 3 Nano (hybrid Mamba-Transformer MoE) and Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507. KL-only QAD reduces CKA similarity to the BF16 teacher across layers, with RL-post-trained models showing the most severe drift. CKA-QAD restores internal alignment to near-BF16 levels with only 0.5% step-time overhead and 7.0% peak VRAM overhead. On downstream tasks: AIME25 68.5%→72.3%, GPQA-D 59.5%→61.1%, LiveCodeBench-v5 57.9%→59.8%.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (CKA-QAD objective and implementation details) and Section 4's CKA similarity heatmaps showing per-layer drift patterns. The most valuable part for pretraining researchers is the diagnostic framing: how CKA systematically reveals that output alignment can mask internal degradation. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution not explicitly stated in the provided text; authors work on NVFP4 quantization and QAD.

recommendation.zh: RL 后训练模型在蒸馏中表征退化更严重——这对 pretrain-post-train 接口有直接启示；重点读 §3 CKA 分析。
recommendation.en: RL-post-trained models suffer more representational degradation during distillation — directly relevant to the pretrain-post-train interface; focus on §3 CKA analysis.

paper.title: Filter, Then Reweight: Rethinking Optimization Granularity in On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-Policy distillation (OPD) in large language models is shifting from full-trace KL supervision toward more selective training paradigms. Recent OPD methods increasingly focus on selecting which trajectories to learn from, which tokens are most informative, and which supervision signals are most reliable. Motivated by this trend, we rethink optimization granularity of OPD and propose \fireicon\ FiRe-OPD (Filter, then Reweight), which jointly adjusts supervision signals at both trajectory and to

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是 on-policy distillation 里的监督粒度问题：学生模型在自己生成的轨迹上接受教师监督时，不同 rollout 的可学性不同，不同 token 的信息量也不同；如果仍然对所有轨迹、所有 token 一视同仁地做全轨迹 KL 或 PPO 风格蒸馏，会把大量低质量、低可靠性的信号混进优化里。论文要解决的是，如何同时在 trajectory level 和 token level 做选择性优化，而且避免现有方法常见的硬筛选带来的不连续和信息浪费。
summary.importance: 这项工作更偏 post-train，但和预训练研究的接口很直接，因为它讨论的是训练信号质量与优化粒度，而这正是大模型训练里反复出现的问题。它给出的核心启发有两点。第一，样本级过滤和 token 级重加权不是替代关系，而是适合放在不同层面联合使用：轨迹层面适合 hard filter，token 层面更适合 soft weighting。第二，教师“能不能教”与学生“需不需要学”应同时进入权重设计，而不是只看 teacher confidence 或只看 student uncertainty。对做 continual pretrain、reasoning distillation、RL-pretrain 接口的人，这种信号分层处理思路是有迁移价值的。贡献量级上，它更像对 OPD recipe 的系统整理和增强，而不是提出全新的训练范式。
summary.technical_approach:
论文从标准 OPD 出发。学生模型先基于 prompt 采样 rollout，教师再在这些 student-generated trajectories 上提供 token 级监督。基础目标写成 PPO 风格的 clipped policy optimization，其中 token-level advantage 由 teacher 与旧 student policy 的对数似然比给出。作者认为这个标准做法的问题是：它默认每条轨迹、每个 token 的监督都同样可靠。

FiRe-OPD 分两步。第一步是 trajectory-level filtering。作者不用外部 verifier 的 outcome correctness，也不用 reward model，而是直接用教师对整条 student rollout 的归一化 log-probability 作为轨迹重要性分数。直觉是：如果教师在这条路径上概率很低，说明 student 走到了教师并不熟悉、也不擅长解释的区域；此时继续强行蒸馏，教师给出的 token 级信号可能是噪声甚至误导。具体做法是在每个 batch 内按该分数排序，丢弃底部 p% 的轨迹，默认 p=20。

第二步是 token-level soft reweighting。保留下来的轨迹内部，不再做硬 token 选择，而是给每个 token 一个连续权重。这个权重来自两个因素的乘积：teacher confidence 和 student confusion。前者衡量教师在当前位置的监督是否可靠，后者衡量学生在当前位置是否真的需要学习。这样设计的含义很清楚：既要教师“会”，也要学生“不会”，该 token 才值得更大梯度。相比 TIP 一类硬筛 token 的方法，FiRe-OPD 保留所有 token 的梯度，只是按信息量缩放，优化更平滑，也减少了阈值选择过于刚性的副作用。

论文的一个重要判断是，不同粒度适合不同操作：trajectory level 用 hard filter 更有效，因为低质量 rollout 往往整体不值得学；token level 用 soft weighting 更有效，因为同一条轨迹里常常同时包含有用和无用位置，直接删 token 容易把边界信息一起丢掉。这种“先过滤，再重加权”的结构，是全文最核心的 recipe 贡献。
summary.experiments:
从全文描述看，作者在 strong-to-weak、single-teacher、multi-teacher 等多种蒸馏设定下都做了实验，并把 FiRe-OPD 与标准 OPD、EOPD、TIP、ExOPD、Uni-OPD 等方法比较。摘要没有给出具体 benchmark 名称和完整数字，但论文主张的主要结论有三类：

第一，联合做 trajectory filtering 和 token soft weighting，优于只做其中一层选择。也就是说，粒度隔离确实会损失性能。

第二，在 trajectory level，hard filtering 比软处理更有效；在 token level，soft weighting 比 hard token selection 更稳、更强。这不是一个对称结论，而是经验上区分了两种粒度的最优操作方式。

第三，这个优势在单教师和多教师场景都成立，说明方法不是依赖某个特定 teacher 的偶然现象。

如果你精读原文，建议重点找三类实验细节：一是过滤比例 p 的敏感性，特别是 10%、20%、30% 附近是否存在稳定区间；二是 token 权重中 teacher confidence 与 student confusion 各自的独立贡献，是否存在一项主导、另一项只是微调；三是多教师设定下权重如何聚合，是否会放大 teacher 间分歧。没有这些细节，方法结论仍然偏 recipe 经验，而不是机制上完全坐实。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看方法部分对标准 OPD 目标的重写，再看 Figure 2 一类总览图，理解 FiRe-OPD 的两阶段结构。然后直接看主结果表和消融：只做 trajectory filtering、只做 token weighting、hard token selection、soft token weighting 之间的差异，这是论文真正的信息密度所在。最后看作者如何解释“teacher low-likelihood trajectory 为何不该学”，这关系到方法是否只是经验筛样本，还是有更清楚的分布对齐含义。预计 35–50 分钟可以读完主线。

阅读时要带着两个问题。第一，teacher 低概率轨迹到底是“无效路径”还是“学生探索出的新但正确路径”；如果是后者，过滤可能压制多样推理。第二，student confusion 往往和高熵、长尾 token 重合，soft weighting 会不会把训练过度拉向局部困难 token，而忽略全局 reasoning structure。论文如果在这些点上有额外分析，值得重点看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies optimization granularity in on-policy distillation. In OPD, a student learns from teacher supervision on trajectories generated by the student itself. But not all rollouts are equally learnable, and not all token positions are equally informative. Standard full-trace KL or PPO-style distillation treats every trajectory and every token the same, which mixes strong supervision with noisy or low-value signals. The paper asks how to make selection at both the trajectory and token levels, while avoiding the brittleness of hard token filtering.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training paper, but it is relevant to pretraining-oriented readers because it is really about signal quality and optimization granularity, two issues that recur throughout large-scale training. The main lesson is that sample-level filtering and token-level reweighting are complementary rather than interchangeable. Hard filtering makes sense at the trajectory level, while soft weighting is better at the token level. A second useful idea is that weighting should reflect both whether the teacher can teach and whether the student needs to learn, instead of relying only on teacher confidence or only on student uncertainty. That perspective transfers naturally to continual pretraining, reasoning distillation, and the pretrain↔post-train interface. The contribution is best read as a stronger OPD recipe, not as a new training paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The starting point is standard OPD. The student samples rollouts from prompts, and the teacher provides token-level supervision on those student-generated trajectories. The base objective is written in a PPO-style clipped policy optimization form, where the token-level advantage is derived from the teacher-versus-old-student log-likelihood ratio. The authors argue that this objective is too coarse because it assumes all trajectories and all token positions provide equally reliable supervision.

FiRe-OPD has two stages. The first is trajectory-level filtering. Instead of using external verifiers, outcome correctness, or reward models, the method scores each student rollout by the teacher’s normalized log-probability on that trajectory.
