The intuition is straightforward: if the teacher assigns very low probability to a student path, then the student has moved into a region the teacher does not naturally model well. In that case, token-level supervision from the teacher may be noisy or even misleading. So within each batch, trajectories are ranked by this score and the bottom p% are discarded, with p=20 by default.

The second stage is token-level soft reweighting. For the retained trajectories, the method does not hard-drop tokens. Instead, each token receives a continuous weight formed by multiplying two signals: teacher confidence and student confusion. The first term measures whether the teacher’s local supervision is reliable; the second measures whether the student actually needs learning at that position. This gives larger gradients to tokens where the teacher is confident and the student is uncertain. Compared with hard token selection methods such as TIP-style filtering, FiRe-OPD keeps gradient contributions from all positions but scales them by informativeness, which should make optimization smoother and less threshold-sensitive.

One of the paper’s strongest claims is asymmetric: hard filtering works better at the trajectory level because bad rollouts are often globally unhelpful, while soft weighting works better at the token level because useful and useless positions often coexist within the same trajectory. That “filter first, then reweight” structure is the core recipe contribution.
summary_en.experiments:
From the full text provided, the authors evaluate FiRe-OPD in strong-to-weak, single-teacher, and multi-teacher distillation settings, comparing against standard OPD and several selective OPD baselines such as EOPD, TIP, ExOPD, and Uni-OPD. The abstract does not expose the full benchmark list or exact numbers, but the main empirical claims are clear.

First, combining trajectory filtering with token soft weighting outperforms doing selection at only one granularity. That supports the paper’s central argument that granularity isolation leaves performance on the table.

Second, the preferred operation differs by level: hard filtering is better for trajectories, while soft weighting is better than hard token selection for tokens. This is the most interesting empirical takeaway because it is not a generic “more selection is better” story; it is a claim about matching the operation to the granularity.

Third, the gains persist in both single-teacher and multi-teacher settings, suggesting the method is not tied to one specific teacher.

If reading the paper in detail, the most important experimental checks are: sensitivity to the filtering ratio p, especially around 10/20/30%; the separate contribution of teacher confidence and student confusion in the token weights; and how multi-teacher weighting is aggregated when teachers disagree. Without those details, the method remains a strong recipe result but not yet a fully settled mechanistic account.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with the reformulation of the standard OPD objective and the overview figure that shows the two-stage FiRe-OPD pipeline. Then go straight to the main result tables and ablations: trajectory filtering only, token weighting only, hard token selection, and soft token weighting. That is where the paper’s real information lies. Finally, read the discussion of why low teacher-likelihood trajectories should be filtered, because that determines whether the method is just heuristic sample pruning or a more principled distribution-alignment argument. Roughly 35–50 minutes should be enough for the main thread.

Two questions are worth keeping in mind while reading. First, are low-probability teacher trajectories truly unhelpful, or could they include valid but novel student reasoning paths that the teacher would suppress? Second, because student confusion often correlates with high-entropy or tail tokens, could the soft weighting over-focus on locally difficult tokens and underweight global reasoning structure? If the paper contains extra analysis on these points, that is where the deeper value is.

recommendation.zh: 这是典型“训练信号颗粒度”论文，不是范式突破；如果你在做 RL/SFT 蒸馏接口，重点看过滤准则和 soft weighting 是否真比 hard mask 更稳。
recommendation.en: This is a classic training-signal granularity paper, not a paradigm shift; if you work on the RL/SFT distillation interface, check whether the filtering rule and soft weighting are actually cleaner and more stable than hard masking.

paper.title: Soft-NBCE: Entropy-Weighted Chunk Fusion for Long-Context
paper.abstract: The quadratic complexity of self-attention remains a bottleneck for Large Language Models (LLMs) processing ultra-long contexts. The Naive Bayes Cognitive Engine (NBCE) parallelizes long-context inference by chunking documents and routing to the lowest-entropy chunk at each decoding step. This hard-selection strategy causes semantic fragmentation during cross-chunk reasoning, as abrupt routing changes between adjacent tokens disrupt the model's contextual grounding.   We present Soft-NBCE, a lig

summary.core_problem: 处理超长上下文时，标准 Transformer 的自注意力机制面临 $O(N^2)$ 的计算和内存瓶颈。现有的 NBCE 分块方法采用硬路由（选择熵最低的块），导致跨块推理时语义碎片化，破坏了模型的上下文连贯性。
summary.importance: 提出了一种轻量级的长上下文推理优化方法 Soft-NBCE，通过软性的熵加权融合替代硬路由，在显著降低显存占用的同时，缓解了分块带来的语义割裂问题。结合无监督蒸馏，进一步弥补了分块推理与全上下文联合注意力之间的性能差距。
summary.technical_approach: Soft-NBCE 将每个文本块视为概率专家，通过温度缩放的 Softmax 计算基于预测熵的连续置信度分布。生成逻辑是所有块条件分布在对数空间下的加权聚合，并引入对比先验（减去无条件先验概率）以抑制停用词的干扰。此外，提出一致性蒸馏（Consistency Distillation），利用全上下文教师模型指导分块学生模型（通过 LoRA 更新 Q/V 投影），以无监督方式对齐局部预测与全局分布。
summary.experiments: 消融实验表明，温度参数 $\tau=0.1$ 能较好地平衡锚点精度和补充上下文。一致性蒸馏在 MuSiQue 数据集上带来了 9.5% 的 F1 提升。Soft-NBCE 在多跳推理基准上优于原始 NBCE 和均匀平均方法，同时将峰值显存需求降低至 $O(L/n)$。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Section 2 中的对数空间聚合公式（Equation 4）及其背后的直觉（对比先验的作用），以及 Section 3 中一致性蒸馏的无监督目标函数。实验部分可关注其在多跳推理任务上的表现及显存开销分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The $O(N^2)$ complexity of self-attention bottlenecks LLMs on ultra-long contexts. Existing chunking methods like NBCE use hard routing (selecting the lowest-entropy chunk), causing semantic fragmentation during cross-chunk reasoning and disrupting contextual coherence.
summary_en.importance: Proposes Soft-NBCE, a lightweight optimization for long-context inference that replaces hard routing with soft entropy-weighted fusion. It mitigates semantic fragmentation while significantly reducing memory footprint. Coupled with unsupervised distillation, it bridges the performance gap between chunked inference and full-context joint attention.
summary_en.technical_approach: Soft-NBCE treats each chunk as a probabilistic expert, computing a continuous confidence distribution via temperature-scaled Softmax over predictive entropies. The generation logit is a weighted log-space aggregation of chunk-conditional distributions, modulated by a contrastive prior (subtracting unconditional prior probability) to suppress stop words. Additionally, Consistency Distillation is introduced, using a full-context teacher to guide a chunked student (updating Q/V projections via LoRA) in an unsupervised manner, aligning local predictions with the global distribution.
summary_en.experiments: Ablations identify $\tau=0.1$ as optimal for balancing anchor precision and supplementary context. Consistency Distillation yields a 9.5% F1 gain on MuSiQue. Soft-NBCE outperforms vanilla NBCE and uniform averaging on multi-hop reasoning benchmarks while reducing peak memory to $O(L/n)$.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the log-space aggregation formula (Equation 4) and the intuition behind the contrastive prior in Section 2, as well as the unsupervised objective for Consistency Distillation in Section 3. In the experiments, pay attention to performance on multi-hop reasoning tasks and memory overhead analysis.

recommendation.zh: 把 NBCE 的硬路由改成熵加权软融合是合理工程修补，但关键看“质量-吞吐”曲线是否真优于直接加大检索/滑窗；只读方法+主表即可。
recommendation.en: Entropy-weighted soft fusion is a sensible patch over NBCE hard routing, but the only thing that matters is the quality–throughput curve vs simpler sliding-window/RAG baselines; read the method and the main trade-off table.

paper.title: Hidden Thoughts Are Not Secret: Reasoning Trace Exposure in LLMs
paper.abstract: Reasoning traces have become a valuable form of learning signals for improving and transferring the capabilities of large language models. In particular, detailed traces can help distill reasoning behavior from stronger teacher models into weaker student models. The value of capability transfer has motivated many deployed systems with reasoning models to hide raw internal traces and expose at most summaries and answers to users. As a result, we ask whether such interface-level trace hiding preve

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究一个很具体的安全与训练数据问题：当推理模型隐藏原始 chain-of-thought，只向用户暴露答案或摘要时，黑盒用户是否仍能通过提示诱导出可用于蒸馏的显式推理轨迹。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，但对 post-train 数据闭环和能力抽取风险有明确参考价值。推理轨迹已经成为 SFT、蒸馏、过程监督和 verifier 训练的重要信号；如果接口层面的隐藏不能阻止用户获得高质量 rationale，那么 reasoning model 的数据护城河会比想象中更脆弱。对基座研究员而言，值得关注的是它把“可见文本输出”重新定义为一种潜在训练数据泄露通道，而不是只讨论模型权重或最终答案泄露。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Reasoning Exposure Prompting，简称 REP。核心做法不是直接要求模型展示隐藏思考，而是在上下文里放入若干 question-reasoning-answer 示例，让模型把“先输出推理，再输出答案”当作当前格式继续补全。示例由 shadow model 生成，并被包在 markdown fence、shell command、代码块等辅助格式中，降低模型触发拒答或隐藏策略的概率。论文把推理轨迹拆成三类：标准提示下的内部轨迹 r0，REP 条件下的内部轨迹 r1，以及 REP 下用户可见的暴露轨迹 r2。这个拆分比较关键，因为只看最终蒸馏效果无法判断 r2 是真的反映了 victim 的推理，还是只是另一种 prompt-induced rationale。评估也对应分成四项：格式是否可解析、r2 对 r1 的暴露保真度、REP 是否保留原模型行为、暴露轨迹是否能提升学生模型。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 OpenThoughts-114k 作为源数据，Qwen3-14B 和 Qwen3-32B 作为 victim model，Qwen3-14B 作为 shadow model，Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 作为 student。作者比较了多种 wrapper、demo 数量、跨数据集迁移、跨模型迁移和下游蒸馏效果。最佳配置是 markdown-fence REP，k=3 demonstrations，并且这个配置是通过 trace-level fidelity 指标选择出来的。下游蒸馏中，REP 暴露轨迹平均效果达到 oracle internal-trace reference 的 96.7%；相对 answer-only supervision 提升 2.09 倍，相对 summarized traces 提升 1.25 倍，相对 TIA-style reasoning trace inversion 提升 1.23 倍。这些数字说明暴露轨迹不只是表面风格模仿，至少在这些开源 victim 和任务设置下携带了可迁移的推理监督信号。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20 分钟。重点看 Problem Formulation 中对 r0、r1、r2 的定义，以及实验部分里 wrapper 对 fidelity 和 distillation utility 的影响。真正有信息量的是作者没有只报蒸馏收益，而是把“暴露保真度”和“行为保持”分开评估。需要带着限制读：实验主要依赖开源模型来观测内部轨迹，部署环境中的系统提示、输出过滤、采样策略和 API 监控可能更复杂；结论更适合作为风险下界，而不是完整的线上攻击评估。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether hiding raw chain-of-thought at the interface level is enough to prevent users from eliciting useful reasoning traces from a black-box reasoning model.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to the post-training data loop. Reasoning traces are now valuable supervision for distillation, process supervision, verifier training, and capability transfer. If a model can be prompted into exposing usable rationales despite hidden internal traces, then answer-only APIs may still leak training signals. The main value for foundation-model researchers is the framing of visible model outputs as a supervision-extraction channel, not just a user-facing response.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, Reasoning Exposure Prompting, avoids directly asking for hidden reasoning. It instead gives the model a few question-reasoning-answer demonstrations and asks it to continue the visible pattern. The demonstrations are generated by a shadow model and wrapped in auxiliary formats such as markdown fences, shell-like commands, or code-style blocks. The evaluation separates three traces: r0, the benign internal trace under standard prompting; r1, the internal trace under REP; and r2, the user-visible trace exposed under REP. This decomposition is useful because downstream distillation gains alone cannot tell whether r2 reflects the victim’s reasoning or merely a plausible prompt-induced rationale. The paper evaluates structural validity, exposure fidelity, behavior preservation, and functional utility.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use OpenThoughts-114k as the source dataset, Qwen3-14B and Qwen3-32B as victim models, Qwen3-14B as the shadow model, and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct as the student. The authors test different wrappers, numbers of demonstrations, transfer across datasets and victim models, and end-to-end distillation. The strongest setting is markdown-fence REP with k=3 demonstrations, selected using trace-level fidelity metrics. Averaged over benchmarks, REP-based traces reach 96.7% of the oracle internal-trace reference, outperform answer-only supervision by 2.09x, summarized traces by 1.25x, and TIA-style reasoning trace inversion by 1.23x.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 minutes. Focus on the formulation of r0, r1, and r2, then read the experimental tables comparing wrappers and distillation utility. The most useful part is the separation between trace fidelity, behavior preservation, and student-model gains. Treat the deployment claim carefully: the internal-trace analysis relies on open-weight models, while real APIs may add stronger system prompts, filtering, sampling controls, and monitoring.

recommendation.zh: 别把“隐藏 CoT”当安全边界：REP 说明可蒸馏的推理监督仍能被提示挖出；重点看 threat model 和相似度/蒸馏增益定义。
recommendation.en: Don’t treat “hidden CoT” as a security boundary: REP suggests distillable reasoning supervision can still be elicited; focus on the threat model and how similarity/distillation gains are measured.

institutions: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University

paper.title: Draft-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Speculative Draft Models
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by pairing a target model with a lightweight draft model whose proposed tokens are verified in parallel. A common way to build draft models, like EAGLE3 or DFlash is supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on target-generated trajectories. However, we observe that SFT quickly plateaus: the draft model's acceptance length on test data stops improving. The reason is an offline-to-inference mismatch: In SFT, the drafter learns from fixed target-g

summary.core_problem: Draft-OPD 解决的是训练型 speculative decoding draft model 的离线训练瓶颈。常规 SFT 学的是 target model 生成的固定轨迹，但推理时 draft model 的接受长度由它自己提出的 token block 决定，两者状态分布不一致，导致继续 SFT 很快进入平台期。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练方向的直接关系不强，但对大模型推理效率和 post-train 信号设计有清晰启发。它指出 draft model 的训练目标不能只看 teacher-forced next-token matching，而要看 verification-time state distribution。这个观点和预训练中的 exposure bias、on-policy data、训练-推理分布差异是同一类问题。对做推测解码、轻量预测头、蒸馏和推理加速的人，方法价值较高。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Draft-OPD，即面向 speculative draft model 的 on-policy distillation。直接让 draft model 自己 rollout 不可行，因为 EAGLE 类或 DFlash 类 drafter 通常不是完整自回归模型，而是依赖 target model 上下文提出短 token span，单独生成会重复或退化。单纯 target-assisted rollout 也不够，因为 target 会丢弃 draft 的错误 token，最有训练价值的错误状态被抹掉。Draft-OPD 的做法是：先用 target-assisted rollout 保持续写稳定，同时记录 speculative verification 中暴露出来的错误位置；再从这些错误位置 replay drafting，让 target model 对相同的 draft-induced prefixes 打分；最后使用 acceptance-aware distillation objective，对 accepted tokens 和 rejected tokens 区分处理。accepted tokens 用来强化与 target 的可靠一致性，rejected tokens 用来集中修正限制接受长度的 draft-induced errors。
summary.experiments: 论文报告，离线 SFT 在初始 warm-up 后 accepted length 不再提升，继续在 OPD 数据上做 SFT 甚至可能降低接受长度。Draft-OPD 在 matched FLOPs 设置下，相比 EAGLE-3 提升 23%，相比 DFlash 提升 13%。在 thinking models 上实现超过 5 倍的 lossless acceleration。关键实验信号是 accepted length，而不是单纯 distillation loss；这符合 speculative decoding 的实际目标，因为更长的接受片段直接减少 target model 解码步数。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 30 分钟。重点看 Figure 1 和相关训练曲线，理解 SFT plateau 的证据。然后读方法部分的 error-position replay 和 acceptance-aware objective，这是论文的核心。实验部分重点看 matched FLOPs 对比、accepted length、端到端加速倍率，而不是只看 loss。若关注推理系统，可进一步看它如何接入 EAGLE-3 和 DFlash 风格 drafter。

summary_en.core_problem: Draft-OPD addresses a training mismatch in learned speculative draft models. Standard SFT trains the drafter on fixed target-generated trajectories, while speculative decoding evaluates the drafter on token blocks produced by its own policy. This offline-to-inference mismatch causes accepted length to plateau after a short SFT warm-up.
summary_en.importance: The paper is most relevant to inference efficiency and distillation, with a useful connection to broader foundation-model training. It shows that matching the teacher under teacher-forced states is not enough when the deployment metric depends on student-induced states. This is the same class of issue as exposure bias and on-policy data collection, but studied in the concrete setting of speculative decoding.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, Draft-OPD, adapts on-policy distillation to speculative drafters. Naive draft-only rollouts are unstable because EAGLE-style or DFlash-style drafters are designed to propose short spans under target-model guidance, not to act as standalone autoregressive generators. Target-assisted rollouts are stable, but they erase the rejected draft tokens, which are exactly the states that limit acceptance. Draft-OPD keeps target-assisted rollout for stable continuation, records error positions exposed by speculative verification, replays drafting from those positions, and asks the target model to score the resulting draft-induced prefixes. The training objective is acceptance-aware: accepted tokens reinforce reliable agreement with the target, while rejected tokens focus learning on the errors that reduce accepted length.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports that continued offline SFT stops improving accepted length after the initial warm-up, and in some settings can even reduce it on OPD data. Under matched FLOPs, Draft-OPD improves over EAGLE-3 by 23% and over DFlash by 13%. For thinking models, it achieves more than 5x lossless acceleration. The important metric is accepted length rather than distillation loss alone, because accepted length directly determines how many expensive target-model decoding steps are saved.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 minutes. Start with Figure 1 and the SFT plateau analysis, since that motivates the method. Then read the error-position replay procedure and the acceptance-aware objective. In the experiments, focus on matched-FLOPs comparisons, accepted length, and end-to-end speedup. The implementation details are useful if the goal is to integrate the method with EAGLE-3 or DFlash-style speculative drafters.

recommendation.zh: 离线蒸馏失配这个诊断很可信；读方法里如何保留 on-policy 信号，值得在内部 draft 训练复现。
recommendation.en: The offline-distillation mismatch diagnosis is credible; read how they preserve on-policy signal and consider reproducing it for draft training.

paper.title: Divergence Decoding: Inference-Time Unlearning via Auxiliary Models
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) frequently memorize sensitive training data thereby creating significant privacy and copyright risks. Addressing these risks, i.e., removing such knowledge from an existing model checkpoint, has proven challenging as many unlearning methods lead to catastrophic utility loss or are ineffective for complex queries. We introduce Divergence Decoding (DD), a mechanism that uses small auxiliary models to steer the logits of the LLM away from specific data during inference.

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究如何在不重新训练大模型、不直接修改主模型权重的情况下，让模型在推理时避开需要遗忘的训练信息，同时尽量保留通用能力。
summary.importance: 它和预训练的关系主要在模型生命周期和训练数据治理。大模型预训练后可能记住敏感数据、版权数据或需要移除的时间泄漏信息；完全重训成本过高，权重编辑又容易损害能力。Divergence Decoding 提供了一种推理时分布修正思路：用小辅助模型近似“原模型”和“干净重训模型”之间的差异，再把这个差异注入到主模型解码中。对基座研究员的启发在于，数据删除不一定只靠重新训练或权重更新，也可以通过概率分布组合和后续蒸馏形成闭环。
summary.technical_approach: 方法设定中，Target 模型 P 是已经见过 retain 数据和 forget 数据的待遗忘模型；理想的 Retrain 模型 Q 是只在 retain 数据上重训得到的模型，但通常不可获得。论文训练两个小辅助语言模型 p 和 q，分别作为 Target 与 Retrain 差异的代理。推理时，在每个 prefix 下计算辅助模型的 logit 差异，并用该差异调整 Target 模型的 logits，使采样分布远离 forget 数据相关区域，向理想的 retain-only 模型靠近。论文还强调了 rank-based steering，相比直接线性 logit steering，目标是让辅助模型差异在尺度、模型族和 tokenizer 不完全一致时更稳。若推理时额外前向两个辅助模型仍不可接受，作者使用 student-teacher distillation，把带有 Divergence Decoding 行为的模型蒸馏回单一模型。这个设计把推理时 unlearning 和权重内化连接起来。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 TOFU 和 MUSE Knowledge Memorization 等 unlearning benchmark。论文称 Divergence Decoding 在遗忘效果和保留能力之间优于已有 unlearning baseline，蒸馏后的单模型也优于 prior weight-based 或 distillation-based unlearning 方法。消融包括超参数选择、辅助模型大小、额外计算和延迟、跨 tokenizer 与跨模型族设置，以及 adversarial prompting。论文还做了初步图像生成实验，用类似思想遗忘特定视觉语义。给出的正文内容没有提供具体数值表格，因此无法核验每个 benchmark 上的绝对提升幅度。可确认的是，作者把延迟开销归因于辅助模型大小，并认为在小辅助模型下影响较小。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看 Method 中 Target/Retrain 的概率设定，再看 Divergence Decoding 的 logit 调整公式和 rank-based steering 细节。随后看 distillation 部分，理解如何从推理时控制转成单模型权重更新。实验部分优先看 TOFU、MUSE、utility-retention tradeoff、cross-tokenizer/cross-family ablation 和 adversarial prompting。预计阅读 25 到 40 分钟。对预训练研究更有用的是它对“理想重训分布”的近似方式，而不是具体 benchmark 分数。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses inference-time unlearning: how to make an existing LLM avoid specific memorized training data without retraining the full model and without directly editing its main weights, while preserving general utility.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pre-training lies in model lifecycle management and training-data governance. Large pre-trained models can memorize private, copyrighted, or time-sensitive data. Full retraining on a sanitized corpus is usually infeasible, and weight-based unlearning often damages utility. Divergence Decoding offers a distribution-level alternative: use small auxiliary models to approximate the gap between the current target model and an ideal retain-only retrained model, then steer decoding with that gap. The broader lesson is that data removal can be approximated through probability composition and later distilled into weights, rather than being treated only as a retraining problem.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setup uses a Target model P, trained on both retained and forgotten data, and an ideal Retrain model Q, trained only on retained data. Q is the desired deployment distribution but is normally unavailable at frontier scale. The method trains two small auxiliary language models, p and q, as proxies for the target-like and retain-only distributions. At generation time, it computes the auxiliary logit difference under the current prefix and uses that difference to adjust the Target model’s logits, moving the sampling distribution away from content associated with the forget set and toward the retain-only distribution. The paper also introduces rank-based steering, intended to be more robust than raw linear logit steering when auxiliary models differ in scale, family, or tokenizer. When running auxiliary models at inference is undesirable, the behavior of the Divergence-Decoding-augmented model is distilled into a single student model.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover TOFU and MUSE Knowledge Memorization. The paper reports better unlearning-utility tradeoffs than prior baselines, and the distilled single-model version is also reported to outperform previous weight-based or distillation-based unlearning methods. Ablations include hyperparameter choice, auxiliary model size, compute and latency overhead, cross-tokenizer and cross-family settings, and adversarial prompting. The paper also gives preliminary evidence on transformer-based image generation by targeting specific visual semantics. The provided content does not include exact numerical tables, so the absolute gains cannot be verified here. The reported latency overhead is described as proportional to auxiliary model size and small when the auxiliaries are lightweight.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the probabilistic Target/Retrain formulation first, then read the Divergence Decoding logit adjustment and the rank-based steering details. The distillation section is important because it connects inference-time unlearning to a single deployable model. In the experiments, focus on TOFU, MUSE, the utility-retention tradeoff, cross-tokenizer and cross-family ablations, and adversarial prompting. Expected reading time is about 25 to 40 minutes. For pre-training researchers, the most useful part is the approximation to the ideal retrained distribution, not the benchmark scores alone.

recommendation.zh: 值得看解码公式和蒸馏实验；若效用指标干净，这是比参数级 unlearning 更实用的路径。
recommendation.en: Read the decoding rule and distillation experiments; if utility is measured cleanly, this is a more practical path than parameter-level unlearning.

paper.title: Distilling LLM Feedback for Lean Theorem Proving
paper.abstract: Post-training for reasoning models typically combines supervised fine-tuning with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards, most commonly with GRPO. However, this algorithm suffers from sparse rewards, limited exploration, and mode collapse. Building upon recent works on self-distillation, we propose Feedback Distillation, a training method where the model is trained to match, at the token level, its own distribution conditioned on privileged feedback produced by a language model. Feedback

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作针对的是可验证推理任务里常见的 SFT+GRPO 路线的几个老问题：奖励稀疏、探索不足、容易模式坍缩，以及 trajectory-level reward 带来的弱 credit assignment。作者关心的不是再做一个更复杂的 RL 变体，而是能否用一种 on-policy、token-level 的训练方式，把“带反馈的搜索过程”蒸馏回模型参数里，从而在 formal theorem proving 这类大搜索空间任务上保留更多策略熵和解题多样性。
summary.importance: 它属于 post-train，但对基座研究也有启发，尤其是在“RL 是否真的带来新能力”以及“如何把外部反馈转成更密集训练信号”这两个问题上。论文给出的答案是：与其只靠 verifier 的成败信号做 trajectory-level 优化，不如让模型在自己采样的轨迹上，去匹配一个看过尝试结果和反馈后的 teacher 分布。这样既保留 on-policy 特性，又把监督细化到 token 级。对预训练研究者，这个思路和 self-distillation、latent reasoning、test-time feedback internalization 有明显接口；它提示一种更一般的方向：把昂贵的外部推理过程、反馈过程、甚至 judge 过程，蒸馏成模型内部条件分布，而不是只把最终 reward 当标量回传。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名叫 Feedback Distillation。训练时维护 student 和 teacher 两个同架构模型，初始都来自同一个预训练 LM。对一个问题 x，先由 student 采样一个尝试 y。然后构造 teacher 的条件输入：它不仅看到 x，还看到针对 y 的文本反馈 F(y)。这个反馈可以来自冻结的同模型副本，也可以来自更强的外部 LLM；在 theorem proving 场景里，反馈会结合模型尝试和 verifier 输出，指出失败原因、可用 lemma、策略修正等信息。接着，student 在自己采样出的轨迹上，最小化 teacher 与 student 的逐 token KL。因为 teacher 分布对 student 参数不反传，这个目标在梯度上等价于 teacher 分布对 student 的 token-level cross-entropy。作者采用 EMA 更新 teacher 权重，每 5 个梯度步做一次 μ ← αμ + (1-α)θ，这一点对稳定性很关键。为降低计算量，KL 只在 teacher 概率最高的 top-K token 上近似，实验里 K=25。和 GRPO 相比，这个方法有几个实质差异：第一，它不依赖多样本间 reward ranking，而是直接学习“如果看到了反馈，下一步更该怎么写”；第二，它在所有失败轨迹上也有学习信号，不会因为 reward 全零而完全学不到；第三，它更像一种 on-policy knowledge transfer，把 test-time feedback 变成 train-time teacher condition。作者也讨论了它与纯 self-feedback、外部强模型反馈、以及后续再接 GRPO 的关系，结论是二者互补而不是替代。
summary.experiments: 实验平台是 Lean 4 theorem proving，数据集是 LeanWorkbook。核心结果有两层。第一层是单独训练效果：Feedback Distillation 比 GRPO 保持更高的 policy entropy，pass@k 随 k 增长更好，说明它学到的不是单一路径上的 reward hacking，而是更丰富的证明轨迹分布。第二层是与 GRPO 结合后的效果：在 LeanWorkbook test split 上，Qwen3.5-9B 用 GRPO alone 的 pass@1 是 59%，而先做 Feedback Distillation 再接 GRPO 可以到 75%。这个提升幅度很大，说明蒸馏阶段提供的不是简单 warm start，而是更好的探索起点和更密的局部学习信号。论文还分析了不同反馈来源的差异，以及 EMA 系数对训练稳定性的影响。作者明确指出 α 对性能和稳定性都很敏感，这意味着方法虽然有效，但 recipe 还没有“随便训都行”那么稳。另一个值得注意的观察是，Feedback Distillation 在多样性指标上优于 GRPO，这与近期一些关于 GRPO 倾向于收缩到已有高奖模式的结论是一致的。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看 Introduction，把作者为什么不满足于 SFT+GRPO 讲得很清楚。然后直接看方法部分的 loss 定义，重点理解 teacher 看到的 privileged feedback 是什么、student 在什么轨迹上学、以及为什么这是 token-level credit assignment。实验部分优先看性能主表和 policy entropy / pass@k 的分析图，这两处最能体现它和 GRPO 的差异。再看 Section 5 里关于 feedback source 和 EMA 稳定性的讨论，能帮助判断方法的可迁移性与工程难点。预计 30 分钟左右可以完成一次有效泛读；如果你关心 RL for reasoning 或 verifier-based training，值得细看 appendix 里的 loss 推导和训练细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a familiar weakness of the standard SFT+GRPO recipe for verifiable reasoning tasks: sparse rewards, weak exploration, mode collapse, and poor credit assignment from trajectory-level rewards. Instead of proposing yet another RL variant, it asks whether one can train the model on-policy with token-level supervision by distilling a feedback-conditioned policy back into the model. The intended benefit is better exploration and higher trajectory diversity in formal theorem proving, where success depends on searching large libraries and not just exploiting a narrow set of already-known proof patterns.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training paper, but it matters for foundation-model research because it speaks to two broader questions. First, does RL actually create new reasoning behavior, or mostly amplify modes that already exist? Second, how can external feedback be converted into a denser and more learnable training signal? The paper's answer is to replace pure reward optimization with a self-distillation style objective: let the model imitate a version of itself, or a stronger model, that has access to privileged textual feedback about its own attempt. That makes the signal token-level, on-policy, and potentially more informative than a scalar verifier reward. For pretraining-oriented readers, the interesting part is the interface to self-distillation, internalizing test-time feedback, and learning richer conditional distributions rather than only optimizing end rewards.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, Feedback Distillation, maintains a student and a teacher with the same architecture, both initialized from the same pretrained LM. For a problem x, the student first samples an attempted proof y. The teacher is then conditioned not only on x but also on textual feedback F(y), which is generated from the attempt and, in this setting, can incorporate verifier output. The feedback may come from a frozen copy of the same model or from a stronger external LLM. Training minimizes the per-token KL divergence between the teacher and student distributions along trajectories sampled from the student. Since gradients do not flow through the teacher distribution, this is equivalent in practice to token-level cross-entropy from the teacher to the student on the student's own rollouts. The teacher weights are updated by EMA every five gradient steps, using μ ← αμ + (1-α)θ, and the paper emphasizes that α is critical for stability. To reduce cost, the KL is approximated using only the teacher's top-K tokens, with K=25 in the reported experiments. Compared with GRPO, the method differs in three important ways. It does not rely on ranking multiple sampled trajectories by reward. It provides learning signal even when all sampled attempts fail. And it can be viewed as on-policy knowledge transfer: the model learns what it would do if it had access to richer feedback at generation time, then absorbs that behavior into its parameters.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on Lean 4 theorem proving using LeanWorkbook. The main empirical result is twofold. First, Feedback Distillation alone maintains higher policy entropy than GRPO and shows better pass@k scaling, indicating a broader and more diverse proof distribution rather than collapse onto a small set of high-reward modes. Second, the method combines well with GRPO instead of replacing it. On the LeanWorkbook test split, Qwen3.5-9B reaches 59% pass@1 with GRPO alone, while Feedback Distillation followed by GRPO reaches 75% pass@1. That is a large gain, and it suggests the distillation stage is doing more than providing a mild warm start. It appears to improve exploration and local credit assignment before reward optimization takes over. The paper also studies different feedback sources and training stability. A notable practical point is that the EMA coefficient α strongly affects both performance and stability, so the method is promising but not yet a plug-and-play recipe. The diversity findings also align with recent critiques that GRPO often sharpens pre-existing successful modes rather than expanding the search distribution.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction. It gives a clear motivation for moving beyond the usual SFT+GRPO pipeline. Then read the loss definition carefully: what privileged feedback the teacher sees, why the student learns on its own sampled trajectories, and how this yields token-level credit assignment. In the experiments, prioritize the main performance table and the analyses of policy entropy and pass@k. Those are the clearest evidence for the claimed advantage over GRPO. After that, read the section on feedback sources and EMA stability, since that is where the practical limitations and transfer questions show up. A solid skim takes about 30 minutes. If you work on RL for reasoning or verifier-based training, the appendix derivations and implementation details are worth the extra time.

recommendation.zh: 核心 insight：feedback distillation 比纯 GRPO 保持更高策略多样性，两者组合优于单独使用。对 reasoning 模型 post-training recipe 设计有直接参考，看 §3 方法和 §4 pass@k scaling 曲线。
recommendation.en: Key insight: feedback distillation preserves higher policy diversity than GRPO alone, and combining both is better. Directly relevant for reasoning model post-training recipe design—read §3 method and §4 pass@k scaling curves.

paper.title: Same Evidence, Different Answers: Canonical-Context On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Turn Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often solve a task when all instructions are given in a single prompt, but fail when the same information is revealed gradually across turns. When a clean FULL prompt and a RAW-SHARDED conversation contain the same complete user evidence, the model should still arrive at the same answer. We argue that a key reason for this gap is self-anchored drift: responses produced under partial information introduce unsupported assumptions, and those assumptions later distort th

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是多轮对话里的一个很具体、也很常见的失真：同一任务如果一次性给全信息，模型能答对；如果把完全相同的用户证据拆到多轮里逐步给出，模型最后却可能答错。作者把这个要求定义为 canonical-context consistency。全文的关键判断是，问题不只是“上下文变长”或“信息分散”，而是模型早期在证据不完整时生成的中间回复，会把未经支持的假设、 tentative answer 或局部推理写进上下文，后续解码又被这些自生成文本牵引，形成 self-anchored drift。论文要解决的核心，不是让模型学会额外反思或外部修复，而是让模型在最终证据已经齐备时，能重新锚定到完整用户证据，而不是继续沿着自己 earlier turns 的错误轨迹走下去。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练接口的启发主要有三点。第一，它把多轮一致性问题从“agent orchestration”或“inference-time repair”拉回到模型参数内部能力，说明这类失真可以通过训练目标直接矫正，而不一定依赖外部控制环。第二，它提出的 teacher 不是更强模型，而是同一 backbone 在 canonical Full prompt 下的自身能力，这一点很重要：它把问题表述成“保住模型本来就有、但在污染上下文下丢失的能力”，而不是传统蒸馏里从强教师迁移能力。第三，作者只用 sharded GSM8K 风格数学对话做训练，却在五类非数学任务上拿到 zero-shot 改善，说明这种信号学到的不是狭义数学技巧，而更像一种对最终证据重 grounding、抑制 assistant-side anchor 的通用行为偏置。对做 post-train recipe、continual pretrain、multi-turn SFT 的人，这个角度是有参考价值的。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Canonical-Context On-Policy Distillation，简称 CCOPD。训练时同一个 base model 分成两个角色。冻结的 teacher 看到 clean canonical Full prompt，也就是把全部用户证据一次性给全；可训练的 student 只看到 Raw-Sharded 多轮历史，也就是用户证据被拆成多轮，并且中间夹着 student 自己在信息不完整时生成的回复。关键监督只发生在“最终答案阶段”：当所有 task-relevant evidence 都已经在多轮里揭示完之后，student 先按自己的当前策略生成 final answer prefix，teacher 再在相同 prefix 下、但基于 Full prompt 计算 token 分布，对 student 做 same-prefix distillation。这里有两个设计点值得注意。其一，它是 on-policy 的，因为监督建立在 student 自己生成的答案前缀上，而不是离线 teacher forcing 到某条固定参考答案；这样训练时能直接覆盖那些由 student 自己 earlier mistakes 导致的偏移轨迹。其二，它采用 reverse-KL 风格的 token-level distillation，目标是把 student 在污染历史下的分布拉回 Full-context teacher 的分布。作者强调 same-prefix 很关键，因为如果 prefix 不对齐，teacher 和 student 会在不同解码轨道上比较，监督会变弱甚至失真。论文还把 canonical-context consistency 形式化为 task-equivalent presentation 下 final-answer distribution 的不变性，并定义了一个在共享答案前缀下比较 next-token 分布差异的局部诊断量，用来定位 presentation sensitivity 在哪些前缀位置最严重。与已有做法相比，CCOPD 不改推理流程，不加反思/重写 loop，也不要求模型先学会澄清提问；它直接针对“最终证据已齐但仍被旧回复污染”的情形做参数更新。
summary.experiments: 实验设置围绕 task-equivalent sharding 展开，核心比较三种输入形式：Full、Concat、Raw-Sharded。Full 是一次性完整提示；Concat 是把多轮用户证据拼接但去掉中间 assistant 污染；Raw-Sharded 则保留真实多轮结构和中间模型回复。CCOPD 只在 sharded GSM8K-style math conversations 上训练，但评测覆盖六个任务家族，其中五个是非数学 zero-shot 迁移。主结果是：相对未修改 base model，Raw-Sharded 表现平均相对提升 32%，同时 Full 和 Concat 基本保持，不出现明显能力回退。这个结果说明它不是简单把模型推向某种保守回答风格，否则 Full/Concat 也会受损。消融部分给出的信息量比较足。作者比较了 canonical Full teacher 与其他替代监督，结论是收益确实来自“对齐同模型在 Full 视角下的行为”，而不是任意蒸馏都行。进一步地，当同一 backbone 在 Full prompt 下已经足够强时，继续增大 teacher scale 带来的额外收益有限，这支持作者的论点：问题主要不是 teacher 不够强，而是 student 在污染上下文里丢失了原本已有的能力。matched pollution tests 显示，经过 CCOPD 后模型对 assistant-side anchors 的敏感性下降；evidence-focus probes 则表明最终答案更依赖完整用户证据，而不是 earlier assistant text。论文还报告了与 data-matched post-training baselines 的比较，CCOPD 在 Raw-Sharded 设定下更优，说明收益不是单纯来自“多看一些多轮数学数据”。摘要里没有给出参数量和训练 token 规模，正文片段也未见完整表格，因此这两项无法可靠补全。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先抓三处。第一看 Introduction 和 Problem Statement，重点理解 canonical-context consistency 与 self-anchored drift 的定义，这决定了整篇工作的边界：它处理的是 task-equivalent、最终证据齐备后的偏移，不是一般性的对话歧义。第二看方法部分里 same-prefix on-policy distillation 的训练流程图和目标函数，尤其要弄清为什么 student 先生成 prefix、teacher 再在 Full prompt 下对齐这个 prefix；这是方法真正有别于普通 KD 的地方。第三看 ablation 和 diagnostics，尤其是 canonical teacher 替换实验、teacher scale 实验、matched pollution test、evidence-focus probe。这几组实验共同回答“为什么有效”。如果时间有限，30-40 分钟足够把方法和主要证据链读明白；如果要精读，建议把 Raw-Sharded / Concat / Full 三种 presentation 的差异和每个 baseline 的 supervision source 逐一画出来，否则很容易把收益误解成普通多轮 SFT 效果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a specific failure mode in multi-turn interaction: a model can solve a task when all user evidence is presented in one clean prompt, yet fail when the exact same evidence is revealed incrementally across turns. The authors call the desired invariance canonical-context consistency. Their main diagnosis is sharper than “longer context hurts.” In a raw sharded dialogue, the context contains the model’s own earlier replies produced under incomplete evidence. Those replies may inject unsupported assumptions, partial reasoning, or premature answers, and the model later conditions on that self-generated text instead of re-grounding on the now-complete user evidence. This is the self-anchored drift the method is designed to reduce.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining and post-training research, the contribution is less about a new benchmark and more about a training view of multi-turn reliability. First, it treats consistency across equivalent presentations as an internal model capability, not merely an inference-time orchestration problem. Second, the teacher is not a stronger external model; it is the same backbone under a cleaner conditioning context. That reframes the task as preserving capabilities the model already has under canonical prompts but loses under contaminated histories. Third, the transfer result matters: training only on sharded GSM8K-style math conversations improves raw-sharded performance beyond math, including five zero-shot non-math settings. That suggests the learned signal is not narrow mathematical supervision but a more general tendency to re-anchor on complete user evidence and discount assistant-side anchors. This is relevant to multi-turn SFT, continual post-training, and any recipe that mixes dialogue trajectories with partially observed tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, Canonical-Context On-Policy Distillation (CCOPD), uses the same base model in two roles. A frozen teacher sees the canonical Full prompt containing all task-relevant user evidence at once. A trainable student sees only the Raw-Sharded interaction, where the same evidence is disclosed gradually and interleaved with the student’s own earlier responses. Supervision is applied only once all relevant evidence has been revealed and the model is producing the final answer. The student first generates its own final-answer prefix under the sharded history. Then the teacher, conditioned on the Full prompt and the same answer prefix, provides token-level supervision for the next-token distribution. Two design choices are central. One is on-policy supervision: the training signal is attached to the student’s own decoding trajectory, so the method directly addresses trajectories that were already perturbed by earlier self-generated contamination. The other is same-prefix alignment: teacher and student are compared under the same answer prefix, which avoids a mismatch between different decoding paths and makes the distillation target local and actionable. The paper frames this as a reverse-KL style distillation objective that pulls the student’s distribution under contaminated history toward the canonical distribution under complete evidence. Unlike reflection loops, reset mechanisms, or clarification policies, CCOPD does not alter inference-time control flow. It updates model parameters so that once the evidence is complete, the model is more likely to recover the canonical answer behavior.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation is built around task-equivalent presentation modes: Full, Concat, and Raw-Sharded. Full is the clean one-shot prompt. Concat concatenates the user evidence without preserving the assistant’s intermediate replies. Raw-Sharded keeps the actual multi-turn structure and therefore preserves contamination from the model’s own earlier turns. CCOPD is trained only on sharded GSM8K-style math conversations, but tested on six task families, five of them non-math in zero-shot transfer. The headline result is a 32% average relative improvement over the unmodified base model on Raw-Sharded performance, while largely preserving Full and Concat performance. That preservation matters because it suggests the method is not simply making the model more cautious or generic. The ablations are informative. Gains are tied to alignment with the canonical Full-view teacher rather than arbitrary distillation targets. When the model’s own Full-prompt behavior is already strong, scaling up the teacher yields limited extra benefit, which supports the paper’s claim that the bottleneck is not lack of capability under Full context but failure to retain that capability under contaminated histories. Matched pollution tests show reduced sensitivity to assistant-side anchors, and evidence-focus probes indicate stronger grounding in completed user evidence. The paper also compares against data-matched post-training baselines and reports stronger Raw-Sharded gains for CCOPD. The provided text does not expose reliable parameter counts or training-token totals, so those should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and problem formulation. The key is to understand the distinction between equivalent evidence and different presentation, and why the failure is attributed to self-generated contamination rather than missing information. Then read the training objective carefully, especially the same-prefix on-policy setup. That is the part that differentiates CCOPD from ordinary knowledge distillation or standard multi-turn SFT. After that, go straight to the ablations and diagnostics: canonical teacher substitutions, teacher-scale analysis, matched pollution tests, and evidence-focus probes. Those sections explain why the method works and what it is actually changing in model behavior. For a quick pass, 30 to 40 minutes is enough to extract the main idea and evidence. For a deeper read, it helps to explicitly map the supervision source for Full, Concat, and Raw-Sharded settings; otherwise the gains can be mistaken for generic dialogue fine-tuning effects.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改 pretrain prior，但把多轮退化明确归因到 on-policy 假设漂移；先看方法图和误差分解，若你做对话式 post-train 或 latent reasoning，很值得复现。
recommendation.en: It does not change pretraining priors, but it gives a clean training handle on multi-turn drift; read the method figure and error decomposition first, and replicate if you care about dialogue post-training or latent reasoning.

paper.title: Reasoning-preserved Efficient Distillation of Large Language Models via Activation-aware Initialization
paper.abstract: Efficient Distillation (EDistill) compresses large language models (LLMs) by structured pruning parameters and tuning lightweight modules with high training efficiency. Although these EDistilled LLMs achieve state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on general ability benchmarks relative to similarly sized LLMs, we identify a severe degradation in their multi-step reasoning ability, which we term reasoning collapse. We systematically analyze the geometric origins of reasoning collapse and show that th

summary.core_problem: 这项工作关注高效蒸馏后小模型在多步推理上出现的“reasoning collapse”：模型在通用能力 benchmark 上看起来恢复不错，但数学推理和代码生成明显退化。
summary.importance: 对预训练和模型压缩研究的启发在于，它把蒸馏失败从“容量不够”或“训练数据不够”推进到表示几何层面。宽度压缩类 EDistill 方法通过可学习投影矩阵对齐 teacher 和 student 的 hidden size，训练成本低，但随机初始化会让隐藏表示的 effective rank 下降。这个现象说明，压缩后的表示子空间是否保持足够多的独立方向，可能直接影响多步推理能力。对于想用大模型裁剪得到小模型的训练流程，这比只看 MMLU、常识问答等平均分更有诊断意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名为 RED，核心是 activation-aware initialization。已有宽度压缩方法 LRC 在 teacher 中插入可学习投影矩阵，用较小 hidden size 的 student 去复用 frozen teacher 的大部分结构。问题在于随机初始化的投影矩阵奇异值分布不均，训练时奇异值梯度与奇异值大小成比例，较大的方向会继续放大，最后表示空间被少数方向主导，token 表示变得更难区分。RED 不用随机矩阵初始化投影，而是先在一个小 calibration dataset 上收集 teacher activation，估计不同 channel 的重要性，再把投影矩阵初始化为 channel-selection matrix。这样初始化时被选中的奇异值为 1，未选方向被显式舍弃，避免一开始就引入随机混合带来的奇异值偏置。区别在于，RED 先保留 teacher 已经形成的关键子空间，再训练轻量模块；LRC 则让一个随机投影在训练中自己学会对齐，容易先破坏表示秩。
summary.experiments: 给出的正文片段没有包含完整表格分数，但实验设计信息比较清楚。作者在 Llama 和 Qwen 系列上比较 RED、LRC、depth-reduced EDistill、LoRA-style recovery、full-parameter retraining 等路线，并保持与 LRC 相同训练条件。观察重点包括两类：一是通用能力 benchmark，二是多步推理任务，如 mathematical reasoning 和 code generation。主要结果是 RED 在维持 EDistill 高训练效率的同时，恢复了 reasoning benchmark 上的性能，并在 general ability 与 reasoning 两类指标上优于同等压缩规模下的对比方法。机制实验围绕 effective rank 和投影矩阵奇异值展开：LRC 的 hidden representation 出现 eRank collapse，RED 的投影矩阵奇异值分布更均匀，hidden representation 保留更多有效方向。引言还给出训练小模型的成本背景：SmolLM2-1.7B 从头训练使用约 11T tokens，数百张 A100 训练数周，成本约 25 万美元，用来说明压缩恢复路线的现实动机。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 25–35 分钟。优先看 Section 4 中 reasoning collapse 的定义和诊断方式，再看理论部分关于投影矩阵奇异值梯度与 eRank collapse 的推导。方法部分重点看 activation-aware channel selection 的具体重要性估计方式，以及投影矩阵如何被构造成 channel-selection matrix。实验部分建议重点找三类图表：reasoning benchmark 与 general benchmark 的分项结果、hidden representation 的 effective rank 曲线、投影矩阵 singular value 分布。真正值得深挖的是诊断范式：模型压缩不只比较平均准确率，还要检查表示秩、token distinguishability 和推理任务之间的关系。

summary_en.core_problem: The work studies a failure mode of efficient distillation: compressed LLMs can recover general benchmark performance while losing multi-step reasoning ability in math and code.
summary_en.importance: The useful point for pretraining and compression research is the diagnosis. The paper argues that reasoning degradation is not only a capacity or data issue. In width-reduced efficient distillation, learnable projection matrices can reduce the effective rank of hidden states. Once representations collapse into a few dominant directions, tokens become less distinguishable, which is especially harmful for multi-step reasoning. This gives a concrete signal to monitor when turning a large pretrained model into a smaller deployable model.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, RED, uses activation-aware initialization for projection matrices. Prior width-reduction methods such as LRC insert trainable projections into a frozen teacher to align dimensions with a smaller student. With random initialization, the singular values of these projections can become uneven. The paper’s analysis states that singular-value gradients are proportional to the singular values themselves, so already-large directions grow faster and dominate the representation space. RED replaces random initialization with channel-selection initialization. It first collects teacher activations on a small calibration set, estimates channel importance, and initializes the projection as a selection matrix over important channels. At initialization, selected singular values are set to 1, which avoids the early random mixing that causes rank imbalance.
summary_en.experiments: The provided manuscript excerpt does not include the full numerical tables, but the experimental setup is clear. RED is evaluated on Llama and Qwen model families under the same training conditions as LRC, and is compared with full-parameter recovery, LoRA-style recovery, depth-reduced efficient distillation, and width-reduced efficient distillation. The key evaluations cover both general ability benchmarks and multi-step reasoning tasks, especially mathematical reasoning and code generation. The reported finding is that RED keeps the efficiency advantage of EDistill while recovering reasoning performance. Diagnostic experiments track effective rank of hidden states and singular-value distributions of projection matrices: LRC shows eRank collapse, while RED keeps a more balanced spectrum. The introduction also motivates the setting with the cost of training SmolLM2-1.7B from scratch: around 11T tokens, weeks on hundreds of A100 GPUs, and roughly $250K.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–35 minute skim is enough. Read the reasoning-collapse diagnosis first, then the theoretical section on singular values and effective-rank collapse. In the method section, focus on how activation statistics are collected and how the channel-selection projection is constructed. In the experiments, look for three kinds of evidence: reasoning versus general benchmark scores, effective-rank curves of hidden representations, and singular-value spectra of projection matrices. The most reusable part is the diagnostic framing for compressed LLMs: average benchmark recovery can hide representation collapse that hurts reasoning.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是“推理塌缩=表示有效秩塌缩”这条诊断线，不一定放之四海皆准，但做压缩/蒸馏的人应立刻复现 eRank 分析。
recommendation.en: The useful part is the diagnosis that reasoning collapse tracks effective-rank collapse; it may not generalize universally, but anyone doing compression or distillation should reproduce the eRank analysis.

paper.title: Veda: Scalable Video Diffusion via Distilled Sparse Attention
paper.abstract: Scaling Diffusion Transformers to generate high-resolution, long videos is constrained by the quadratic cost of self-attention, and existing sparse attention methods degrade under high sparsity. We show empirically that generation quality is determined not by the sparsity ratio itself, but by how well the sparse mask aligns with the tile-wise geometry of full attention. Based on this insight, we propose Veda, a distilled sparse attention framework that formulates tile selection as an explicit re

summary.core_problem: 解决高分辨率长视频 Diffusion Transformer 中自注意力二次复杂度过高、常规稀疏注意力在高稀疏率下质量下降的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率和注意力系统优化，重点不在 LLM 预训练，但其“从 full attention 蒸馏稀疏 mask”的思路对长上下文注意力稀疏化和视频生成模型服务有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: Veda 将 tile 选择建模为对 full attention 的显式重建问题，而不是手工设定稀疏模式；使用 statistics-aware tile scoring 降低估计误差，使用 head-aware tiling 减少不同 attention head 的结构错配，并配套 tile-skipping kernel 将稀疏性转成实际 wall-clock 加速。
summary.experiments: 在大型视频扩散模型 Waver 和 Wan2.1 上测试，目标包括 720P、10 秒视频生成；摘要称在无明显生成质量下降的情况下取得显著加速，但未给出具体稀疏率、延迟、吞吐或质量指标数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the quadratic self-attention cost in high-resolution long-video diffusion transformers, where naive sparse attention tends to degrade quality at high sparsity.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-efficiency and attention-systems contribution. It is not LLM pretraining work, but the full-attention-distilled sparse-mask idea is relevant to long-context sparsification and large generative-model serving.
summary_en.technical_approach: Veda formulates tile selection as an explicit reconstruction problem against full attention rather than relying on fixed sparse patterns. It combines statistics-aware tile scoring, head-aware tiling, and a hardware-oriented tile-skipping kernel to make sparsity translate into wall-clock speedups.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on large video diffusion models including Waver and Wan2.1, targeting settings such as 720P 10-second video generation. The abstract reports substantial acceleration without noticeable quality loss, but does not provide exact latency, sparsity, throughput, or quality numbers.

recommendation.zh: 不必通读；看 tile 重建目标和 kernel 部分即可，判断它能否迁移到长上下文 LLM 稀疏注意力。
recommendation.en: Do not read end to end; inspect the tile-reconstruction objective and kernel section to judge transferability to sparse long-context LLM attention.

paper.title: minWM: A Full-Stack Open-Source Framework for Real-Time Interactive Video World Models
paper.abstract: Recent video diffusion foundation models have achieved remarkable progress in high-quality video generation, yet turning them into real-time interactive video world models remains challenging. Interactive world models require controllable, causal, and low-latency rollout, which in practice demands a full pipeline spanning data construction, controllable fine-tuning, autoregressive training, few-step distillation, and streaming inference. In this work, we present minWM, a full-stack open-source f

summary.core_problem: 现有视频扩散基础模型能生成高质量离线视频，但缺乏实时交互式世界模型所需的因果滚动、用户动作响应和低延迟能力。同时，将离线视频生成器转化为实时互动世界模型涉及数据构建、可控微调、AR训练、少步蒸馏和流式推理等分散技术，缺少一个统一、可复现的端到端框架。
summary.importance: 提供了第一个完整开源的从视频扩散基础模型到实时交互式视频世界模型的转换pipeline。其两阶段方法论（可控微调+因果强制蒸馏）展示了如何系统地将通用预训练生成能力迁移到专用交互场景，这种范式对预训练模型的下游适配（尤其是在视频/多模态领域）有方法论参考价值。框架的模块化设计和实际消融分析也为相关研究提供了可复现的工程基线。
summary.technical_approach: minWM是一个全栈开源框架，遵循两阶段方案：(1) 相机控制训练：在标注或生成的相机轨迹视频数据上微调双向视频扩散骨干，使其能遵循指定相机轨迹；(2) 因果强制转换：用Causal Forcing或Causal Forcing++将多步双向模型转化为少步自回归生成器，包括teacher-forcing AR扩散训练、因果ODE/因果一致性蒸馏初始化、非对称DMD后训练+自rollout。框架模块化，支持替换不同视频骨干、控制信号和训练配方。
summary.experiments: 在Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B（cross-attention条件注入）和HY1.5-TI2V-8B（MMDiT架构）两个开源骨干上完成了完整实例化，展示了从双向基础模型到实时相机可控AR世界模型的端到端转换。也支持对现有视频世界模型（如HY-WorldPlay）向新数据分布、训练配方和延迟目标的适配。报告了相机轨迹质量、可控性训练步数和最小batch size等实际工程消融结果，提供了可操作的训练指导。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点看第1章的框架定位和两阶段设计概览，第2章的方法流程（特别是2.1相机控制训练和因果强制蒸馏的具体步骤），以及消融实验部分的实际工程guidance。预计阅读时间25-35分钟。
summary.authors_note: 涉及HY-WorldPlay（腾讯混元相关）和Wan2.1等模型，可能是腾讯或相关研究团队工作，具体机构信息未在提供内容中明确。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing video diffusion foundation models generate high-quality offline videos but lack the causal rollout, user-action responsiveness, and low-latency capabilities required for real-time interactive world models. Converting an offline video generator into a real-time interactive world model involves scattered techniques spanning data construction, controllable fine-tuning, AR training, few-step distillation, and streaming inference — a unified, reproducible end-to-end pipeline is missing.
summary_en.importance: Delivers the first complete open-source pipeline for converting video diffusion foundation models into real-time interactive video world models. Its two-phase methodology (controllable fine-tuning + causal forcing distillation) demonstrates a systematic approach to transferring general pretrained generative capabilities to specialized interactive scenarios. This paradigm offers methodological insights for downstream adaptation of pretrained models, particularly in video/multimodal domains. The modular design and practical ablation analyses provide a reproducible engineering baseline.
summary_en.technical_approach: minWM is a full-stack open-source framework following a two-phase recipe: (1) Camera control training: fine-tune a bidirectional video diffusion backbone on camera-annotated or camera-generated video data, enabling it to follow prescribed camera trajectories; (2) Causal forcing conversion: apply Causal Forcing or Causal Forcing++ to transform the multi-step bidirectional model into a few-step autoregressive generator, including teacher-forcing AR diffusion training, causal ODE/causal consistency distillation initialization, and asymmetric DMD post-training with self-rollout. The framework is modular, supporting interchangeable video backbones, control signals, and training recipes.
summary_en.experiments: Complete instantiations on two open-source backbones: Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B (cross-attention condition injection) and HY1.5-TI2V-8B (MMDiT architecture), demonstrating end-to-end conversion from bidirectional foundation models to real-time camera-controllable AR world models. Also supports adaptation of existing video world models (e.g., HY-WorldPlay) to new data distributions, training recipes, and latency targets. Reports practical ablation results on camera trajectory quality, controllability training steps, and minimal batch-size requirements, providing actionable training guidance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Chapter 1 for framework positioning and the two-phase design overview, Chapter 2 for the methodological pipeline (especially Sec 2.1 camera control training and causal forcing distillation steps), and the ablation section for practical engineering guidance. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Involves HY-WorldPlay (Tencent Hunyuan-related) and Wan2.1 models, likely from Tencent or affiliated research teams. Specific institution details not explicitly stated in the provided content.

recommendation.zh: 看 pipeline 比看分数更有用；AR diffusion、causal distillation、streaming inference 的接口值得复用。
recommendation.en: The pipeline matters more than the scores; the AR diffusion, causal distillation, and streaming-inference interfaces are worth mining.

paper.title: SGMD: Score Gradient Matching Distillation for Few-Step Video Diffusion Distillation
paper.abstract: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) is a widely used paradigm for accelerating inference in few-step video diffusion models. However, DMD-style video distillation faces two coupled challenges: the fake score must track a continuously evolving generator, making training costly when frequent updates are required, while reverse-KL-style matching can be mode-seeking and conservative for preserving strong motion dynamics. To address these issues, we propose \textbf{Score Gradient Matching Distil

summary.core_problem: DMD-style video diffusion distillation has two coupled issues: fake score must track evolving generator (high training cost), and reverse-KL matching is mode-seeking/conservative for motion dynamics.
summary.importance: Method innovation: Score Gradient Matching Distillation (SGMD) as a new distillation paradigm for few-step video diffusion models.
summary.technical_approach: Directly optimizes fake score toward teacher score, using teacher stop-gradient Fisher as stable distribution-matching objective. Dual potentials: negative-residual (NR) for outer-loop correction and residual-contraction (RC) for inner-loop tracking.
summary.experiments: Empirically outperforms DMD2. Authors from Chinese Academy of Sciences, CUHK, Beihang, with Dahua Lin (CUHK) on the author list.
summary.authors_note: Chinese Academy of Sciences, CUHK (Dahua Lin), Beihang University

summary_en.core_problem: DMD-style video diffusion distillation suffers from costly tracking of evolving generator and conservative reverse-KL matching that suppresses motion dynamics.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: Score Gradient Matching Distillation (SGMD), a new distillation paradigm for few-step video diffusion acceleration.
summary_en.technical_approach: Direct fake score optimization toward teacher via stop-gradient Fisher matching objective. Dual potentials: negative-residual (NR) for outer-loop correction and residual-contraction (RC) for inner-loop tracking.
summary_en.experiments: Outperforms DMD2 empirically. Author list includes Dahua Lin (CUHK).
summary_en.authors_note: Chinese Academy of Sciences, CUHK (Dahua Lin), Beihang University

recommendation.zh: 视频diffusion蒸馏方法，distillation机制对推理加速有参考价值，但核心应用域是视频生成，LLM研究员仅需知晓概念。
recommendation.en: Video diffusion distillation method. The distillation mechanism has some transfer value for inference acceleration but the domain is video generation — LLM researchers only need conceptual awareness.

paper.title: Less is More: Early Stopping Rollout for On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation has recently emerged as a promising alternative to standard sequence-level imitation, training a student by scoring its own rollouts with a teacher model. However, we observe ``Off-policy Teacher Decay'' problem in this paradigm: for the later tokens, with student's earlier trajectory as context that is off-policy to the teacher, the teacher's ability to produce a corrective score would decay, and may fall back to token-completion behavior learned in the pre-training stage

summary.core_problem: On-policy distillation（OPD）用 teacher 对 student 自己 rollouts 的每个 token 给 soft target/密集奖励。但在长输出里，teacher 在后段 token 的评分会因为 conditioning 在 student 的 off-policy 前缀上而“失真”，逐渐退化成预训练式的 token completion，而不是对齐后的纠错分布。论文要解决的是：如何在不改 OPD 主框架的情况下，缓解这种 late-token 的 off-policy teacher decay，并提升稳定性与效率。
summary.importance: 对训练动态与对齐信号质量有直接启发：它把 OPD 里一个常被忽略的“位置维度分布漂移”问题显式化，并给出极简修复（截断 rollout）。这对 post-training recipe 很实用，尤其是跨家族/跨代 teacher-student 组合时的稳定性。对预训练本身不是方法贡献，但对“如何让 teacher 信号在长序列上保持语义对齐而非退回 next-token completion”这一类问题有普遍性，可能影响后续的 distillation/RLHF/RLAIF 训练设计。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 Early Stopping Rollout（ESR）：student 只生成前 N 个 response tokens，只在这段 early window 上计算 OPD 的 token-level distillation loss（teacher 条件在 prompt + student 前缀）。实现上是 OPD loop 的一行改动。
核心机制判断：
- Off-policy Teacher Decay：随着位置 t 增大，teacher 需要在越来越长的 student 前缀 y^S_{<t} 上条件化；该前缀对 teacher 来说是 off-policy，导致 teacher 的“可恢复性”下降，评分不再代表 teacher 的对齐后策略。
- 论文用 recoverability gap 来度量：比较 teacher 从原 prompt 解题的准确率 A_T(x) 与从 student 前缀继续的准确率 A_T(x | y^S_{<t})，差值随 t 增大。
- ESR 的直觉是：只在 teacher 仍处于“自然推理状态”的早期位置蒸馏，避免把后段的退化分布当成监督信号。
作者进一步给出两个解释性现象：
1）Cascading Alignment：只训练早期窗口，未训练的后段 token 的 KL 也会下降 30–40%，说明早期对齐会通过前缀分布改善后续生成。
2）Sub-mode Commitment：ESR 训练的 student 可能收敛到 teacher 支持的某个子模态，而不是追逐 teacher 的主模态；该子模态在某些任务上可能更好，因此出现 student 超过 teacher 的现象。
并且作者做了消融，声称“位置”效应独立于 KL/entropy 等常见信号。
summary.experiments:
主要结果（来自全文描述）：
- ESR 在 math/code/function calling 等任务上，跨训练方式（LoRA、全参微调）、跨 student 规模（1.5B–32B）、跨 teacher 规模（1.7B–72B）、跨模型家族（Qwen2.5/Qwen3、Gemma2/Gemma3）均优于 full-rollout OPD。
- 训练效率：wall-clock 最多降低 24×，峰值显存最多降低 4×（因为 rollout 更短、token-level loss 计算更少）。
- 稳定性：full-rollout OPD 在 cross-generation / cross-family 设置下更容易不稳定甚至 collapse；ESR 更稳。
- 现象验证：teacher 从 early-stopped student rollout 继续生成时，性能在约 100 tokens 后快速衰减，约 300 tokens 降到接近 student baseline（Figure 1 的描述）。
- 机制量化：Cascading Alignment 里提到未训练后段的 KL 仍下降 30–40%。
具体各任务的绝对分数/提升幅度、最佳 N 的选择曲线等需要看论文表格与超参扫描部分（提供的全文片段未包含这些表格）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（20–30 分钟）：
- 先看 Off-policy Teacher Decay 的定义与度量（recoverability gap）以及 Figure 1：这是 ESR 合理性的关键证据。
- 再看 ESR 的超参 N 如何选、对不同任务/模型是否敏感（通常会有一张 sweep 曲线或表）。
- 最后看两组解释性实验：Cascading Alignment（为什么不训练后段也能改善后段）与 Sub-mode Commitment（为什么可能超过 teacher）。
如果要落地到训练：优先确认两点——(1) 你的 OPD 是否也存在长输出场景（工具调用/代码/长推理），(2) teacher 在 off-policy 前缀上的退化是否可复现；可先用 recoverability gap 做快速诊断。

summary_en.core_problem: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own rollouts using token-level teacher scores as soft targets. The paper identifies a failure mode in long responses: as token position increases, the teacher is conditioned on an increasingly off-policy student prefix, so the teacher’s scoring distribution decays toward generic next-token completion rather than providing aligned corrective supervision. The goal is to fix this late-token supervision pathology without changing the OPD framework.
summary_en.importance: A practical training-dynamics contribution for post-training recipes: it isolates “position-induced off-policy drift” as a distinct issue in OPD and shows a minimal intervention can improve both stability and cost, especially for cross-family or cross-generation teacher–student pairs where full-rollout OPD can collapse. While not a pretraining method, it is broadly relevant to how we preserve the quality of teacher signals over long sequences—an issue that also shows up in alignment and distillation pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Early Stopping Rollout (ESR): truncate the student rollout to the first N response tokens and compute the OPD distillation loss only on this early window. Implementation is essentially a one-line change.
Key reasoning:
- Off-policy Teacher Decay: teacher supervision at position t is conditioned on the student prefix y^S_{<t}, which is off-policy for the teacher and drifts away from the teacher’s aligned distribution.
- The paper proposes a measurable diagnostic via a recoverability gap: compare teacher accuracy from the original prompt A_T(x) versus accuracy when forced to continue from a student-generated prefix A_T(x | y^S_{<t}); the gap grows with t.
- ESR avoids training on positions where the teacher is no longer in its “natural reasoning state.”
Explanatory findings:
1) Cascading Alignment: training only early tokens reduces KL on untrained late tokens by ~30–40%, suggesting early-prefix alignment improves downstream generation distribution.
2) Sub-mode Commitment: ESR students may commit to a supported sub-mode of the teacher distribution instead of chasing the dominant mode; this can sometimes outperform the teacher.
The authors also claim position effects are not reducible to KL/entropy heuristics via ablations.
summary_en.experiments:
Reported empirical coverage:
- Tasks: math, code, function calling.
- Training regimes: LoRA and full fine-tuning.
- Scales: students 1.5B–32B; teachers 1.7B–72B.
- Families/generations: Qwen2.5/Qwen3 and Gemma2/Gemma3; ESR is notably more stable in cross-family/cross-generation settings where full-rollout OPD can collapse.
Efficiency: up to 24× wall-clock reduction and up to 4× peak memory reduction.
Diagnostics: teacher performance when continuing from an early-stopped student rollout decays quickly after ~100 tokens and reaches near-student baseline within ~300 tokens (as described for Figure 1).
Mechanism quantification: Cascading Alignment shows ~30–40% KL reduction on late tokens without directly training them.
Exact per-benchmark scores and the optimal N sweeps are not present in the provided excerpt and should be taken from the paper’s tables/plots.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Read the definition/measurement of Off-policy Teacher Decay and the main diagnostic plot (Figure 1).
- Check how N is selected and how sensitive ESR is across tasks/models (look for sweeps).
- Read the two explanatory sections: Cascading Alignment and Sub-mode Commitment.
For adoption, first reproduce the recoverability-gap diagnostic on your own OPD setup; it’s a fast way to tell whether ESR is likely to help.

recommendation.zh: 只看机制实验和 rollout 长度消融；它修正了“更 on-policy、更长轨迹更好”的直觉。
recommendation.en: Read the mechanism tests and rollout-length ablations; it corrects the intuition that longer on-policy trajectories are always better.

paper.title: You Only Align Once: Propagating Cooperative Behaviors in Multi-Agent Systems through Seed Agents
paper.abstract: Ensuring agent behaviors in distributed open multi-agent systems remains challenging, especially as populations grow and unaligned agents may exist. We show that a single aligned agent can propagate cooperative behaviors to untrained agents purely through natural language interaction, a phenomenon we term Alignment Propagation. We study this in the Red-Black Game, a team-based iterated Prisoner's Dilemma in which teammates deliberate and vote to determine their team's collective action. By disti

summary.core_problem: 论文研究开放多智能体系统中的一个对齐问题：如果无法重新训练所有 agent，是否可以只训练少量 seed agent，让合作行为通过自然语言交互传播给未训练 agent。
summary.importance: 这篇更接近 post-training 和 agent alignment，而不是基座预训练。它的启发点在于：SFT 学到的不只是静态偏好，也可能是一种可交互传播的行为策略，例如说服、稳定规范、影响群体投票。对于预训练研究，价值在于提醒数据和训练目标可以塑造模型在群体环境中的社会性能力；如果未来把多 agent interaction trace 纳入预训练或持续训练，这类指标可能比单轮指令跟随更有区分度。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Alignment Propagation。流程是先在 Red-Black Game 中评估多个 LLM 的合作表现，选择表现较好的 teacher 生成合作推理和说服性对话，再经过质量控制后蒸馏到 Qwen-3-14B，得到 seed agent。Red-Black Game 是团队版迭代囚徒困境：两队各 5 个 agent，进行 10 轮；每轮先广播理由和建议，再多数投票决定团队动作。收益结构鼓励短期背叛，但长期集体最优需要持续合作。论文还设计了场景级 OOD 和环境级 OOD：前者换叙事框架但保留游戏机制，后者迁移到 Sugarscape 网格资源竞争环境，检验 seed agent 的合作说服能力是否脱离训练场景。
summary.experiments: 在 Red-Black Game 中，把一个 SFT 后的 Qwen-3-14B seed agent 放入 4 个未训练队友中，合作率从 24.8% 提升到 62.2%。seed agent 还超过了带合作 prompt 的 teacher Kimi-K2，以及 vanilla Gemini-3.1-Pro。环境级 OOD 的 Sugarscape 中，seed agent 未额外训练即可把 trade success rate 从 21.6% 提升到 91.5%。论文还测试了跨架构传播：Qwen-SFT seed 能影响 LLaMA-3.1-8B 和 Mistral-Small-3.1-24B 队友，但不同模型的可说服性不同。作者强调，这种提升不能只用模型能力解释，更接近 SFT 注入的主动说服与规范稳定能力。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25 到 35 分钟。重点看 Red-Black Game 的机制设计、数据生成与 SFT 流程、ID/OOD/Sugarscape 三类评估设置，以及 influence shift 这类衡量 seed agent 是否真正改变他人行为的指标。对预训练方向，值得关注的是训练数据中哪些语言行为被蒸馏下来：合作理由、风险解释、互惠承诺、对背叛诱因的抑制。这比单纯看最终合作率更能判断方法是否可迁移。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies alignment in open multi-agent systems: if not every deployed agent can be retrained, can a small number of trained seed agents propagate cooperative behavior to untrained peers through natural-language interaction alone?
summary_en.importance: The work is closer to post-training and agent alignment than to foundation-model pretraining. Its main lesson is that SFT may instill not only static preferences, but also interactive behavioral policies such as persuasion, norm stabilization, and group-level influence. For pretraining research, the useful signal is that data and objectives can shape social capabilities that only appear in multi-agent dynamics. If interaction traces are later used for continual pretraining or agentic data generation, these metrics may be more informative than single-turn instruction following.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces Alignment Propagation. The pipeline first evaluates cooperative behavior across LLMs, selects a strong teacher to generate cooperative reasoning and persuasive dialogue, filters the data, and distills the behavior into a Qwen-3-14B seed agent. The main environment is the Red-Black Game, a team-based iterated Prisoner’s Dilemma. Two teams of five agents play ten rounds. In each round, agents broadcast justified recommendations and then vote by majority. The payoff structure rewards short-term defection but requires sustained cooperation for the best collective outcome. The paper evaluates three regimes: in-distribution Red-Black scenarios, scenario-level OOD with unseen narrative framings but identical mechanics, and environment-level OOD in Sugarscape, a spatial resource-competition world with local pairwise negotiation.
summary_en.experiments: In the Red-Black Game, placing one SFT Qwen-3-14B seed agent among four untrained teammates increases the cooperation rate from 24.8% to 62.2%. The seed agent outperforms the prompted teacher model, Kimi-K2, and a vanilla Gemini-3.1-Pro baseline. In the environment-level OOD Sugarscape setting, the seed transfers without additional training and raises trade success from 21.6% to 91.5%. The paper also reports cross-architecture propagation: Qwen-SFT seeds can influence LLaMA-3.1-8B and Mistral-Small-3.1-24B teammates, with different architectures showing different degrees of persuadability. The authors argue that the effect is not explained by raw capability alone, but by an SFT-induced ability to persuade and stabilize mutually beneficial norms.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–35 minute skim is appropriate. Focus on the Red-Black Game design, the teacher-data generation and SFT pipeline, the ID/OOD/Sugarscape evaluation split, and the influence-shift metric that measures whether the seed actually changes other agents’ votes. For pretraining researchers, the most relevant detail is what linguistic behavior is being distilled: cooperative reasoning, risk framing, reciprocity commitments, and resistance to short-term defection incentives. These details matter more than the final cooperation rate alone.

recommendation.zh: 读实验设计和迁移部分即可；数字很亮，但要重点查未训练 agent 是否被 prompt 泄漏或环境规则牵引。
recommendation.en: Read the experimental design and transfer section; the numbers are sharp, but check for prompt leakage and environment-induced cooperation.

paper.title: Skill0.5: Joint Skill Internalization and Utilization for Out-of-Distribution Generalization in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Equipping large language models with explicit skills has emerged as a promising paradigm for enabling autonomous agents to solve complex tasks. Agent skills can be inherently divided into general skills for broad cognitive transfer and task-specific skills for dynamic execution. However, existing skill-based reinforcement learning (RL) methods typically force a rigid choice between full externalization, which incurs prohibitive context overhead, and full internalization, which risks overfitting

summary.core_problem: 解决 agentic RL 中“技能应内化到模型参数里，还是外置到上下文里”这一两难：前者易过拟合和冲突，后者带来上下文开销，进而影响 OOD 泛化。
summary.importance: 属于 agent 后训练方法创新，不是基座预训练工作本身，但它讨论了参数内化与上下文利用的分工，这对 pretrain/post-train 接口、技能蒸馏和长期能力沉淀有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Skill0.5 框架，把技能分成通用技能与任务特定技能两类，并由一个动态、难度感知的路由器决定处理方式：通用技能通过 privileged distillation 内化进模型，作为困难任务的认知底座；任务特定技能则保留为外部可调用资源，通过诊断式策略进行利用，而不是一刀切地全部写进参数或全部放在上下文中。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练 token 或基线细节。可确认的是，论文在 OOD generalization 场景下比较了全外置、全内化以及其混合方案，主张动态分流能在复杂任务上取得更稳的泛化与效率折中。由于缺少 clean setup 细节，结论更适合作为方法线索而非强证据。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles the skill-placement dilemma in agentic RL: whether skills should be internalized into model parameters or externalized into context/tooling, with implications for OOD generalization.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to the pretrain/post-train interface because it explicitly studies what should become parametric capability versus what should remain external and task-specific.
summary_en.technical_approach: Skill0.5 splits skills into general and task-specific ones, then uses a dynamic difficulty-aware router to decide the treatment. General skills are internalized via privileged distillation to build a reusable cognitive base, while task-specific skills are kept external and utilized diagnostically rather than being fully baked into the model.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, training data scale, or detailed baselines. It does indicate comparisons against full externalization and full internalization under OOD settings, arguing that the mixed routing strategy yields a better generalization-efficiency trade-off. Without cleaner setup details, the result should be treated as a directional signal rather than a settled conclusion.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练不直接相连，但“哪些能力该写进参数、哪些该留在上下文”这个切分值得记；先看路由策略与 ablation，别急着信 OOD 结论。
recommendation.en: Not a pretrain paper, but the parametric-vs-context skill split is worth noting; read the routing ablations first and treat the OOD claims as soft evidence.

paper.title: O-MARC: Omni Memory-Augmented Compression Distillation for Efficient Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Omnimodal large language models enable unified audio video understanding, but long joint token sequences make inference costly, and existing benchmarks do not fully isolate audio visual association in noisy user generated videos. We introduce UGC-AVQA, a public UGC benchmark with 1,000 videos and 4,816 QA pairs, where an audio removal test ensures that benchmark questions require both acoustic and visual evidence. To reduce inference cost, we propose OMAC, a training free plug in compression met

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是全模态视频理解里的压缩问题：音频和视频同时输入时 token 序列很长，直接推理成本高；但简单压缩又容易删掉跨模态证据，尤其是短暂声音、场景切换、动作与声音之间的对应关系。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在文本基座训练，而在多模态 LM 的输入表示压缩和训练接口。它提醒一个关键点：音频和视频不能简单按各自冗余度独立压缩，因为很多有效信息来自二者的时间对齐和互相解释。对做 native multimodal pretrain、视频/音频 token budget 分配、长上下文多模态推理的人有参考意义。UGC-AVQA 也提供了一个更偏“音画关联”的评测切面，能减少模型只靠视觉先验答题的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 论文包含两部分。第一是 UGC-AVQA，一个面向用户生成短视频的音画关联 benchmark。样本来自公开短视频平台，共 1,000 个视频、4,816 个 QA。问题覆盖音画事件推进、场景或时间转移、跨场景音画对齐、细粒度音画对比。关键过滤步骤是 audio removal check：去掉音轨后让 Gemini-3.1-Flash 回答，只有模型在无音频条件下失败的样本才保留，以降低纯视觉可解的比例。第二是 OMAC/O-MARC。OMAC 是 training-free 插件式压缩方法，保留紧凑视觉 memory 和时间锚定的 audio anchors，并用视觉 memory 的分布来分配音频预算。这个设计的动机是：视觉里常有更稳定的场景结构，音频里可能有短但决定性的片段，因此音频压缩预算需要受视觉事件分布约束，而不是平均采样或孤立压缩。O-MARC 则进一步做 compression distillation，让较小模型在被压缩的多模态上下文上学习推理，减少推理时压缩分布和训练时完整上下文之间的不匹配。
summary.experiments: 数据方面，UGC-AVQA 的 benchmark split 包含 206 个视频、1,648 个 QA；其余 794 个视频作为训练 split。作者对 benchmark 候选和生成训练样本各抽取 30% 进行人工复核和修正。模型方面，实验覆盖 Qwen2.5-Omni-3B、7B、30B 量级。OMAC 在相近推理成本下优于直接 token compression。O-MARC 在 3B 设置下带来更明显收益；扩展到 7B 后，在总体平均分上超过同期训练式压缩 baseline。论文提供的片段没有完整表格数值，精确提升幅度需要看实验主表和各类别 breakdown。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–40 分钟。重点看三处：第一，UGC-AVQA 的构造流程，尤其是 audio removal check，这决定了评测是否真的需要音频；第二，OMAC 的 token budget 分配和视觉 memory/audio anchors 设计，这是方法的核心；第三，3B/7B/30B 上 compression ratio、准确率和推理成本的对照表。若只关心预训练，可重点看它对多模态 token 压缩训练分布的启发，而不必深读 benchmark 样例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies efficient audiovisual reasoning for omnimodal LLMs. Joint audio-video inputs create long token sequences, while naive compression can remove the short acoustic cues and cross-modal alignments needed for answering.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model research is mainly in multimodal token budgeting and the train–inference interface for compressed contexts. The useful lesson is that audio and video should not be compressed independently: decisive evidence often lies in the temporal relation between what is heard and what is seen. The UGC-AVQA benchmark is also useful as an evaluation slice for native multimodal models because it explicitly filters out questions solvable from visual priors alone.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work has two components. UGC-AVQA is a user-generated-video benchmark with 1,000 videos and 4,816 QA pairs, targeting audiovisual event progression, scene or temporal transitions, cross-scene alignment, and fine-grained contrast. A key design step is an audio-removal check: after removing the audio track, Gemini-3.1-Flash is asked to answer; only samples that fail under this setting are retained. On the method side, OMAC is a training-free plug-in compression method. It keeps compact visual memory and temporally grounded audio anchors, then allocates audio budget according to the visual memory distribution. This differs from modality-isolated compression because visual structure is used to guide where audio evidence should be preserved. O-MARC adds compression distillation, training the model to reason over memory-compressed multimodal contexts so that inference-time compressed inputs are less out-of-distribution.
summary_en.experiments: UGC-AVQA contains a benchmark split with 206 videos and 1,648 QA pairs, while the remaining 794 videos form the training split. The authors manually review and correct 30% of both benchmark candidates and generated training examples. Experiments are reported on Qwen2.5-Omni models at 3B, 7B, and 30B scales. OMAC improves over direct token compression at comparable inference cost. O-MARC gives stronger gains in the 3B setting, and the 7B version outperforms a contemporary training-based compression baseline on the overall average. Exact per-category gains require the full result tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–40 minute skim is enough for most pretraining readers. Focus on the UGC-AVQA construction pipeline, especially the audio-removal filter; the OMAC memory and audio-anchor mechanism; and the main tables comparing compression ratio, accuracy, and inference cost across 3B/7B/30B models. Readers interested in multimodal pretraining should look for how compressed-context distillation changes the model’s operating distribution, rather than spending too much time on individual QA examples.

recommendation.zh: 免训练的多模态token压缩方法有实用价值，核心看§3的OMAC设计和§4的蒸馏框架，基准构建也值得参考
recommendation.en: The training-free multimodal token compression method has practical value. Focus on §3 for OMAC design and §4 for the distillation framework; the benchmark construction is also worth referencing.

paper.title: OmniRetriever: Any-to-Any Audio-Video-Text Retrieval via Fusion-as-Teacher Distillation
paper.abstract: Unified multimodal embedding spaces have become the standard interface for cross-modal retrieval and multimodal RAG, and recent audio-video-text (AVT) encoders extend this setting to three modalities. Such encoders can produce a joint (T,V,A) embedding whenever all three modalities are available, but standard pairwise InfoNCE objectives leave this signal unused during training. We close this gap with fusion-as-teacher distillation, which treats a stop-gradient copy of the fused embedding as a te

summary.core_problem: 现有音视频文本三模态编码器训练时仅使用成对InfoNCE损失，未利用三模态同时存在时的融合嵌入信号，单模态嵌入质量受限。
summary.importance: 方法创新与数据贡献，提出融合作为教师的蒸馏策略，同时发布跨模态检索基准OmniBench。
