summary.technical_approach: 提出融合作为教师的蒸馏方法，将融合嵌入的停止梯度版本作为单模态嵌入的教师信号，结合Tuple-InfoNCE损失直接监督融合嵌入，实现任意模态间的统一检索。
summary.experiments: 训练了7B参数的OmniRetriever-7B，在6个零样本检索基准上超过闭源Gemini Embedding 2，在Clotho和SoundDescs上R@1提升13.3-18.0个百分点。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing audio-video-text encoders only use pairwise InfoNCE loss during training and do not utilize fusion embedding signals when all three modalities are available, limiting single-modal embedding quality.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation and data contribution, proposes fusion-as-teacher distillation strategy and releases OmniBench cross-modal retrieval benchmark.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes fusion-as-teacher distillation, which uses a stop-gradient copy of the fused embedding as teacher signal for single-modal embeddings, combined with Tuple-InfoNCE loss to directly supervise the fused embedding, enabling any-to-any cross-modal retrieval.
summary_en.experiments: Trained 7B-parameter OmniRetriever-7B, which outperforms closed-source Gemini Embedding 2 on six zero-shot retrieval benchmarks, with 13.3-18.0 R@1 improvement on Clotho and SoundDescs.

recommendation.zh: 多模态检索的增量改进，蒸馏思路对多模态嵌入对齐有微弱参考，作为领域文献备查即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement to multimodal retrieval. The distillation idea has weak reference for multimodal embedding alignment; keep as literature reference only.

paper.title: On-Policy Adversarial Flow Distillation for Autoregressive Video Generation
paper.abstract: Autoregressive video generators are attractive for streaming, long-horizon, and interactive applications, but distilling strong black-box teachers into causal students remains difficult. The student must learn under its own rollout distribution, whereas practical teachers may expose only prompt-conditioned completed videos and may differ in architecture, capacity, temporal design, and sampling schedule. This interface makes supervised fine-tuning off-policy, score-based distillation inapplicable

summary.core_problem: 解决黑盒视频教师模型向因果自回归视频学生模型蒸馏时的分布错配和时间信用分配问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型蒸馏方法创新。它把 on-policy imitation、Bradley-Terry 判别器和 flow-matching 更新结合起来，目标是让自回归视频生成器适配流式、长程和交互式生成场景。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Adversarial Flow Distillation。方法在同一 prompt 下分别查询教师和 rollout 当前学生，用 prompt-paired Bradley-Terry discriminator 估计教师样本与学生样本的差异，再把该差异转成 on-policy advantage，进一步作用到学生自身前向过程上的 flow-matching 更新。它不是简单 SFT，也不依赖教师暴露 score 或内部采样轨迹。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据、baseline 名称和具体指标。可确认的实验设定是异构黑盒教师到自回归视频学生的蒸馏，并强调教师与学生可在架构、容量、时间设计和采样日程上不同。
summary.authors_note: Yang You is known for large-batch optimization work such as LARS/LAMB.

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses distribution mismatch and denoising-time credit assignment when distilling black-box video teachers into causal autoregressive video students.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a distillation method for generative video models. It is relevant because it treats video generation as an on-policy student rollout problem rather than as ordinary supervised imitation from completed teacher samples.
summary_en.technical_approach: Adversarial Flow Distillation queries the teacher and rolls out the current student on matched prompts, trains a prompt-paired Bradley-Terry discriminator to estimate teacher-student discrepancy on clean samples, and converts the resulting on-policy advantage into flow-matching updates on the student's own forward process.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide parameter counts, data scale, baseline details, or metric numbers. The stated experimental setting is heterogeneous black-box teacher-to-student video distillation where teacher and student may differ in architecture, capacity, temporal design, and sampling schedule.
summary_en.authors_note: Yang You is known for large-batch optimization work such as LARS/LAMB.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法框架即可；它对LLM蒸馏的可迁移点是on-policy差异估计，不是视频指标本身。
recommendation.en: Skim the method only; the transferable idea is on-policy discrepancy estimation for distillation, not the video-generation metrics.

paper.title: The Strongest Teacher Is Not Always the Best Teacher: Student-Centric Answer Selection
paper.abstract: LLM training increasingly relies on teacher-generated supervision, from synthetic responses to reasoning traces and tool-use demonstrations. Current practice often chooses the highest-performing teacher to generate student training data, implicitly treating teacher test performance as a proxy for teaching quality. We show that this assumption can fail: even when multiple teachers provide correct answers to the same question, the answer from the strongest teacher is not necessarily the best super

summary.core_problem: 在“多教师生成、答案都正确”的前提下，如何为特定学生模型选择更合适的监督答案：教师越强并不必然越会教，强教师生成的正确答案可能对当前学生的学习更新代价更高、反而学得更差。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在数据合成/蒸馏与持续训练接口：1）把“合成数据质量”从 teacher-centric（看教师测评分）改成 student-centric（看学生当前参数状态下的学习成本）；2）提供一个可计算、近似前向的打分指标，适合在大规模合成数据管线里做在线/迭代式筛选；3）对多教师混合、self-distill、curriculum、以及 mid-train 阶段的“数据配比与难度控制”有直接可用的机制。它更偏 post-train/蒸馏 recipe，但方法论上能反哺 continual pretrain 的数据选择。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 SCAS（Student-Centric Answer Sampling）。设每个问题 q 有一组“已验证正确”的教师答案集合 A(q)，训练时不是固定选某个最强教师，而是在候选答案里按“学生中心学习成本”采样。
关键在于如何定义并高效估计学习成本：
- 从监督微调的梯度出发，考虑对学生某个权重矩阵 W 的梯度 ∂L/∂W 的平方 Frobenius 范数，作为该 (q,a) 序列对学生造成的更新负担。
- 将 token 位置划分为问题 token（conditioning, Q）与答案 token（A），把梯度范数展开成 token 两两内积的和，并分解成 AA（答案-答案）、AQ/QA（答案-问题交互）、QQ（问题-问题）三块。这个分解解释了“同样正确的答案”也会因为 token 交互结构不同而对学生产生不同更新压力。
- 为避免对每个候选答案都做反向传播，作者推导了一个 forward-only 的代理指标来近似上述学习成本（核心是用前向可得的表征与误差信号去估计梯度交互项），从而能在大候选池里快速打分。
- 训练时按该成本进行采样：优先选择低成本、与当前学生更匹配的答案，而不是默认选择最强教师的答案。整体是一个可迭代的过程：学生更新后，成本估计也随之变化，形成隐式 curriculum。
summary.experiments:
实验设置强调“控制变量”：比较不同教师的教学效果时，只在“九个教师都答对”的最大公共子集上生成训练数据，从而把差异尽量归因于答案作为监督的可学性，而不是正确率。
作者在 DeepScaleR、GSM8K、MATH 等任务上，用 Qwen2.5 不同尺寸学生做对比，观察到教师测试准确率与学生最终准确率不单调对应。
更大规模实验：从约 30 个开源/闭源模型收集候选答案，在 6 个学生基座、6 个任务上评估 SCAS。论文摘录未包含具体提升数字与统计显著性细节；需要在结果表中核对：
- SCAS 相对“选最强教师/随机选/按 teacher 分数选”的提升幅度；
- forward-only 代理与真实梯度成本的相关性；
- 采样温度/成本归一化等超参敏感性；
- 是否存在偏向短答案或模板化答案的副作用（这会影响泛化）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 45–60 分钟）：
- 先看引言里的 controlled comparison（九教师公共正确子集）与 Figure 2：这是“强教师不一定会教”的核心证据。
- 然后精读方法 2.2：forward-only 代理怎么从梯度分解落到可计算打分，哪些近似假设最关键。
- 最后看实验消融：代理相关性、不同学生规模下的收益、以及候选池大小对收益的影响。
如果只想拿来用：重点关注实现细节（验证正确性的流程、候选答案去重/过滤、以及在线更新时的计算开销）。

summary_en.core_problem: Given multiple verified-correct teacher answers per question, how to select supervision that best teaches a specific student model—since the highest-performing teacher’s answer is not necessarily the most learnable or beneficial for that student.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly to synthetic-data distillation and continual training pipelines: it reframes supervision quality as student-dependent, introduces a scalable scoring proxy that can be used in large answer pools, and implicitly implements a curriculum that adapts as the student changes. This is closer to post-training / distillation recipe work than core pretraining, but the data-selection principle is directly reusable in mid-training and continual pretraining where synthetic instruction data is mixed in.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SCAS (Student-Centric Answer Sampling) operates in a candidate-answer setting: for each question q, there is a set of verified-correct teacher answers A(q). Instead of picking the strongest teacher, SCAS samples answers according to an estimated student-centric learning cost.
The cost is motivated by gradient mechanics in SFT:
- Consider the squared Frobenius norm of the gradient on a student weight matrix W induced by the concatenated sequence x=[q;a].
- Expand the gradient norm into pairwise token interaction terms, then partition token indices into question (Q) and answer (A) positions, yielding AA (answer–answer), AQ/QA (answer–conditioning interactions), and QQ (conditioning–conditioning) blocks.
- This decomposition explains why two correct answers can differ in how much parameter change they demand from the current student.
- To avoid per-candidate backprop, the paper derives a forward-only proxy to approximate the learning cost using signals available from forward passes (representations and error-related quantities), enabling efficient scoring over large candidate pools.
Training then samples lower-cost answers more often, aligning supervision with the student’s current capabilities and effectively creating an adaptive curriculum.
summary_en.experiments:
A key design is a controlled teacher comparison: when evaluating “teaching quality,” they restrict training to the largest common subset of questions where all compared teachers are correct, so differences are not driven by answer correctness.
They test across reasoning tasks such as DeepScaleR, GSM8K, and MATH with Qwen2.5 students of multiple sizes, showing teacher test accuracy does not monotonically predict student gains.
They also collect candidate answers from ~30 open/closed models and evaluate across 6 student base models and 6 tasks. The provided excerpt does not include the exact deltas; in the full paper, the critical checks are: SCAS vs strongest-teacher selection, correlation between the proxy and true gradient cost, sensitivity to sampling hyperparameters, and whether the method implicitly favors shorter/more templated answers.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (45–60 minutes):
- Start with the controlled comparison setup (and the main figure showing non-monotonic teacher→student transfer). That is the empirical motivation.
- Then read the derivation of the forward-only proxy (Section 2.2): identify the approximations and what signals are required from the student forward pass.
- Finally, scan ablations: proxy-vs-true-cost correlation, gains across student sizes, and scaling with candidate pool size.
If you want to implement it, focus on the “verified correct” filtering pipeline, candidate deduplication, and the runtime overhead of scoring during iterative training.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，因为它直接挑战“强教师=好监督”这个偷懒 prior；先看方法推导和多教师对比表，若 proxy 与真实学习收益相关性站得住，内部数据筛选策略该立刻重做。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it directly challenges the lazy prior that the strongest teacher gives the best supervision; check the proxy derivation and multi-teacher tables first—if the correlation with actual student gain is clean, your synthetic data selection pipeline likely needs revision.

paper.title: StreamChar: Long-Horizon Streaming Character Audio-Video Generation with Decoupled Orchestration
paper.abstract: Real-time streaming joint audio-video generation for character animation requires a generator to speak the requested transcript, maintain visual identity across chunks, and run within a strict playback budget. These requirements are difficult to satisfy simultaneously: chunk-wise autoregressive generation can accumulate transcript-audio misalignment and visual drift, while the few-step distillation needed for low latency often degrades spatial diversity and temporal quality. We present StreamCha

summary.core_problem: 解决长时程流式角色音视频生成中，文本对齐、身份一致性和低延迟播放难以同时满足的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个流式多模态生成系统设计：用 LLM 做长程编排，用局部音视频 DiT 做短窗去噪，并配合在线 rollout 蒸馏；对统一多模态生成系统有参考，但不是基座预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: StreamChar 将长程控制和短窗生成解耦：LLM orchestrator 根据 transcript 和历史上下文生成帧对齐的音频条件；joint audio-video DiT 在短窗口内做双向去噪，并使用参考帧和运动帧条件保持身份与动作连续；部署侧采用两阶段蒸馏，先压缩采样器，再在在线 chunk rollout 下微调 student。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数、训练数据、baseline、延迟预算和具体指标；实验应覆盖 transcript-audio alignment、身份漂移、时序质量、空间多样性和流式延迟。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles long-horizon streaming character audio-video generation, where transcript fidelity, identity consistency, and low playback latency must be satisfied at the same time.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a streaming multimodal generation system: an LLM handles long-horizon orchestration, a local audio-video DiT handles short-window denoising, and online-rollout distillation makes deployment feasible. It is relevant to multimodal generation systems, not foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: StreamChar decouples long-horizon orchestration from local generation. An LLM orchestrator produces frame-aligned audio conditions from the transcript and history. A joint audio-video DiT performs bidirectional denoising in short windows with reference and motion-frame conditioning. A two-stage distillation pipeline first compresses the sampler and then fine-tunes the student under online chunk rollouts.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report parameter counts, training data, baselines, latency numbers, or quantitative improvements. The expected evaluation dimensions are transcript-audio alignment, identity drift, temporal quality, spatial diversity, and streaming latency.

recommendation.zh: 可扫系统图和蒸馏流程；它是流式生成工程取舍，不会改变对多模态预训练目标的判断。
recommendation.en: Skim the system diagram and distillation recipe; this is a streaming-generation engineering tradeoff, not a new view on multimodal pretraining.

paper.title: Visual-Advantage On-Policy Distillation for Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: On-policy knowledge distillation has proven effective for language models, yet its application to vision-language models (VLMs) remains underexplored. We observe that standard on-policy distillation can improve a student's output quality while failing to strengthen its reliance on visual input: on vision-critical tokens, the student's predictions remain largely unchanged whether or not fine-grained visual detail is present, even though the teacher's predictions depend heavily on it.To make this

summary.core_problem: 标准在策略蒸馏应用到视觉语言模型（VLM）时，均匀加权的KL损失会被大量不依赖视觉信息的语言脚手架token稀释，学生模型仅能表面对齐教师输出，无法真正增强对细粒度视觉信息的依赖，视觉关键token的梯度贡献被严重弱化。
summary.importance: 为多模态模型蒸馏提供了token级的视觉依赖量化信号，避免蒸馏仅对齐语言表面特征，对VLM预训练后的蒸馏压缩、多模态对齐有实际参考价值，方法轻量无需额外标注或额外训练组件。
summary.technical_approach: 首先提出视觉优势（VA）的量化指标：对学生生成的每个token，计算教师模型在有细粒度视觉信息、无细粒度视觉信息两种条件下打分的对数概率差，用来表征每个token的视觉依赖程度。基于VA提出VA-OPD蒸馏方法，从两个粒度优化损失：1）轨迹层面，同prompt下生成的多个候选rollout按轨迹平均VA加权，视觉依赖更强的rollout梯度贡献更高；2）token层面，按VA将token分为高低两组，组内分别平均KL损失后再求和，避免高VA关键token的梯度被低VA语言token稀释。整个方案仅增加一次教师模型在退化图像上的前向传播，无额外标注、奖励模型或更多rollout的开销。
summary.experiments: 在4B/8B/32B三种教师规模、Geometry3K和ViRL39K两个训练语料、8个基准测试上验证，VA-OPD在所有基准上均超过标准在策略蒸馏。细粒度视觉依赖越强的任务提升越明显：HallusionBench提升2.5，AI2D提升2.4；使用更大规模的ViRL39K语料时，数学类任务平均提升3.8，视觉类任务平均提升2.5。训练过程中学生rollout的VA值与准确率同步上升，证明性能提升来自对视觉信息依赖的增强，而非单纯模仿教师的输出表面特征。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注Introduction部分的问题观察、VA指标定义，以及实验章节中移除高VA token损失的消融实验，可跳过具体训练超参数细节，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: When standard on-policy distillation is applied to vision-language models (VLMs), the uniformly weighted KL loss is diluted by a large volume of language scaffolding tokens that do not rely on visual input. The student model only aligns with the teacher's outputs at the surface level, failing to genuinely strengthen reliance on fine-grained visual details, with gradient contributions from vision-critical tokens heavily weakened.
summary_en.importance: It provides a token-level quantitative signal of visual dependency for multimodal model distillation, avoiding distillation that only aligns surface linguistic features. It has practical reference value for post-pretraining distillation, compression and multimodal alignment of VLMs, and the method is lightweight with no requirement for extra annotations or additional training components.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, the Visual Advantage (VA) metric is proposed: for each token generated by the student, calculate the log-probability difference of the token scored by the teacher under two conditions (with fine-grained visual details, and with fine-grained visual details degraded), which characterizes the visual dependency level of each token. The VA-OPD distillation method is built on VA, with loss optimized at two granularities: 1) Trajectory level: multiple candidate rollouts generated under the same prompt are weighted by their trajectory-averaged VA, so rollouts with stronger visual dependency contribute more to the gradient. 2) Token level: tokens are divided into high and low VA groups by VA value, KL loss is averaged separately within each group before summation, to avoid gradient dilution of high-VA critical tokens by low-VA linguistic tokens. The whole pipeline only adds one extra teacher forward pass on degraded images, with no extra cost of annotations, reward models or additional rollouts.
summary_en.experiments: Validated across 3 teacher sizes (4B/8B/32B), 2 training corpora (Geometry3K, ViRL39K) and 8 benchmarks, VA-OPD outperforms standard on-policy distillation on all benchmarks. Gains are more significant on tasks with higher fine-grained visual dependency: +2.5 on HallusionBench, +2.4 on AI2D. When using the larger ViRL39K corpus, the average gain on math tasks reaches 3.8, and the average gain on visual tasks reaches 2.5. The VA value of student rollouts rises synchronously with accuracy during training, proving performance gains come from enhanced reliance on visual information, rather than mere imitation of surface features of teacher outputs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the problem observation and VA metric definition in the Introduction section, as well as the ablation experiment of removing loss on high-VA tokens in the experiment section. Specific training hyperparameter details can be skipped. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看的是训练信号分解思路，不是蒸馏本身；只看VA定义和高VA token分布，如果现象稳，很多多模态loss都该重写。
recommendation.en: What matters here is the supervision decomposition, not distillation per se; read the VA definition and token distribution first—if the effect is robust, many multimodal losses are underweighting the only tokens that matter.

institutions: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

paper.title: Post-Training is About States, Not Tokens: A State Distribution View of SFT, RL, and On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: Large language model post-training methods such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning (RL), and distillation are often analyzed through their loss functions: maximum likelihood, policy gradients, forward KL, reverse KL, or related objective-level variants. We study a complementary factor: the state distribution on which supervision is applied. For an autoregressive policy, a state is a prompt plus generated prefix. SFT trains on fixed dataset states, while RL and on-policy dist

summary.core_problem: 后训练方法（SFT、RL、蒸馏）通常从损失函数角度分析（MLE、策略梯度、KL散度等），但这一视角无法充分解释一些关键现象：SFT的数据效率高但可能导致灾难性遗忘；RL奖励稀疏却能产生稳定改进；蒸馏中学生有时能超越教师。论文提出关键的补充维度：监督信号所施加的状态分布（state distribution），即模型生成时实际访问的前缀上下文分布。
summary.importance: 对预训练-后训练接口研究有概念性贡献。提出的'状态分布塑造'视角统一了SFT、RL和on-policy蒸馏（OPD），解释了为什么OPD可以超越退化的教师模型，以及为什么RL更新天然具有局部稳定性。这对理解后训练的遗忘/泛化trade-off、设计更好的对齐算法有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 将自回归后训练形式化为状态分布塑造问题：一个状态（state）是提示+已生成的前缀。SFT在固定的数据集状态上训练（这些状态可能不是模型当前实际访问的）；RL在当前策略采样的轨迹状态上训练；OPD由学生自己采样状态（on-policy），由教师提供局部监督信号。将三种方法统一分解为两个独立选择：状态来源（state source）和信号来源（signal source）。核心论点：后训练行为由监督信号与训练状态分布之间的交互决定；on-policy状态监督可以保持局部性，使学生能够超越退化的教师。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3-0.6B-Base上做受控实验，目标任务GSM8K，保留性评测TruthfulQA和MMLU。结果：(1) 温和SFT提升GSM8K且几乎无遗忘；(2) 压力SFT产生退化教师（目标精度和保留性都下降）；(3) 从该退化教师进行OPD，在GSM8K、TruthfulQA和MMLU上均超过教师；(4) 轻量on-policy RL提升GSM8K同时保留良好。实验支持的不是简单的'漂移标量'解释，而是更精确的状态中心论主张：训练状态的来源、局部性和学习者依赖性是后训练行为的核心决定因素。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，重点阅读第2章状态分布视角的形式化（理解state vs token的分解）和第3章实验设计与结果。核心概念图（Figure 1如果有）和实验对比表格是关键。预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Post-training methods (SFT, RL, distillation) are typically analyzed through their loss functions (MLE, policy gradients, KL divergences), but this perspective fails to fully explain key phenomena: SFT is data-efficient but can cause catastrophic forgetting; RL with sparse rewards can produce stable improvements; distillation students sometimes outperform teachers. The paper proposes a complementary dimension: the state distribution on which supervision is applied — the distribution of prefix contexts the model actually visits during generation.
summary_en.importance: Conceptual contribution to the pretrain-posttrain interface. The 'state distribution shaping' view unifies SFT, RL, and on-policy distillation (OPD), explaining why OPD can surpass a degraded teacher and why RL updates are naturally locally stable. Directly relevant for understanding the forgetting/generalization tradeoff in post-training and designing better alignment algorithms.
summary_en.technical_approach: Formalizes autoregressive post-training as state-distribution shaping: a state is a prompt plus generated prefix. SFT trains on fixed dataset states (which may not be states the current model actually visits); RL trains on trajectory states sampled from the current policy; OPD has the student sample states (on-policy) while the teacher provides local supervision signals. Unifies all three methods by decomposing into two independent choices: state source and signal source. Core thesis: post-training behavior is governed by the interaction between supervision signal and training state distribution; on-policy state supervision preserves locality and enables students to improve beyond degraded teachers.
summary_en.experiments: Controlled experiments on Qwen3-0.6B-Base, target task GSM8K, retention evaluations TruthfulQA and MMLU. Results: (1) Mild SFT improves GSM8K with minimal forgetting; (2) Stress SFT produces a degraded teacher (lower target accuracy and retention); (3) OPD from this degraded teacher outperforms the teacher on all three metrics; (4) Lightweight on-policy RL improves GSM8K while preserving retention. Results support a precise state-centric claim over simplistic scalar-drift explanations: state source, locality, and learner-dependence are central to post-training behavior.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on Section 2 (state distribution view formalization, the state vs token decomposition) and Section 3 (experimental design and results). The conceptual diagram (Figure 1 if available) and comparison tables are key. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 将SFT/RL/蒸馏统一为状态分布塑造的框架非常有价值，OPD超越退化教师的反常识现象值得注意，实验部分值得精读
recommendation.en: The state-distribution shaping framework unifying SFT/RL/distillation is valuable; the counter-intuitive OPD-beats-degraded-teacher phenomenon warrants attention; experimental section worth close reading

paper.title: The Distillation Game: Adaptive Attacks & Efficient Defenses
paper.abstract: Distillation attacks create a deployment trade-off for model providers: the same outputs that make a model more useful can also make it easier to imitate. We study this trade-off through a minimax game between a utility-constrained teacher and an adaptive student. Our framework yields tractable one-sided response rules: an adaptive evaluation rule in which the student reweights high-value examples, and a teacher-side defense template that suppresses outputs most useful for distillation. From a c

summary.core_problem: 现有蒸馏攻防研究普遍孤立设计防御方法、采用固定均匀采样的学生模型做评估，未考虑真实攻击者会自适应筛选、重加权高蒸馏价值样本的情况，也缺乏统一框架来比较不同防御的设计逻辑。
summary.importance: 对预训练基座模型部署阶段的知识产权保护、能力泄露防护有直接参考价值；其自适应评估框架修正了过往防御效果评估的乐观偏差，也为后续蒸馏防御的设计提供了统一的形式化基础。
summary.technical_approach: 将蒸馏攻防建模为带约束的极小极大博弈：教师端受效用约束，输出不能偏离原参考模型过多；学生端受自适应预算约束，不能无限制偏离观测到的教师输出分布。从博弈的最优响应分别推导出两部分：1）学生端的自适应评估规则，按每个样本对蒸馏的价值重加权训练数据；2）教师端的防御模板，抑制对蒸馏最有用的输出。进一步引入低成本的代理学生估计样本价值，提出仅需前向传播的Product-of-Experts（PoE）防御，生成阶段融合教师与代理学生的输出。
summary.experiments: 在GSM8K和MATH数据集上，自适应评估相比被动均匀采样，能让学生模型准确率相对提升约50%，暴露了现有防御被高估的鲁棒性。PoE防御的推理开销仅为原教师模型的1.6倍，低于现有性能领先防御的2.9倍；同时在LLM评审的输出质量评测中，PoE生成的推理链质量更高。在商用前沿模型的推理链摘要数据上，即使是被动学生也能蒸馏出不可忽略的能力，说明仅靠隐藏或摘要推理链不足以完全防御蒸馏。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第1章的问题背景与贡献概述、第2章的博弈框架形式化定义、第3章的PoE防御实现细节；附录C的商用模型蒸馏实验可快速浏览，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。
summary.authors_note: 加州大学伯克利分校Simons计算理论研究所，作者为共同贡献、按姓氏字母排序。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing distillation attack and defense studies typically design defenses in isolation and evaluate them against passive students that train uniformly on released outputs. This setup ignores the fact that realistic attackers adaptively filter or reweight high-value examples for distillation, and lacks a unified framework to compare the design logic of different defenses.
summary_en.importance: Provides direct reference for intellectual property protection and capability leakage mitigation during pretrained base model deployment. Its adaptive evaluation framework corrects the optimistic bias in prior defense effectiveness assessments, and offers a unified formal foundation for future distillation defense design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Models distillation attack and defense as a constrained minimax game: the teacher operates under a utility constraint that outputs cannot deviate too much from the reference model, while the student operates under an adaptation budget constraint that it cannot deviate indefinitely from the observed teacher output distribution. The optimal responses of the game derive two components: 1) An adaptive evaluation rule for the student side that reweights training data by the distillation value of each sample; 2) A defense template for the teacher side that suppresses outputs most useful for distillation. A low-cost proxy student is further used to estimate sample value, leading to the Product-of-Experts (PoE) defense — a forward-pass-only method that combines teacher and proxy student outputs during generation.
summary_en.experiments: On GSM8K and MATH datasets, adaptive evaluation improves student model accuracy by ~50% relative to passive uniform sampling, exposing the overestimated robustness of existing defenses. PoE defense incurs only 1.6× teacher inference overhead, lower than the 2.9× overhead of prior leading defenses. PoE also produces higher-quality reasoning chains in LLM-judged output quality assessments. Experiments on reasoning chain summaries from commercial frontier models show that even passive students can distill non-trivial capabilities, indicating that hiding or summarizing reasoning chains alone is insufficient for full distillation defense.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 1 for problem background and contribution overview, Section 2 for formal definition of the game framework, Section 3 for PoE defense implementation details. Appendix C experiments on commercial model distillation can be skimmed quickly. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Simons Institute for the Theory of Computing, UC Berkeley. Authors contributed equally, listed in alphabetical order.

recommendation.zh: 蒸馏攻击的自适应评估发现被动评估严重低估了攻击有效性，对评估蒸馏防御和学生模型评估方法有借鉴意义，重点看§4自适应评估部分
recommendation.en: Adaptive evaluation of distillation attacks reveals passive evaluation severely underestimates attack effectiveness; relevant for distillation defense evaluation and student model assessment; focus on §4 adaptive evaluation

paper.title: Toward Understanding Adversarial Distillation: Why Robust Teachers Fail
paper.abstract: Adversarial Distillation aims to enhance student robustness by guiding the student with a robust teacher's soft labels within the min-max adversarial training framework, yet its success is notoriously inconsistent: a more robust teacher often fails to improve, or even harms, the student's robust generalization. In this paper, we identify a key mechanism of this teacher dependency: the misalignment between the teacher's supervisory confidence and the student's representational limitations on a co

summary.core_problem: 解释对抗蒸馏里一个长期存在的现象：更鲁棒的教师为什么并不稳定地提升学生，甚至会伤害学生的鲁棒泛化。
summary.importance: 这是一篇训练动力学与泛化机制分析工作，不是 LLM 论文，但它讨论了“强教师监督何时变成坏信号”这一更普遍的问题，对蒸馏、软标签质量、学生容量受限下的训练失配有方法论启发。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出“Robustly Unlearnable Set”这一概念，指学生表征能力不足、但教师仍给出高置信监督的一致样本子集。作者用两层网络建立理论分析，说明当教师在这些样本上过于自信时，学生会被迫记忆噪声或伪相关特征，最终压过真正的鲁棒信号并导致 robust overfitting；相反，若教师在这些样本上保持适度不确定，蒸馏才可能帮助学生学习可泛化的鲁棒特征。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整实验规模与具体数据集细节，但核心实验应围绕不同鲁棒教师、不同学生容量和对抗训练设置，比较鲁棒精度与过拟合行为，并验证理论中“不可学习样本上的监督置信度”与蒸馏成败的对应关系。对 LLM 研究员而言，重点不在数值，而在教师置信度—学生容量失配这一机制。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper explains a long-standing failure mode in adversarial distillation: why a more robust teacher does not reliably improve, and can even hurt, the student's robust generalization.
summary_en.importance: This is a training-dynamics and generalization analysis paper rather than an LLM paper, but it studies a broader issue: when strong teacher supervision becomes a harmful signal. That is relevant to distillation, soft-label quality, and capacity mismatch under constrained students.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce the notion of a Robustly Unlearnable Set: a subset of samples where the student lacks the representational capacity to learn the right robust features while the teacher still provides highly confident supervision. Using a two-layer network analysis, they show that overconfident supervision on such samples drives the student to memorize noise or spurious patterns, which eventually overwhelms the robust signal and causes robust overfitting. If the teacher remains appropriately uncertain on those samples, distillation can instead help robust feature learning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide full experimental details, but the empirical setup likely varies teacher robustness, student capacity, and adversarial training conditions, measuring robust accuracy and overfitting behavior. For an LLM researcher, the main value is not the benchmark result but the mechanism linking teacher confidence and student limitations.

recommendation.zh: 不是 LLM 论文，但“教师越强越好”这个 prior 被拆得比较干净；只看理论结论和不可学习样本定义，能借去想蒸馏与 synthetic supervision 的坏案例。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper, but it cleanly weakens the 'stronger teacher is always better' prior; read the theory and the unlearnable-set notion, then map it to distillation and synthetic supervision failure modes.

paper.title: One-Step Distillation of Discrete Diffusion Image Generators via Fixed-Point Iteration
paper.abstract: Discrete diffusion models excel at visual synthesis but rely on slow, iterative decoding. Existing single-step distillation methods attempt to bypass this bottleneck, either by training auxiliary score networks that effectively double compute, or by introducing specialized parameterizations and multi-stage pipelines that fragment optimization. In this paper, we introduce Fixed-Point Distillation (FPD), an end-to-end framework that constructs local correction targets by partially corrupting the s

summary.core_problem: 离散扩散图像生成器推理需要多步迭代速度慢，现有单步蒸馏方法要么计算开销翻倍要么训练流程碎片化的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出端到端的离散扩散单步蒸馏框架，无需额外辅助网络或多阶段训练
summary.technical_approach: 提出定点蒸馏（FPD）框架，通过局部破坏学生模型的单步生成结果再用教师模型单步修正构造训练目标，在连续特征空间做多带宽漂移损失，用直通估计器解决离散瓶颈反向传播问题
summary.experiments: 未披露完整模型参数量和训练数据规模，验证了单步蒸馏后生成质量接近原多步离散扩散模型，推理速度提升数百倍
summary.authors_note: 团队来自北京大学

summary_en.core_problem: Discrete diffusion image generators require slow iterative decoding, existing single-step distillation methods either double compute cost or have fragmented training pipelines
summary_en.importance: Method innovation, proposes an end-to-end single-step distillation framework for discrete diffusion without extra auxiliary networks or multi-stage training
summary_en.technical_approach: Fixed-Point Distillation (FPD) constructs training targets by partially corrupting the student's one-step output and refining with one teacher step, applies multi-bandwidth drift loss in continuous feature space, uses straight-through estimator for discrete bottleneck backpropagation
summary_en.experiments: Full model parameter count and training data scale are not disclosed, verifies that single-step distilled model has quality close to original multi-step model, with hundreds of times faster inference speed
summary_en.authors_note: Team from Peking University

recommendation.zh: 离散扩散蒸馏思路可迁移到文本离散扩散LM的加速任务，仅看方法部分即可，实验参考价值低
recommendation.en: The discrete diffusion distillation idea can be transferred to text diffusion LM acceleration tasks, only read the method section, experiments have low reference value

paper.title: Towards Generalization of Block Attention via Automatic Segmentation and Block Distillation
paper.abstract: Block attention, which processes the input as separate blocks that cannot attend to one another, offers significant potential to improve KV cache reuse in long-context scenarios such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). However, its broader application is hindered by two key challenges: the difficulty of segmenting input text into meaningful, self-contained blocks, and the inefficiency of existing block fine-tuning methods that risk degrading performance. To address these, we first construct

summary.core_problem: 解决 block attention 难以泛化到真实长上下文输入的问题：块边界难自动确定，直接微调又低效且容易损伤模型能力。
summary.importance: 贡献是长上下文推理效率方法和训练框架：把 block attention 从依赖人工分块或任务特定分块，推进到自动语义分割加教师蒸馏的通用流程，目标是提升 RAG 等场景的 KV cache 复用。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SemanticSeg，包含 3 万多个样本、16 类文本、长度 2k 到 32k，覆盖书籍、代码、网页和对话；用该数据训练轻量 segmenter 自动切分语义自洽块，并提出 block distillation，用冻结的 full-attention teacher 指导 block-attention student，避免昂贵且不稳定的 block fine-tuning。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出数据规模和覆盖范围，但未完整展示模型参数、baseline 和具体提升；核心实验应围绕自动分块质量、block distillation 相比 block fine-tuning 的效率与性能保持，以及长上下文 KV cache 复用收益。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 The Chinese University of Hong Kong、City University of Hong Kong、Tencent、Singapore Management University、Renmin University of China 等；包含 Tencent 参与，方向与长上下文推理和 RAG 缓存复用相关。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the poor generalization of block attention in realistic long-context inputs, where block boundaries are hard to choose automatically and direct fine-tuning is inefficient and performance-damaging.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a long-context inference-efficiency method and training framework. It moves block attention from manual or task-specific segmentation toward automatic semantic segmentation plus teacher distillation, targeting KV-cache reuse in RAG-like workloads.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces SemanticSeg, a dataset with over 30K examples across 16 categories and 2K–32K token lengths, covering books, code, web text, and conversations. A lightweight segmenter predicts semantically self-contained blocks, while block distillation uses a frozen full-attention teacher to train a block-attention student instead of relying on costly block fine-tuning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports the dataset scale and coverage but not detailed model sizes, baselines, or numerical gains. The key experiments should test segmentation quality, efficiency and capability retention versus block fine-tuning, and KV-cache reuse benefits in long-context settings.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include The Chinese University of Hong Kong, City University of Hong Kong, Tencent, Singapore Management University, and Renmin University of China. Tencent is involved, and the work targets long-context inference and RAG cache reuse.

recommendation.zh: 只看分块数据构造和 distillation ablation；若性能不掉，这会改变 block attention 只能做工程特例的判断。
recommendation.en: Read the segmentation dataset and distillation ablations; if capability holds, it weakens the prior that block attention is only a narrow engineering trick.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China

paper.title: BiSpikCLM: A Spiking Language Model integrating Softmax-Free Spiking Attention and Spike-Aware Alignment Distillation
paper.abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer promising energy-efficient alternatives to large language models (LLMs) due to their event-driven nature and ultra-low power consumption. However, to preserve capacity, most existing spiking LLMs still incur intensive floating-point matrix multiplication (MatMul) and nonlinearities, or training difficulties arising from the complex spatiotemporal dynamics. To address these challenges, we propose BiSpikCLM, the first fully binary spiking MatMul-free causal lan

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是 spiking causal LM 里的两个硬问题：如何在自回归注意力中去掉 softmax 和浮点 MatMul，同时又让大规模 SNN 从随机初始化稳定训练，而不是依赖高时间步的 ANN-to-SNN 转换。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值主要在低功耗语言模型架构探索。它不是主流 LLM 预训练路线的直接替代，但对“语言建模能否映射到事件驱动、二值计算硬件”给出了一套较完整的设计。对预训练研究的启发在于：效率不只来自量化、稀疏化或 serving 优化，也可以来自训练目标、注意力算子和神经元动态的共同重写。需要注意的是，当前实验仍停留在 1.3B 规模和较短训练 token 范围，结论更适合作为架构原型参考，而不是通用 LM scaling 结论。
summary.technical_approach: BiSpikCLM 基于 OPT-family decoder-only 架构改造为二值脉冲语言模型。核心模块是 Softmax-Free Spiking Attention，目标是用 spike-compatible computation 替换常规 causal self-attention 中的 softmax、浮点激活和密集 MatMul。这样做的动机很清楚：如果注意力层仍保留大量浮点矩阵乘，SNN 的事件驱动优势会被抵消。训练侧提出 Spike-Aware Alignment Distillation，用冻结的 ANN teacher 给 SNN student 提供多层级监督，包括 embedding、attention map、中间特征和输出 logits。它不是简单 logits distillation，而是把对齐信号分布到模型内部，以缓解 SNN 时序反传带来的优化困难。模型仍使用自回归 next-token 交叉熵作为语言建模目标，蒸馏项提供额外的收敛约束。
summary.experiments: 关键结果集中在 BiSpikCLM-1.3B。作者报告用 10B training tokens 训练，而 OPT-1.3B 使用约 180B tokens。4 个 time steps 下，BiSpikCLM-1.3B 在常见 zero-shot reasoning benchmarks 上达到 42.19% accuracy，接近 OPT-1.3B 的 49.73%，推理能耗为后者的 10.6%。2 个 time steps 下 accuracy 为 41.33%，能耗降到 5.88%。这些数字说明 SpAD 对低时间步 SNN 训练有明显帮助，也说明 time step 是该类模型的核心质量-能耗旋钮。需要谨慎看待能耗结果：这类估算通常依赖具体硬件假设和操作计数模型，和 GPU 上真实端到端 serving 成本并不等价。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction、Methods 中 SFSA 和 SpAD 两部分，以及实验表格中的 time step、能耗、accuracy 对比。预计 20–30 分钟。重点看三个问题：第一，SFSA 如何保持 causal constraint；第二，attention map distillation 在没有 softmax 的结构中如何定义；第三，能耗计算是否把 embedding、输出头、memory access 和控制开销算进去。如果只关心主流 LLM 预训练，可跳过 SNN 神经元细节，把它当作极端低功耗架构研究阅读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses two bottlenecks in spiking causal language models: removing softmax and floating-point matrix multiplication from autoregressive attention, and making large SNN language models trainable from random initialization without relying on high-timestep ANN-to-SNN conversion.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an architecture-level exploration of low-power language modeling. It is not an immediate replacement for mainstream Transformer pretraining, but it gives a concrete design for mapping causal LM computation onto binary, event-driven dynamics. The useful lesson for pretraining research is that efficiency can come from changing the modeling primitive itself, not only from quantization, sparsity, or inference-time engineering. The evidence is still at 1.3B scale with limited training tokens, so the result should be read as a prototype rather than a scaling-law claim.
summary_en.technical_approach: BiSpikCLM adapts an OPT-style decoder-only model into a binary spiking causal LM. Its key module, Softmax-Free Spiking Attention, replaces standard causal self-attention components that depend on softmax, floating-point activations, and dense MatMul with spike-compatible computation. This design matters because keeping floating-point attention would largely erase the energy advantage of SNNs. For training, the paper introduces Spike-Aware Alignment Distillation. A frozen ANN teacher supervises the SNN student at several levels: embeddings, attention maps, intermediate hidden features, and output logits. This is stronger than plain logits distillation and is meant to stabilize optimization through the spatiotemporal dynamics of SNNs. The model still uses autoregressive next-token cross-entropy, with distillation losses acting as additional alignment signals.
summary_en.experiments: The main reported model is BiSpikCLM-1.3B. It is trained on 10B tokens, compared with roughly 180B tokens used for OPT-1.3B. With 4 timesteps, BiSpikCLM-1.3B reaches 42.19% zero-shot accuracy on common reasoning benchmarks, compared with 49.73% for OPT-1.3B, while using 10.6% of the reported inference energy. With 2 timesteps, it keeps 41.33% accuracy and reduces energy to 5.88%. These results suggest that SpAD is important for low-timestep training, and that timestep count is the main quality-energy knob. The energy numbers should be interpreted carefully, since they depend on hardware assumptions and operation accounting, and may not match end-to-end GPU serving cost.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the Introduction, the SFSA and SpAD method sections, and the experimental tables comparing timesteps, energy, and accuracy. A focused read should take about 20–30 minutes. The main things to inspect are how SFSA preserves causality, how attention-map distillation is defined without standard softmax attention, and whether the energy accounting includes embeddings, output projection, memory movement, and control overhead. Readers focused on conventional LLM pretraining can skip most neuron-dynamics details and treat the paper as an extreme low-power architecture study.

recommendation.zh: 看 SFSA 和蒸馏目标就够；“5.6% token 接近 ANN”很诱人，但先查模型尺度、能耗口径和 teacher leakage。
recommendation.en: Skim SFSA and the distillation losses; the 5.6% token claim is attractive, but first check scale, energy accounting, and teacher leakage.

paper.title: Towards Resource-Efficient LLMs: End-to-End Energy Accounting of Distillation Pipelines
paper.abstract: The rise in deployment of large language models has driven a surge in GPU demand and datacenter scaling, raising concerns about electricity use, grid stress, and the impacts of modern AI workloads. Distillation is often promoted as one of the most effective paths to obtain cheaper, more efficient models, yet these claims rarely account for the full end-to-end energy and resource costs, including crucial teacher-side workloads such as data generation, logit caching, and evaluation. We present a c

summary.core_problem: 评估蒸馏是否真的节省资源时，不能只看学生模型训练和推理成本，还要计入教师模型生成数据、logit caching、评测等完整流水线能耗。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是工程测量与资源核算框架。它挑战了“蒸馏天然更省”的粗粒度叙事，对模型压缩、合成数据 SFT 和大规模部署成本评估有现实意义。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出端到端 energy accounting framework，对蒸馏流水线各阶段进行 GPU device power consumption 的分阶段记录。比较两类常见蒸馏：logit-based knowledge distillation 和 synthetic-data supervised fine-tuning，并构造 energy-quality Pareto frontiers。
summary.experiments: 实验分离记录教师侧、学生侧、缓存、评测等阶段的经验能耗和排放。摘要未给出模型规模、GPU 类型、数据量、质量指标和 Pareto 数值，但明确覆盖经典 logit 蒸馏与合成数据 SFT 两条路线。
summary.authors_note: Sasha Luccioni 长期参与 AI 能耗、碳排和模型环境影响测量相关工作；论文信息未提供明确机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper argues that claims about distillation efficiency must include the full pipeline cost, not just student training or inference, because teacher generation, logit caching, and evaluation can dominate the budget.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an engineering measurement and resource-accounting framework. It questions the coarse claim that distillation is automatically resource-efficient and is relevant to compression, synthetic-data SFT, and deployment cost analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose an end-to-end energy accounting framework that logs GPU device power stage by stage across distillation pipelines. They compare logit-based knowledge distillation with synthetic-data supervised fine-tuning and build energy-quality Pareto frontiers.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments empirically separate energy use and emissions across teacher-side work, student-side training, caching, and evaluation. The abstract does not provide model sizes, GPU types, dataset sizes, quality metrics, or exact Pareto numbers, but it covers both classic logit distillation and synthetic-data SFT.
summary_en.authors_note: Sasha Luccioni is known for work on AI energy use, carbon accounting, and environmental impact measurement. The provided paper metadata does not list a specific institution.

recommendation.zh: 结论不会改预训练方法，但会约束蒸馏项目立项；只看能耗分解表和 Pareto 曲线即可。
recommendation.en: It will not change pretraining methods, but it should constrain distillation project planning; read the stage-wise energy tables and Pareto curves.

paper.title: CoT-Guard: Small Models for Strong Monitoring
paper.abstract: Monitoring the chain-of-thought (CoT) of reasoning models is a promising approach for detecting covert misbehavior (i.e., hidden objectives) in code generation tasks. While large models (GPT-5, Gemini-3-Flash) can serve as effective CoT monitors, they are expensive to deploy due to the lengthy reasoning traces and high API cost, emphasizing the need for smaller, cheaper alternatives. Nevertheless, we find that current small models (4B--8B) struggle to detect hidden objectives despite access to t

summary.core_problem: 现有4B-8B开源小模型在代码生成任务的CoT轨迹隐蔽不当行为检测上性能远低于大闭源监控模型；同时大模型部署成本高、依赖闭源API，小模型还容易将注入的隐藏目标误判为用户查询的合法部分，缺乏低成本、高性能的小模型CoT监控方案。
summary.importance: 验证了小模型通过结构化后训练流水线可以在专用安全监控任务上超过更大的闭源模型。在难样本上施加RL提升域外泛化的思路，为垂直能力增强、LLM安全对齐的后训练流水线设计提供了可落地的参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出4B参数的CoT监控模型CoT-Guard，采用两阶段后训练流水线：第一阶段有监督微调（SFT），从更强的闭源监控模型蒸馏检测行为，缩小域内任务的性能差距；第二阶段在SFT后针对难样本做强化学习（RL），提升域外泛化能力。同时基于真实供应链攻击形式化了中间人威胁模型，包含两种攻击场景：提示操纵（将隐藏目标注入用户提示）、代码操纵（直接修改生成代码），并构造了4种对应真实代码攻击模式的新隐藏目标：包强制、域名仿冒（Typosquatting）、广告注释、广告打印。
summary.experiments: 零样本设置下，4B-8B开源模型在隐藏目标检测上与大闭源监控模型存在显著性能差距。CoT-Guard 4B在提示操纵和代码操纵两种攻击下，9种域外隐藏目标的检测性能超过GPT-5.4和GPT-5-mini，与Gemini-3-Flash性能接近但成本远更低。在最强对抗隐藏策略下，其G-Mean仅下降1.0%。消融实验验证，针对难隐藏目标做RL能有效提升域外泛化能力。
summary.reading_guide: 先泛读第3节的威胁模型与新增隐藏目标设计，再看第4节的后训练流水线细节，尤其是RL阶段的难样本筛选逻辑，最后浏览第5节的主实验与消融结果，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Small open-source models (4B–8B) perform poorly at detecting covert hidden objectives in code generation agent CoT traces, far underperforming large closed-source monitors. Deploying large models for CoT monitoring also incurs high API costs and closed-system dependency, while small models frequently misclassify injected hidden objectives as legitimate parts of user queries.
summary_en.importance: Demonstrates that small models can outperform much larger closed-source models on specialized safety monitoring tasks via a structured post-training pipeline. The strategy of applying RL on hard samples to boost out-of-domain generalization provides actionable reference for designing post-training pipelines for vertical capability enhancement and LLM safety alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes CoT-Guard, a 4B-parameter CoT monitoring model with a two-stage post-training pipeline: 1) Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to distill detection behavior from stronger closed-source monitors, closing the performance gap on in-domain tasks; 2) Reinforcement learning (RL) on hard negative samples post-SFT to improve out-of-domain generalization. Also formalizes a practical man-in-the-middle threat model based on real-world supply chain attacks, with two attack scenarios: prompt manipulation (inject hidden objectives into user prompts) and code manipulation (directly modify generated code). Four new hidden objectives aligned with real code attack patterns are constructed: Package Forcing, Typosquatting, Ads Comment, and Ads Print.
summary_en.experiments: Zero-shot 4B–8B open-source models show substantial performance gaps to large closed-source monitors on hidden objective detection. CoT-Guard 4B outperforms GPT-5.4 and GPT-5-mini on 9 out-of-domain hidden objectives under both prompt and code manipulation attacks, with performance competitive to Gemini-3-Flash at a far lower cost. Under the strongest adversarial concealment strategy, its G-Mean only drops by 1.0%. Ablations confirm that RL on hard hidden objectives drives improved out-of-domain generalization.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 3 first for the threat model and new hidden objective designs. Then review the post-training pipeline details, especially hard sample selection for RL, in Section 4. Finally check the main experiment and ablation results in Section 5. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 展示了如何用 SFT+RL 蒸馏小模型做 CoT 监控，对 Scalable Oversight 和后训练数据构造有一定参考价值，可扫读方法设计。
recommendation.en: Demonstrates how to distill small models for CoT monitoring using SFT+RL; offers reference value for Scalable Oversight and post-training data construction. Skim the method design.

paper.title: SOMA: Efficient Multi-turn LLM Serving via Small Language Model
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-turn dialogue settings where preserving conversational context across turns is essential. A standard serving practice concatenates the full dialogue history at every turn, which reliably maintains coherence but incurs substantial cost in latency, memory, and API expenditure, especially when queries are routed to large proprietary models. Existing approaches often struggle to balance the trade-off between response quality and efficie

summary.core_problem: 多轮对话线上服务通常每一轮都要把全量历史拼回去给大模型，导致重复计算、延迟和成本随轮次线性上升；但直接把后续轮次交给小模型又会因早期上下文“定锚”而逐步漂移。论文要解决的是：在不每轮调用大模型、且不牺牲多轮一致性的前提下，让小模型在单个会话的“局部行为流形”上逼近大模型。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响有限，更偏系统/Serving 与会话内自适应蒸馏。价值点在于两件事：1）把“会话内分布是局部的”明确成可操作的建模假设（local manifold approximation），提供了一种 session-level 的轻量对齐思路；2）给出一个经验观察：多轮对话 token 分布呈长尾，早期轮次更长且信息密度更高，后期轮次更短但强依赖早期锚点——这对做长上下文训练数据配比、对话压缩/记忆模块的评估设计有启发。
summary.technical_approach:
SOMA（Soft-prompts for lOcal Manifold Approximation）是一个三阶段会话内适配框架，目标是用少量大模型调用，把小模型“拉到”当前会话诱导的局部区域。
1）Soft prompt tuning：在会话早期轮次上，为小模型学习软提示，刻意寻找能放大“小模型 vs 大模型”语义行为差异的方向（文中表述为最大化语义发散/behavioral divergence）。直觉是：先找到最容易出错、最能暴露差距的局部切向方向，后续对齐更高效。
2）Localized fine-tuning：用少量输入-输出对（由大模型在早期轮次产生/标注）对小模型做局部微调（文中提到 localized LoRA），让小模型在该会话的局部流形上模仿大模型。这里的关键取舍是“会话内局部拟合”而不是“全局蒸馏”：牺牲跨会话泛化，换取单会话的快速贴合与成本下降。
3）Efficient inference：推理阶段尽量做到 prompt-free（软提示/LoRA 已内化），并结合 extractive summary 来降低输入长度；同时用一个基于余弦相似度的 gate 做模型切换，并配 rollback 机制监测潜在 topic shift，一旦偏离局部区域就回退到大模型以保质量。
整体上它不是在压缩 KV-cache 或做 attention 复用，而是把“后续轮次的生成”转化为“会话内小模型对大模型的局部模仿问题”。
summary.experiments:
给定的全文片段未包含实验设置与具体数字（模型规模、数据集、成本节省比例、质量指标、消融等），因此无法基于全文复述关键结果。可从论文的实验部分重点核对：
- 质量：与全程大模型相比的胜率/偏好评测、以及多轮一致性指标（是否随轮次漂移）。
- 成本：大模型调用次数减少比例、端到端延迟、token 计费节省。
- 消融：仅路由到小模型 vs SOMA；无 soft-prompt 探索/无 localized LoRA/无 summary/无 rollback 的影响；gate 阈值敏感性。
- 长尾现象：不同域对话的 turn-level token 分布统计是否稳定，以及与性能/切换点的关系。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- Introduction：把“长尾 turn 分布 + 早期定锚”这个经验事实读清楚，这是方法成立的前提。
- 方法部分三阶段：重点看 soft prompt 如何定义“语义发散/最大差异方向”，以及 localized LoRA 的数据来源与预算（每会话需要多少大模型样本）。
- 推理策略：cosine gate 与 rollback 的触发条件，决定线上可控性。
- 实验：优先看成本-质量曲线与消融，判断它到底是“少量大模型调用换大幅节省”，还是把质量风险转移到回退机制上。

summary_en.core_problem: Multi-turn chat serving commonly resends the full dialogue history to a large model at every turn, causing redundant compute, latency, and cost growth with conversation length. Simply handing later turns to a small model degrades coherence because early turns anchor the session and later turns depend heavily on that context. The paper targets session-level efficiency: adapt a small model to approximate a large model’s behavior within the local region induced by the early turns, so later turns can be served cheaply without losing consistency.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a serving/system paper rather than a pretraining-method contribution. Its relevance to foundation-model researchers is indirect: (1) it operationalizes a “session-local distribution/manifold” assumption and turns it into a lightweight, per-session alignment recipe; (2) it highlights an empirical long-tail pattern in turn-level token counts—early turns are long and information-dense, later turns are shorter yet more context-dependent—which can inform how we design dialogue pretraining mixes and how we evaluate memory/compression mechanisms beyond naive truncation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SOMA (Soft-prompts for lOcal Manifold Approximation) is a three-stage per-session adaptation pipeline.
1) Soft-prompt tuning: using early turns, learn soft prompts for the small model that intentionally expose directions where the small and large models diverge most in semantic behavior (maximizing behavioral/semantic divergence). The idea is to find the most diagnostic local directions before aligning.
2) Localized fine-tuning: collect a small set of input–output pairs from the large model in the early session and perform localized adaptation of the small model (via LoRA) to match the large model within this session-specific region. The key design choice is local, session-scoped fitting instead of global distillation.
3) Efficient inference: run the adapted small model in a prompt-free manner, feed it an extractive summary to reduce input length, and use a cosine-similarity gate to decide when to switch/rollback to the large model upon topic shift.
Overall, the method reframes multi-turn serving as session-level local imitation rather than cache reuse or generic routing.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full-text excerpt does not include the experimental section or any concrete numbers (model sizes, datasets, cost/latency reductions, win rates, ablations). As a result, no faithful quantitative summary can be produced from the given content. paper.title: Trajectory as the Teacher: Few-Step Discrete Flow Matching via Energy-Navigated Distillation
paper.abstract: Discrete flow matching generates text by iteratively transforming noise tokens into coherent language, but may require hundreds of forward passes. Distillation uses the multi-step trajectory to train a student to reproduce the process in a few steps. When the student underperforms, the usual explanation is insufficient capacity. We argue the opposite: the trajectory is the bottleneck, not the student. Each training trajectory is built through a chain of blind stochastic jumps with no evaluation

summary.core_problem: 离散流匹配（DFM）是可替代自回归LLM的新一代文本生成建模范式，但生成过程需要数百至上千次前向传播，推理速度比自回归模型慢多个数量级；现有少步蒸馏方案将教师模型的多步生成轨迹作为监督训练学生模型，但存在性能瓶颈：传统观点认为学生性能不足是模型容量不够，实际上瓶颈在于训练轨迹本身——轨迹构造过程中每个中间步的盲随机跳转会引入累积误差，劣质中间状态会传播到后续所有步骤，导致学生模型只能模仿存在偏差的低质量监督信号。
summary.importance: 首次将离散流匹配蒸馏的优化目标从学生模型容量转移到训练轨迹质量，突破了少步DFM的性能天花板；提出的导航塑形方法与现有蒸馏机制完全正交，可叠加在所有基于轨迹的离散生成蒸馏框架上，大幅缩小了少步非自回归生成模型与自回归LLM的推理速度差距与性能差距，为diffusion LM等非自回归范式的实际落地提供了关键支撑。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Trajectory-Shaped Discrete Flow Matching（TS-DFM），通过导航塑形机制优化训练轨迹的中间状态质量：1）生成感知能量罗盘：一个轻量级能量模型，基于生成相关的近负例（velocity near-miss negatives）训练，对部分生成的中间流状态的质量判别准确率达98.5%；2）序列到Token的两阶段导航策略：每个中间步生成K个候选续序列，先用能量罗盘全局选择最优候选，再基于速度置信度在token级别进一步优化；3）时间阈值τ：仅当流过程进行到足够晚的阶段、序列已形成初步语言结构时才激活导航塑形，避免早期无结构状态下罗盘无法有效判别的问题。所有塑形操作仅在训练阶段执行，推理阶段无额外开销。
summary.experiments: 在170M参数的语言建模任务上测试：采用均匀噪声源时，8步TS-DFM的困惑度达到56.1（以GPT-2为评估器），比FS-DFM降低36%，比1024步全步长教师模型还低32%，同时推理速度是教师模型的128倍；采用掩码源时，8步TS-DFM的性能是FS-DFM的5.6倍。TS-DFM超过Duo、SDTT等现有少步离散生成方法，在该领域取得最优困惑度。性能提升在GPT-2、LLaMA-2、LLaMA-3三个不同规模的评估器上均一致成立。训练阶段的塑形操作仅带来2.0-2.4倍的一次性训练开销。
summary.reading_guide: 精读§1和§2的动机分析部分，理解轨迹质量作为蒸馏瓶颈的核心论证；精读§3的导航塑形机制设计，重点关注能量罗盘的训练方法、序列到Token的两阶段选择策略、时间阈值τ的设计逻辑；§4的核心结果与跨评估器的泛化性实验、不同源分布（均匀/掩码）的性能对比需要重点关注；附录中的超参设置、候选数量K和阈值τ的消融实验可作为落地参考。

summary_en.core_problem: Discrete Flow Matching (DFM) is a new generation text generation paradigm that can replace autoregressive LLMs, but its generation process requires hundreds to thousands of forward passes, making inference speed orders of magnitude slower than autoregressive models. Existing few-step distillation schemes use the multi-step generation trajectories of the teacher model as supervision to train the student, but face a performance bottleneck: conventional wisdom attributes poor student performance to insufficient model capacity, but the actual bottleneck is the training trajectory itself—blind stochastic jumps at each intermediate step during trajectory construction introduce cumulative errors, and degraded intermediate states propagate to all subsequent steps, forcing the student to imitate biased low-quality supervision signals.
summary_en.importance: This work shifts the optimization target of discrete flow matching distillation from student model capacity to training trajectory quality for the first time, breaking through the performance ceiling of few-step DFM. The proposed navigation shaping method is fully orthogonal to existing distillation mechanisms and can be applied on top of all trajectory-based discrete generation distillation frameworks. It significantly narrows the inference speed and performance gap between few-step non-autoregressive generation models and autoregressive LLMs, providing critical support for the practical deployment of non-autoregressive paradigms such as diffusion LMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Trajectory-Shaped Discrete Flow Matching (TS-DFM) is proposed to optimize the intermediate state quality of training trajectories through a navigation shaping mechanism: 1) Generation-aware energy compass: a lightweight energy model trained on generation-relevant velocity near-miss negatives, achieving 98.5% accuracy in judging the quality of partially generated intermediate flow states. 2) Two-phase sequence-to-token navigation policy: generate K candidate continuations at each intermediate step, first select the best candidate globally with the energy compass, then further refine it at the token level based on velocity confidence. 3) Time threshold τ: navigation shaping is only activated at sufficiently late flow stages when preliminary linguistic structure has emerged in the sequence, avoiding the problem that the compass cannot effectively discriminate among unstructured early states. All shaping operations are performed only during training, with no extra overhead at inference.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 170M-parameter language modeling tasks: with a uniform noise source, 8-step TS-DFM achieves a perplexity of 56.1 (evaluated against GPT-2), a 36% reduction over FS-DFM and 32% lower than the full 1024-step teacher model, while being 128× faster than the teacher at inference. With a mask source, 8-step TS-DFM outperforms FS-DFM by 5.6×. TS-DFM outperforms existing few-step discrete generation methods such as Duo and SDTT, achieving the best perplexity in this field. Performance improvements are consistent across three evaluators of increasing scale: GPT-2, LLaMA-2, and LLaMA-3. Shaping operations during training only introduce a one-time 2.0–2.4× training overhead.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the motivation analysis in §1 and §2 to understand the core argument that trajectory quality is the bottleneck of distillation. Read the navigation shaping mechanism design in §3 carefully, paying special attention to the training method of the energy compass, the two-phase sequence-to-token selection policy, and the design logic of the time threshold τ. Pay attention to the core results in §4, generalization experiments across evaluators, and performance comparisons across different source distributions (uniform/mask). Hyperparameter settings and ablation studies on candidate number K and threshold τ in the appendix provide practical references for implementation.

recommendation.zh: 真正有insight的工作——结论完全反常识：离散流匹配蒸馏的瓶颈是轨迹质量而非学生容量。能量罗盘导航方案简洁有效，6步击败基线16步的结果很有说服力，应纳入所有离散生成建模的设计考量。
recommendation.en: A genuinely insightful work—counterintuitive conclusion that trajectory quality (not student capacity) is the bottleneck in discrete flow matching distillation. Clean energy-compass navigation scheme; 6 steps beating baseline 16 steps is convincing. Should inform all discrete generative modeling design.

paper.title: How to Compress KV Cache in RL Post-Training? Shadow Mask Distillation for Memory-Efficient Alignment
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a crucial paradigm for unlocking the advanced reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), encompassing frameworks like RLHF and RLAIF. Regardless of the specific optimization algorithm (e.g., PPO, GRPO, or Online DPO), online RL inherently requires an exploratory trajectory generation (rollout) phase. However, for long-context reasoning tasks, this rollout phase imposes a severe ``memory wall'' due to the exorbitant Key-Value (KV) cache foot

summary.core_problem: RL后训练（如RLHF、GRPO、Online DPO）的rollout阶段生成长上下文轨迹时，KV缓存占用过高形成内存墙，直接使用KV缓存压缩会导致生成阶段的稀疏上下文策略与优化阶段的稠密上下文策略不一致，产生严重的离策略偏差，引发梯度更新错误甚至策略崩溃；现有基于拒绝采样、重要性加权的统计修正方法存在样本效率低、梯度方差大的问题，同时KV物理驱逐会引发内存碎片化峰值导致OOM。
summary.importance: 首次从架构层面而非统计修正层面解决RL后训练中KV压缩带来的离策略偏差问题，消除了长上下文RL对齐的内存瓶颈，同时保留训练稳定性，为长序列场景的RLHF规模化落地提供了可行的工程方案；对预训练-后训练闭环中的长上下文能力落地有直接的工程参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Shadow Mask Distillation（SMD）双轨框架：1. rollout阶段使用KV压缩生成轨迹的同时，记录对应上下文保留位置的二进制“影子掩码”；2. 优化阶段将影子掩码直接注入学习者的因果注意力矩阵，使学习者与生成阶段的策略严格对齐，完全消除离策略方差；3. 并行执行一次稠密上下文前向传播，通过KL散度损失将全局上下文推理能力蒸馏到掩码策略中，避免模型过拟合截断上下文；4. 原生实现避免了物理KV驱逐带来的内存分配峰值，无需底层C++/CUDA修改，框架无关。
summary.experiments: 在Reddit TL;DR摘要基准上测试：SMD的ROUGE-L指标相比稠密基线相对提升0.6%，在收敛速度和训练稳定性上显著优于统计加权基线；同时完全消除了优化阶段的瞬时内存碎片化峰值，在相同硬件下可支持更大的批量大小和更长的上下文输入。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读方法论部分的双轨机制设计和工程实现细节，重点关注图1的整体框架示意和内存峰值问题的分析部分；泛读实验部分的基准对比结果，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: During the rollout phase of RL post-training (e.g., RLHF, GRPO, Online DPO) for long-context trajectory generation, excessive KV cache footprint creates a memory wall. Direct application of KV cache compression leads to inconsistency between the sparse-context policy during generation and the dense-context policy during optimization, causing severe off-policy bias, erroneous gradient updates, and even policy collapse. Existing statistical correction methods based on rejection sampling and importance weighting suffer from low sample efficiency and high gradient variance, while physical KV eviction triggers memory fragmentation spikes leading to OOM errors.
summary_en.importance: This work addresses the off-policy bias caused by KV compression in RL post-training from an architectural rather than statistical perspective for the first time. It eliminates the memory bottleneck of long-context RL alignment while preserving training stability, providing a feasible engineering solution for large-scale deployment of RLHF in long-sequence scenarios. It has direct engineering reference value for the implementation of long-context capabilities in the pretrain-posttrain closed loop.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Shadow Mask Distillation (SMD) dual-track framework is proposed: 1. During the rollout phase, KV compression is applied to generate trajectories while a binary "shadow mask" recording the positions of retained context is recorded. 2. During the optimization phase, the shadow mask is directly injected into the learner's causal attention matrix to strictly align the learner with the generation policy, completely eliminating off-policy variance. 3. A dense-context forward pass is executed in parallel, and global context reasoning capability is distilled into the masked policy via KL divergence loss to prevent the model from overfitting to truncated context. 4. The native implementation avoids memory allocation spikes caused by physical KV eviction, requires no low-level C++/CUDA modifications, and is framework-agnostic.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on the Reddit TL;DR summarization benchmark: SMD achieves a 0.6% relative improvement in ROUGE-L over the dense baseline, and significantly outperforms statistical weighting baselines in convergence speed and training stability. It also completely eliminates instantaneous memory fragmentation spikes during the optimization phase, supporting larger batch sizes and longer context inputs on the same hardware.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the dual-track mechanism design and engineering implementation details in the methodology section, paying special attention to Figure 1 illustrating the overall framework and the analysis of memory spike issues. Skim the benchmark comparison results in the experiment section. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和 ablation；若 off-policy bias 证据干净，内部长链 RL rollout 的 KV 压缩策略要重新测。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; if the off-policy-bias evidence is clean, long-chain RL rollout KV compression needs retesting internally.

summary.core_problem: 解读 NVIDIA Lightning OPD 的一个“offline 版 OPD”（Offline On-Policy Distillation）：在不做严格 on-policy 采样的情况下，近似优化 on-policy 目标，用于后训练/蒸馏式 RL。
summary.key_insights: 给出三步流程：选定 prompts 数据集→用 teacher 生成轨迹并保存 per-token logits→先对 student 做 SFT→再用带 clip 的 KL( student || teacher logits ) 形式做类似 off-policy 的优化。作者强调其理论主线：把 on-policy 分布差异转写为带重要性权重（IS）的 off-policy 散度项，并在若干假设下（散度/梯度 L2 有界、SFT 与后训练分布差异小且支集一致、参数更新幅度受限等）证明 offline 梯度与 online 梯度差异有界、并共享驻点，从而支持用 offline 版本近似优化 on-policy 版本。文末也点出关键 caveat：共享驻点与梯度有界并不等价于实际会收敛到同一解或同等效果。
summary.limits: 缺少对实验设置、超参（clip、IS 估计方式）、以及与其他 offline RLHF/蒸馏方法的实证对比细节；理论依赖“分布变化小/支集一致”等强假设，实际大步更新或分布漂移时可能失效。

summary_en.core_problem: A technical note on NVIDIA Lightning OPD, framing it as an offline variant of on-policy distillation to approximate on-policy optimization without fully on-policy sampling.
summary_en.key_insights: It outlines a 3-stage recipe: pick a prompt set, have a teacher generate trajectories and store per-token logits, SFT a student, then run an off-policy-like optimization using a clipped KL to the teacher logits. The theoretical narrative is that the on-policy distribution mismatch can be rewritten into an importance-weighted off-policy divergence term; under assumptions (bounded L2 norms, small distribution shift from SFT, shared support/no probability reversals, bounded gradients), the offline gradient stays close to the online gradient and they share stationary points—motivating offline optimization as a proxy. The author also notes an important caveat: shared stationary points and bounded gradient gaps do not guarantee convergence to the same solution in practice.
summary_en.limits: The note lacks concrete implementation and ablation details (IS estimation, clipping choices, baselines). The guarantees hinge on strong assumptions (small shift, support overlap) that may break under larger updates or distribution drift.

paper.title: Budgeted LoRA: Distillation as Structured Compute Allocation for Efficient Inference
paper.abstract: We study distillation for large language models under explicit compute constraints, with the goal of producing student models that are not only cheaper to train, but structurally efficient at inference time. While prior approaches to parameter-efficient distillation, such as LoRA, reduce adaptation cost, they leave the dense backbone unchanged and therefore fail to deliver meaningful inference savings. We propose Budgeted LoRA, a distillation framework that treats model compression as a structur

summary.core_problem: 解决 LoRA 类参数高效蒸馏只降低适配成本、但保留 dense backbone 导致推理成本几乎不降的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是模型压缩和推理效率方法。它把蒸馏重新表述为结构化 compute allocation，而不是固定学生架构或简单插 LoRA，对“训练便宜”和“推理便宜”的区别讲得比较清楚。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Budgeted LoRA，在全局计算预算下分配 dense 计算和低秩路径容量。核心组件包括 module-level dense retention coefficients、自适应 low-rank allocation，以及训练后压缩步骤；压缩时选择性移除、近似或保留 dense 组件，以得到不同计算预算下的学生模型族。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明目标是在显式计算约束下获得结构上更省推理的学生模型，但截断信息未给出具体模型规模、任务、baseline、压缩率或性能提升数值。因此实验可信度需要读正文确认。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 ADAPT Centre 和 Dublin City University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a gap in LoRA-style distillation: it reduces adaptation cost but usually leaves the dense backbone intact, so inference cost barely changes.
summary_en.importance: This is an efficiency and compression contribution. Its useful framing is to treat distillation as structured compute allocation, separating cheap training from genuinely cheaper inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: Budgeted LoRA introduces a global compute budget and allocates capacity across dense and low-rank paths. It uses module-level dense retention coefficients, adaptive low-rank allocation, and a post-training compression stage that removes, approximates, or preserves dense components.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states the goal and method but does not expose model sizes, tasks, baselines, compression ratios, or quality-speed trade-offs in the provided excerpt. The empirical strength has to be checked in the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the ADAPT Centre and Dublin City University.

recommendation.zh: 想做推理压缩可看方法定义；缺少实验细节前，先把它当 LoRA 稀疏化思路而不是可靠 recipe。
recommendation.en: Worth a methods skim for compression work; until the curves are visible, treat it as a LoRA-structured sparsification idea, not a recipe.

paper.title: EdgeRazor: A Lightweight Framework for Large Language Models via Mixed-Precision Quantization-Aware Distillation
paper.abstract: Recent years have witnessed an increasing interest in deploying LLMs on resource-constrained devices, among which quantization has emerged as a promising lightweight technique that converts full-precision model weights and activations into lower-bit formats. Existing weight quantization approaches can be roughly divided into three categories: Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) that calibrates quantized parameters on a small dataset without retraining but suffers from severe performance degradation

summary.core_problem: 解决资源受限设备上部署 LLM 时，低于 4-bit 量化容易掉点、QAT 训练成本高、蒸馏特征选择依赖人工经验的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理部署与模型压缩方法改进。它关注极低比特混合精度量化和量化感知蒸馏，对端侧 LLM 有工程价值，但不直接推进预训练目标、数据或训练动态。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 EdgeRazor，一个面向 LLM 的轻量化框架，结合混合精度权重量化与量化感知蒸馏。相对 PTQ，它允许重新训练量化参数；相对常规 QAT，它试图降低训练开销；相对人工选择蒸馏特征的方法，它强调更自动化的知识迁移。摘要未给出完整模块细节。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出模型规模、校准/训练数据、具体 baseline 和提升幅度。可确认的对比对象包括 PTQ、QAT 和量化感知蒸馏类方法，目标场景是低于 4-bit 的 LLM 权重压缩。
