paper.title: LEAP: Layer-wise Exit-Aware Pretraining for Efficient Transformer Inference
paper.abstract: Layer-aligned distillation and convergence-based early exit represent two predominant computational efficiency paradigms for transformer inference; yet we establish that they exhibit systematic incompatibility under standard deployment conditions for convergence-based early exit. Distillation objectives that align intermediate student layers to teacher representations suppress the representational convergence that early-exit mechanisms exploit, rendering such mechanisms ineffective on distilled

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个部署层面很常见、但训练目标里很少被正面讨论的冲突：层对齐蒸馏得到的小模型，往往无法再配合基于表示收敛的 early exit 使用。原因不在阈值没调好，也不在退出策略太粗糙，而在于标准 layer-wise distillation 会要求学生每一层都去拟合教师对应层，从而把表征能力均匀摊在整个深度上。这样一来，相邻层之间不会自然出现“后几层变化越来越小”的收敛结构，early exit 依赖的可提前终止条件就失效了。论文要解决的核心问题，是如何在不改模型结构、不增加推理参数的前提下，让蒸馏模型既保留蒸馏收益，又重新具备可用的中间退出点。
summary.importance: 对预训练/压缩研究的启发主要有两层。第一，它指出了一个常被默认可组合、实际却互相牵制的训练—部署接口问题：蒸馏目标会塑造层间表征几何，而这种几何直接决定 early exit 是否成立。这一点对做小模型预训练、蒸馏、mid-training 目标设计的人都有参考价值。第二，它给出的修正方式很轻：不是引入额外退出头，也不是改 backbone，而是在训练目标里显式鼓励中间层靠近最终表征。这个思路说明，很多推理效率问题未必需要推理时加机制，也可以在预训练/蒸馏阶段把“可退出性”作为一种表征约束提前写进目标函数。贡献量级不算范式级，但问题定义清楚，机制解释到位，属于对训练目标设计有实际启发的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 LEAP 的辅助目标。作者先把冲突讲清楚：标准蒸馏里，学生第 l 层对齐教师第 π(l) 层，常见于 MiniLM、TinyBERT 一类 layer-aligned KD。这样的目标会让每层都承担独立功能，导致 contraction ratio 近似 1，也就是层间变换幅度没有随深度单调减小。early exit 需要的恰恰相反，是后层逐步收敛到稳定表示。

LEAP 的做法不是放弃蒸馏，而是在原有 final/output matching 与 intermediate matching 之外，再加一个 exit-aware loss，让每个中间层都被训练成“潜在可退出点”。具体有两个对齐目标：一是中间层表示接近教师最终层表示，二是中间层表示接近学生自身最终层表示，其中后者用 stop-gradient 保持训练稳定，避免所有层一起塌缩到一个不断漂移的目标。损失形式采用带 soft margin 的 sigmoid 约束，并设置训练阈值 τ=0.98，要求中间层与最终层的余弦相似度足够高。总的 exit loss 为教师终层对齐项加上 0.7 倍的学生终层自对齐项，平衡质量与推理时自一致性。

此外，作者还加入 batch 内相似度结构蒸馏，即 contrastive KL，让学生保留教师 embedding space 的相对几何。和传统 attention/hidden-state KD 相比，这里更偏向 sentence embedding 场景下的表示蒸馏。

推理阶段没有额外模块，只用 k-skip patience early exit。默认 k=1，从第 l_min=6 层开始，若当前层与前 k 层的 mean-pooled 表示余弦相似度超过 θ=0.95 就退出。训练阈值比推理阈值更严格，给部署留出余量。这种设计的关键点在于：不是靠训练一个 exit classifier 来预测“能不能退”，而是直接把中间层训练成接近最终层，因此退出判据可以保持参数无关、结构无关。
summary.experiments:
实验重点不是追求绝对任务精度，而是验证“蒸馏 + early exit 为何失效，以及 LEAP 如何恢复可退出性”。作者在句向量、语义相似度和检索任务上做了评测，并给了 GPU latency 的 wall-clock benchmark，而不只报理论层数减少。

最关键结果是：标准 layer-aligned distillation 在部署 early exit 时，虽然中间层偶尔会满足某些表面条件，但实际几乎没有有效层数削减，甚至因为逐层监控开销导致吞吐下降；LEAP 则实现了 1.80× 的平均层数减少，并带来 1.61× 的实际 wall-clock 加速。这个差距说明，是否能退不是看有没有退出逻辑，而是看训练后表征是否真的形成收敛结构。

论文还给出若干机制性分析。其一，标准蒸馏模型的层间 contraction ratio 基本不下降，说明表示没有向终层收敛；LEAP 会显著改善这一趋势。其二，去掉 L_exit 后，模型重新失去 early-exit 能力，说明恢复可退出性的关键不是 final matching 或 contrastive distillation，而正是 exit-aware 约束。其三，作者讨论了不同阈值、patience 设置和 batch size 下的延迟表现，强调 early exit 的收益必须用真实延迟衡量，因为逐样本退出会受 kernel launch、分支不规则性和小 batch 开销影响。

从给出的内容看，实验规模更像 sentence embedding 蒸馏与部署验证，而不是大规模生成式 LLM 预训练。参数量和数据规模在正文片段里没有完整展开，但方法定位很明确：面向 BERT/encoder 类蒸馏模型的高效推理，而不是 decoder-only LLM。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看引言和 Figure 1，抓住论文真正的观察：蒸馏目标会破坏 early exit 依赖的层间收敛。然后看方法部分里 contraction ratio 的定义，以及 L_final、L_inter、L_exit 三者的分工。这里最值得注意的是为什么要同时对齐教师最终层和学生最终层，以及为什么学生终层项要 stop-gradient。

实验部分建议重点看三类图表：一类是层间表示变化/收敛曲线，用来验证冲突是否真实存在；一类是 latency vs. layer reduction，确认理论省层数有没有转成真实加速；一类是 ablation，特别是去掉 L_exit、只保留普通蒸馏时的结果。若只打算快速判断是否值得跟进，读完问题定义、主损失公式和主表，大约 20–30 分钟就够。若关心把类似思想迁移到 decoder-only 模型，可进一步深挖作者对“表征收敛”与“功能分层”关系的讨论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a practical incompatibility between two efficiency techniques that are often assumed to compose: layer-wise distillation and convergence-based early exit. In standard layer-aligned distillation, each student layer is trained to match a corresponding teacher layer. This spreads useful computation across the full depth of the student and suppresses the progressive representational convergence that early-exit methods rely on. As a result, distilled models may satisfy superficial exit checks but still fail to reduce effective depth or latency in deployment. The core problem is how to train a distilled transformer so that it remains compact and accurate while also exposing genuinely usable intermediate exit points, without changing the architecture or adding inference-time parameters.
summary_en.importance: The main value is not a new backbone, but a clean training-objective diagnosis. It shows that deployment behavior can be determined by the geometry induced during distillation: if the objective enforces per-layer specialization, convergence-based early exit becomes structurally unlikely. That is a useful lesson for pretraining and compression work more broadly. Efficiency mechanisms are not always modular; some combinations fail because their optimization targets encode conflicting assumptions about layer dynamics. LEAP also suggests a lightweight remedy: instead of adding exit heads or runtime controllers, one can bake “exitability” into training by shaping intermediate representations toward the final one. The contribution is moderate in scope, but the mechanism is concrete and operationally relevant.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method adds an auxiliary exit-aware objective on top of standard distillation. The paper first formalizes why the conflict arises. In layer-aligned KD, student layer l matches teacher layer pi(l), as in MiniLM or TinyBERT-style setups. This encourages each layer to carry distinct teacher-aligned information, which keeps the contraction ratio near 1 across depth. Early exit, however, needs later layers to make progressively smaller updates so that representations stabilize before the final layer.

LEAP keeps standard final-layer matching and intermediate-layer matching, but introduces an additional loss that turns every intermediate layer into a potential exit point. Each intermediate student representation is encouraged to be close to two targets: the teacher’s final-layer embedding and the student’s own final-layer embedding. The second target uses stop-gradient to avoid instability from chasing a moving target. The loss is implemented as a soft-margin sigmoid constraint with a training threshold tau = 0.98, pushing cosine similarity high enough that intermediate layers become valid approximations of the final representation.

The total exit loss combines the teacher-final alignment term and a 0.7-weighted student-final self-consistency term. This is an important design choice: the teacher term preserves quality, while the student term makes the model internally consistent with the representation actually available at inference time. The method also includes a contrastive KL term over batch-wise similarity matrices so that the student preserves the teacher’s embedding-space geometry.

At inference, LEAP uses a parameter-free k-skip patience early-exit rule. Starting from l_min = 6, the model exits when the cosine similarity between the current mean-pooled representation and that from k layers earlier exceeds theta = 0.95. The training threshold is stricter than the inference threshold, leaving some deployment margin. A notable aspect is that the method does not train an explicit exit classifier; it directly shapes intermediate representations so that a simple convergence test becomes meaningful.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are designed to validate the incompatibility claim and the recovery effect of LEAP, rather than to maximize absolute task scores. Evaluation is done on sentence embedding, semantic similarity, and retrieval settings, with GPU wall-clock latency benchmarks in addition to theoretical layer reduction.

The headline result is that standard layer-aligned distillation provides essentially no effective layer reduction under convergence-based early exit, and can even hurt throughput because per-layer monitoring adds overhead without enough actual exits. LEAP, in contrast, achieves 1.80x layer reduction and 1.61x wall-clock speedup. That gap is the central empirical point of the paper: early exit fails not because the runtime rule is weak, but because the distilled representation trajectory never becomes contractive.

The analysis also includes several useful ablations. Standard distilled models show contraction ratios that stay roughly flat across layers, indicating little representational stabilization. LEAP changes this trend and creates usable convergence regions. Removing the exit-aware loss eliminates the early-exit benefit, showing that final-output matching and similarity-structure distillation alone are insufficient. The paper also discusses threshold choices, patience settings, and latency behavior across batch sizes, which matters because sample-wise early exit can lose some of its theoretical savings due to branching and kernel overhead.

From the available content, this is clearly positioned as an encoder-side embedding/distillation study rather than a large-scale decoder-only LM pretraining paper. The exact parameter and data scales are not fully visible in the provided text, but the experimental story is coherent and deployment-oriented.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the main motivating figure. The key idea to verify is simple: layer-wise distillation destroys the convergence pattern that early exit needs. Then read the methodology around the contraction ratio and the roles of L_final, L_inter, and L_exit. The most important detail is why LEAP aligns intermediate layers to both the teacher final layer and the student final layer, and why the latter uses stop-gradient.

In the experiments, focus on three things: representation-convergence plots, latency-versus-layer-reduction results, and the ablation removing L_exit. Those are the pieces that establish the paper’s main claim. For a quick pass, the introduction, core loss definitions, and main tables should take around 20–30 minutes. If you are interested in adapting the idea to decoder-only models, the deeper question worth probing is how training objectives shape functional layering and representational redundancy across depth.

recommendation.zh: 只看 incompatibility 论证和 LEAP 约束；这是部署训练目标的干净负交互案例，不是基座预训练方向。
recommendation.en: Skim the incompatibility argument and the LEAP constraint; it is a clean efficiency-training interaction, not a foundation pretraining result.

paper.title: When Less is Enough: Efficient Inference via Collaborative Reasoning
paper.abstract: In this work, we introduce DUET (Dual-model Efficient Two-stage inference), a collaborative inference framework in which a capable model and a lightweight model work together to solve a task. Relying on a single large model to perform end-to-end reasoning and prediction often incurs substantial inference cost. In contrast, DUET decomposes inference into two stages: the capable model produces a reasoning signal, and the lightweight model interprets this signal to generate the final answer, allowi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是推理阶段的计算分工问题：当前 reasoning model 把“高难度推理”和“低难度答案表述”混在同一条 token 流里，由同一个大模型完整生成，导致大量昂贵 token 被花在格式化、复述和低信息密度的后处理上。论文要解决的核心问题，是能否把推理过程拆成两段：让大模型只负责产出压缩过的 reasoning signal，再让小模型读取这个信号并生成最终答案，从而在尽量不掉性能的前提下减少大模型 token 开销。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，更接近 post-training / inference-time efficiency，但对基座研究仍有两个启发。第一，它把“推理 token 是否都值得由大模型生成”这个问题显式化了，提出能力密集部分与表达密集部分可以分离，这对未来设计 latent reasoning、分层解码、异构 MoE 式推理都有参考意义。第二，它不是单纯蒸馏小模型，而是让大小模型形成条件协作，目标函数直接约束中间表示长度与边际效用，这比常见的 answer-only distillation 更接近计算预算下的联合优化。贡献量级主要在推理范式和训练目标设计上，而不是预训练方法创新。
summary.technical_approach:
DUET 是一个双模型两阶段推理框架。给定输入 x，先由大模型 M 生成中间表示 z，再由小模型 m 在 x 和 z 条件下生成最终答案 y。若把 z 具体实现为 reasoning trace，那么大模型承担高难度推理，小模型负责把 reasoning signal 转成答案。

方法的关键不只是串联两个模型，而是联合训练目标。作者把问题写成带预算约束的优化：在保证期望奖励的同时，限制中间序列 z 的期望长度不超过预算 B。为此引入长度惩罚项，并采用交替优化训练两个模型。摘要和正文片段里提到两个稳定训练的重要部件。

第一是 marginal-utility reward。只有当小模型单独完成任务可能失败，而大模型给出的 z 确实能改善结果时，大模型才会因为生成这些中间 token 获得正向激励。这样做是为了避免大模型无差别地输出长推理链，也避免 z 退化成对小模型无帮助的冗余文本。换句话说，奖励不是鼓励“多想”，而是鼓励“只在有边际收益时提供必要信息”。

第二是 adaptive length-penalty schedule。固定长度惩罚往往不稳定：惩罚太弱，z 会变长；惩罚太强，协作机制还没学会就被迫压缩，性能先崩。自适应调度的作用，是在训练过程中逐步把系统推向更紧的 token 预算，同时维持可学性。

从框架上看，DUET 与常规 CoT distillation 的区别在于：不是让小模型模仿大模型完整推理，而是让大模型学习输出一种对小模型“足够且更短”的通信表示。它也不同于 speculative decoding 或 routing，因为这里的大小模型不是验证—提议关系，而是语义分工关系。
summary.experiments:
实验集中在高难推理 benchmark，如 AIME 和 GPQA。主结论是，在保持大模型基线测试性能的同时，DUET 可把昂贵的大模型 token 使用量降低约 60%。这个结果对应的不是总 token 一定同比例下降，而是把最贵的那部分计算从“大模型长链生成”转成“大模型较短 reasoning signal + 小模型完成答案生成”。

从论文叙述看，作者强调 reasoning model 的输出通常比同规模 instruct model 长很多，例如 AIME 上可达 5–10 倍；这正是 DUET 试图利用的冗余空间。关键实验应该包括：与单独大模型、单独小模型、以及可能的蒸馏/短 CoT 基线比较；不同长度惩罚强度下的性能—成本曲线；以及交替训练或 marginal-utility reward 的消融。虽然当前给出的全文片段没有完整表格数字，但主结果已经足够说明方法定位：它不是提升上限，而是在高难推理任务上重分配推理计算。

需要注意的是，这类结果对真实部署收益还取决于两个因素：一是小模型读取 z 的额外开销是否足够低，二是大模型生成 z 的长度是否稳定可控。如果 z 仍然很长，或者双模型串行带来较大系统开销，实际收益会低于 token 节省比例。论文显然意识到了这一点，所以把长度预算直接写进训练目标，而不是事后截断。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看引言和方法总图，确认作者要解决的不是“让小模型更强”，而是“让大模型少说、只说有用的部分”。然后重点看约束优化目标、marginal-utility reward 的定义，以及 adaptive length penalty 的训练流程。这三处决定了 DUET 是否只是一个双模型 pipeline，还是一个真正围绕预算优化的协作框架。

实验部分优先看主表和成本—性能曲线，尤其是 AIME、GPQA 上与大模型单跑的对比。若有消融，重点关注：去掉边际效用奖励后 z 是否变长且信息密度下降；固定长度惩罚是否更不稳定；以及小模型规模变化对协作收益的影响。快速阅读预计 25–35 分钟。若想判断它对基座研究有没有更深启发，可进一步思考 z 是否可以从显式文本 reasoning 过渡到离散 latent code，这会更接近预训练范式问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets an inefficiency in current reasoning-heavy inference: a single large model is used to generate both capability-intensive reasoning and low-value answer rendering in one continuous token stream. This makes many expensive tokens carry little marginal utility. The core question is whether inference can be decomposed into two stages, where a strong model emits a compressed reasoning signal and a lightweight model turns that signal into the final answer, reducing costly large-model generation while preserving task accuracy.
summary_en.importance: This is more of a post-training and inference-efficiency contribution than a pretraining one, but it still has conceptual relevance for foundation-model research. It makes explicit that not all reasoning-related tokens deserve equal compute, and that high-capacity inference may be separable from surface-form generation. That idea connects to broader directions such as latent reasoning, hierarchical decoding, and heterogeneous compute allocation. The other useful aspect is the objective design: instead of plain distillation, the framework jointly optimizes collaboration under a token budget, with rewards tied to marginal usefulness rather than raw generation. The contribution is mainly in inference paradigm and training objective design, not in core pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach:
DUET is a dual-model, two-stage inference framework. Given an input x, a capable large model M first produces an intermediate representation z, and a lightweight model m then generates the final answer y conditioned on both x and z. In the main instantiation, z is a reasoning signal: the large model handles the hard cognitive work, while the small model performs cheaper answer generation.

The key point is that DUET is not just a sequential pipeline. The paper formulates training as a constrained optimization problem: maximize expected reward while keeping the expected length of z below a budget B. This directly ties collaboration quality to inference cost. Training uses a length-penalized joint objective with alternating optimization over the two models.

Two ingredients appear central. First, the marginal-utility reward gives positive incentive to the large model only when its intermediate output is likely to improve outcomes beyond what the small model could do alone. This discourages the large model from emitting long generic chains of thought and pushes z toward concise, decision-relevant information. In other words, the objective rewards useful compression, not verbosity.

Second, the adaptive length-penalty schedule stabilizes training under a token budget. A fixed penalty can be too weak, leading to long z, or too strong, collapsing the communication channel before the models learn to cooperate. The adaptive schedule gradually tightens the budget while preserving learnability.

Relative to standard CoT distillation, DUET is different in an important way: the small model is not trained to imitate the full reasoning trace of the large model. Instead, the large model learns to emit a shorter communication signal that is sufficient for the small model to finish the task. It is also different from speculative decoding or verifier-proposer setups, because the two models are not playing a draft-check role; they are dividing semantic labor.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation focuses on difficult reasoning benchmarks such as AIME and GPQA. The main reported result is that DUET matches the large-model baseline performance while reducing expensive large-model token usage by up to about 60%. The gain comes from replacing long large-model reasoning traces with a shorter large-model signal plus cheaper small-model completion.

The motivation is empirically grounded: reasoning models often generate much longer outputs than similarly sized instruct models, with examples in the paper citing 5–10x longer responses on AIME-like tasks. DUET is designed to exploit that redundancy. The most relevant experiments are likely comparisons against the standalone large model, the standalone small model, and simpler compression or short-CoT baselines, along with cost-performance tradeoff curves under different length penalties and ablations on the reward design.

The provided text does not include the full result tables, so exact benchmark-by-benchmark numbers beyond the headline reduction are not visible here. Still, the experimental message is clear: the method is not trying to raise the capability ceiling, but to reallocate reasoning compute more efficiently on hard tasks.

A practical caveat remains important. Real deployment gains depend not only on token savings but also on the overhead of running two models serially and on how tightly the length of z is controlled. If z stays long or the orchestration cost is high, wall-clock savings may fall short of token-level savings. The paper appears aware of this, which is why the token budget is built directly into training rather than enforced only at inference.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with the introduction and the main framework figure. The central idea to verify is that the paper is not simply making the small model stronger; it is teaching the large model to say less and only say what is useful. Then focus on the constrained objective, the definition of the marginal-utility reward, and the adaptive length-penalty schedule. Those parts determine whether DUET is a real budget-aware collaboration method or just a two-model cascade.

In the experiments, prioritize the main benchmark tables and the cost-versus-performance plots on AIME and GPQA. If there are ablations, the most informative ones are removing the marginal-utility reward, replacing the adaptive penalty with a fixed one, and varying the size of the small model. Those should reveal whether the communication signal z becomes shorter, denser, and more useful. A fast pass should take around 25–35 minutes. For deeper relevance to foundation-model research, the natural follow-up question is whether z could move from explicit textual reasoning to a discrete latent code, which would connect the idea more directly to pretraining and modeling paradigms.

recommendation.zh: 只看训练目标和 cost accounting；若压缩信号能稳定迁移，这是比普通蒸馏更干净的推理分工设定。
recommendation.en: Read the objective and cost accounting; if the compressed signal transfers cleanly, this is a sharper setup than ordinary distillation.

paper.title: Mamoda2.5: Enhancing Unified Multimodal Model with DiT-MoE
paper.abstract: We present Mamoda2.5, a unified AR-Diffusion framework that seamlessly integrates multimodal understanding and generation within a single architecture. To efficiently enhance the model's generation capability, we equip the Diffusion Transformer backbone with a fine-grained Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) design (128 experts, Top-8 routing), yielding a 25B-parameter model that activates only 3B parameters, significantly reducing training costs while scaling up the model capacity. Mamoda2.5 achieves top-

summary.core_problem: 统一多模态生成模型中，Diffusion Transformer（DiT）架构随参数规模、视频分辨率及时长提升计算成本爆炸式增长，同时现有开源统一模型在视频编辑场景性能和效率均不足。
summary.importance: 验证了细粒度MoE架构在统一AR+Diffusion多模态预训练中的可行性，为大参数规模的低成本扩缩提供可复用的实践方案，兼顾多任务能力和效率。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Mamoda2.5统一AR-Diffusion框架，视觉生成器采用128专家、Top-8路由的细粒度DiT-MoE架构，总参数量25B，单步前向仅激活3B参数，配合4×16×16高压缩率VAE降低token量，同时引入少步蒸馏加强化学习联合策略压缩推理步数，单模型支持图文理解/文生图/文生视频/图像编辑/视频编辑/多模态理解全能力。
summary.experiments: VBench 2.0上达到第一梯队生成性能，OpenVE-Bench视频编辑指标超过所有测评开源模型，对齐可灵O1性能，视频编辑推理速度比同类基线快12倍，经少步蒸馏后压缩为4步无CFG版本，步数减少7.5倍，额外节省约2倍CFG开销。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看MoE架构设计和蒸馏策略部分，预计阅读时间20分钟，无需关注具体训练数据配比，重点参考细粒度MoE在视频生成场景的路由设计和效率收益。

summary_en.core_problem: For unified multimodal generation models, the computational cost of Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architecture explodes as parameter scale, video resolution and duration increase, while existing open-source unified models have insufficient performance and efficiency in video editing scenarios.
summary_en.importance: It verifies the feasibility of fine-grained MoE architecture in unified AR+Diffusion multimodal pre-training, provides a reusable practice scheme for low-cost scaling of large parameter scales, and balances multi-task capability and efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: Mamoda2.5 unified AR-Diffusion framework is proposed. The visual generator adopts a fine-grained DiT-MoE architecture with 128 experts and Top-8 routing, with 25B total parameters and only 3B parameters activated per forward pass. It is paired with a 4×16×16 high-compression VAE to reduce token count. A joint few-step distillation and reinforcement learning strategy is introduced to compress inference steps. The single model supports full capabilities including text-image understanding, text-to-image, text-to-video, image editing, video editing and multimodal understanding.
summary_en.experiments: It achieves top-tier generation performance on VBench 2.0. Its video editing metric on OpenVE-Bench outperforms all evaluated open-source models and matches Kling O1 performance. Video editing inference speed is 12× faster than comparable baselines. After few-step distillation, it is compressed to a 4-step CFG-free version, step count reduced by 7.5×, with an additional ~2× CFG overhead saving.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on MoE architecture design and distillation strategy sections. Estimated reading time is 20 minutes. No need to pay attention to specific training data ratio, focus on the routing design and efficiency benefits of fine-grained MoE in video generation scenarios.

recommendation.zh: 值得看架构和 ablation：DiT-MoE 是否真能让 AR+diffusion 统一模型按 active 参数扩展，是关键问题。
recommendation.en: Read the architecture and ablations: the key question is whether DiT-MoE makes unified AR+diffusion scale with active rather than total parameters.

paper.title: Distilling Long-CoT Reasoning through Collaborative Step-wise Multi-Teacher Decoding
paper.abstract: Distilling large reasoning models is essential for making Long-CoT reasoning practical, as full-scale inference remains computationally prohibitive. Existing curation-based approaches select complete reasoning traces post-hoc, overlooking collaboration among heterogeneous teachers and lacking dynamic exploration, which leads to redundant sampling and missed complementary reasoning. We introduce CoRD, a collaborative multi-teacher decoding framework that performs step-wise reasoning synthesis gui

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决 Long-CoT reasoning distillation 中的轨迹选择问题：多个强教师能生成很长的推理过程，但事后挑一条完整轨迹会浪费大量采样，也难以把不同教师的互补推理步骤组合起来。
summary.importance: 对 post-train 数据合成和 reasoning distillation 有启发。它把“先生成完整 CoT，再筛选”的流程改成“逐步构造推理轨迹”。这更接近解码过程，也更适合长链推理数据的生产。对预训练研究的间接价值在于，它提供了一种构造高质量 reasoning traces 的思路：评价信号不一定只在最终答案或完整轨迹上使用，也可以在步骤级别介入，但要保留足够的搜索宽度，避免过早剪掉后续可能自我修正的路径。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名为 CoRD，即 Collaborative Reasoning Decoding。它把每个 reasoning step 看作一个高层“token”，把多个 teacher LRM 在当前前缀下提出的下一步看作候选“词表”。每一步中，不同教师基于同一个推理前缀生成候选步骤，系统再选择更有前景的扩展路径。关键机制有三点。第一，用 prompt-guided step segmentation 将长 CoT 切成相对一致的推理步骤，避免不同教师输出粒度不一致。第二，用 predictive perplexity 评估部分推理轨迹：给定当前 reasoning prefix，计算 ground-truth answer 被预测得是否自然。这个信号比最终答案筛选更早，但仍与正确解相关。第三，引入 beam search 同时保留多条候选轨迹，减少局部评分过强导致的早期剪枝。它和 S1、LIMO 这类 curation-based 方法的区别在于，后者通常先让教师各自生成完整轨迹，再做事后选择；CoRD 在生成过程中让多个教师逐步协作。它和 MCTS/PRM 路线的区别在于，不依赖大量 rollout 或细粒度过程奖励，计算形式更接近受控解码。
summary.experiments: 实验在 5 个 close-ended 或 open-ended reasoning benchmark 上进行，对比了多教师 distillation baseline，包括 Curation 和 Integration，也对比了 S1、LIMO-v1/v2 等方法。作者报告 CoRD 生成的数据质量更高，蒸馏后的 student model 能接近甚至超过 teacher model。消融部分强调三个组件都有效：prompt-guided step segmentation 优于替代分段方式，predictive perplexity scoring 能更好选择局部步骤，beam search 能保留带有策略转向和自我修正的长程路径。提供内容中没有给出具体参数量、训练数据规模和逐项分数，精读时需要核对实验表格中的模型规模、teacher 组合、beam size、每题采样预算和数据量。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30 到 40 分钟。先看方法部分的 formalization，确认作者如何把完整轨迹选择改写为 step-wise collaborative decoding。然后重点看三个实现细节：step segmentation、predictive perplexity、beam search。实验部分优先读主结果表和消融表，尤其关注 CoRD 相比 Curation/Integration 的收益是否来自多教师组合，还是主要来自额外搜索预算。若用于构建 reasoning SFT 数据，需要额外检查成本：每步调用多少教师、是否需要 ground-truth answer、beam search 的宽度如何影响吞吐。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses trajectory construction for long-chain-of-thought reasoning distillation. Existing approaches usually generate full reasoning traces from one or more teachers and select among them after the fact. This wastes sampling compute and cannot compose complementary reasoning steps from heterogeneous teachers.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to reasoning-data generation and post-training pipelines. Its main contribution is to move from full-trajectory curation to incremental trajectory construction. This matters because long-CoT traces often contain detours, self-corrections, and strategy shifts; a purely post-hoc selector cannot adapt exploration during generation. For pretraining-oriented work, the useful idea is that supervision for reasoning traces can be injected at the step level, as long as the search keeps enough diversity to avoid pruning paths that only pay off later.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoRD, or Collaborative Reasoning Decoding, treats each reasoning step as a high-level decoding unit. At each step, multiple teacher LRMs propose candidate next steps conditioned on the same current prefix. The system scores the resulting partial trajectories and extends promising ones. The method has three central components. First, prompt-guided step segmentation makes reasoning steps more consistent across teachers. Second, predictive perplexity scores a partial reasoning prefix by measuring how well the ground-truth answer is predicted given that prefix; this provides an early signal without waiting for a complete trace. Third, beam search maintains multiple candidate trajectories, which helps preserve paths that initially look weaker but later lead to useful self-correction or strategic shifts. Compared with S1- or LIMO-style curation, CoRD collaborates during generation rather than selecting after generation. Compared with PRM or MCTS-style methods, it avoids heavy rollout-based search and uses a decoding-like procedure.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers five closed-ended or open-ended reasoning benchmarks. The baselines include multi-teacher Curation and Integration, as well as S1 and LIMO-v1/v2. The authors report that CoRD produces higher-quality reasoning data and that students distilled from these traces can approach or sometimes surpass their teachers. The ablations indicate that prompt-guided segmentation, predictive perplexity scoring, and beam search each contribute to performance. The provided content does not include exact parameter counts, data sizes, benchmark scores, or compute budgets, so those details should be checked in the experimental tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: A good skim takes about 30–40 minutes. Read the formalization first, especially the shift from selecting complete trajectories to step-wise collaborative decoding. Then focus on the three mechanisms: segmentation, predictive perplexity, and beam search. In the experiments, prioritize the main results and ablations. The key question is whether the gains over Curation and Integration come from genuine multi-teacher composition or mainly from additional search. For practical reasoning-SFT data generation, also check the cost model: number of teacher calls per step, dependence on ground-truth answers, beam width, and throughput.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和消融就够；若 step-wise teacher mixing 真能降冗余，应在内部推理蒸馏管线复现。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; if step-wise teacher mixing really reduces redundancy, it is worth reproducing in reasoning-distillation pipelines.

paper.title: Trees to Flows and Back: Unifying Decision Trees and Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Decision trees and diffusion models are ostensibly disparate model classes, one discrete and hierarchical, the other continuous and dynamic. This work unifies the two by establishing a crisp mathematical correspondence between hierarchical decision trees and diffusion processes in appropriate limiting regimes. Our unification reveals a shared optimization principle: \emph{Global Trajectory Score Matching (GTSM)}, for which gradient boosting (in an idealized version) is asymptotically optimal. We

summary.core_problem: 建立决策树和 diffusion process 之间的数学对应关系，并把这种对应用于表格生成和树到神经网络的蒸馏。
summary.importance: 贡献是基础建模视角和理论统一：论文提出 hierarchical decision tree 与 diffusion process 在特定极限下可互相对应，并抽象出 Global Trajectory Score Matching 这一共享优化原则。对 LLM 预训练不是直接贡献，但对理解 score matching 和离散层级结构的关系有概念价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者从数学上把树的层级划分轨迹和扩散过程的连续动态联系起来，提出 GTSM；并声称理想化 gradient boosting 对该目标渐近最优。实践上给出 TreeFlow 用于表格数据生成，以及 DSMTree 将树的层级决策逻辑蒸馏到神经网络中。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告 TreeFlow 在表格生成上质量有竞争力，保真度更高，并有 2 倍计算加速；DSMTree 在多个 benchmark 上可在 2% 以内接近教师模型性能。未给出具体数据集、模型规模和 baseline 细节。
summary.authors_note: Suvrit Sra 是优化和机器学习理论方向的知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper establishes a mathematical correspondence between decision trees and diffusion processes, then applies it to tabular generation and tree-to-network distillation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a foundational modeling perspective: hierarchical decision trees and diffusion processes are shown to correspond in certain limiting regimes, with Global Trajectory Score Matching as a shared optimization principle. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it may be conceptually useful for thinking about score matching and discrete hierarchical structure.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors connect tree-induced hierarchical partition trajectories with continuous diffusion dynamics, define GTSM, and argue that an idealized form of gradient boosting is asymptotically optimal for this objective. They instantiate the idea as TreeFlow for tabular generation and DSMTree for distilling hierarchical decision logic into neural networks.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that TreeFlow achieves competitive tabular generation quality with higher fidelity and a 2x computational speedup. DSMTree matches teacher performance within 2% on many benchmarks. Specific datasets, model sizes, and baseline details are not provided in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Suvrit Sra is a well-known researcher in optimization and machine learning theory.

recommendation.zh: 概念上有趣但离 LLM 远；只看 GTSM 定义和树-扩散对应，别被表格生成结果牵着走。
recommendation.en: Conceptually interesting but far from LLMs; read the GTSM definition and tree-diffusion correspondence, not the tabular-generation claims.

paper.title: World2VLM: Distilling World Model Imagination into VLMs for Dynamic Spatial Reasoning
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong performance on static visual understanding, yet they still struggle with dynamic spatial reasoning that requires imagining how scenes evolve under egocentric motion. Recent efforts address this limitation either by scaling spatial supervision with synthetic data or by coupling VLMs with world models at inference time. However, the former often lacks explicit modeling of motion-conditioned state transitions, while the latter incurs substantial compu

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是一般的图文理解，而是 VLM 在“动态空间推理”上的短板：给定当前视角和一个自运动轨迹，模型往往不能稳定推断场景会如何变化，也不能从视角变化反推出相机动作。已有两条路各有明显问题：一条是继续堆静态空间数据和合成监督，但缺少显式的动作→状态转移建模；另一条是在推理时外挂 world model 做 imagination，但代价高，而且能力没有真正写进 VLM 参数里。World2VLM 的核心问题因此很明确：能不能把 world model 作为训练期教师，把“动作条件下的视角转移规律”蒸馏进 VLM 本身，让部署时仍然只用普通 VLM 推理。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要在训练范式，而不在某个 benchmark 分数。它提出了一种很清楚的 teacher-student 路线：world model 不一定要作为在线推理模块存在，也可以作为离线数据与监督生成器，给 VLM 注入原本难以从静态图文对中学到的转移动力学先验。这个思路对原生多模态预训练和 post-train 接口都有启发：一是说明生成式环境模型可以作为高质量 supervision source，而不只是 inference-time tool；二是说明“空间 imagination”这类能力可以通过结构化任务设计和后训练强化被内化，而不是永远依赖外部系统。量级上，它更像一个有方法论价值的后训练框架，而不是改写 VLM 预训练主范式的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由三部分组成。第一部分是 transition construction。作者从锚点观测 s_t 出发，采样参数化的 egocentric action a_t，用可控 world model 生成动作后的未来视图 s_{t+1}^{WM}。文中强调 teacher 可以替换，实验里用了 Stable Virtual Camera 和 HY-WorldPlay 两类 world model，目的是验证监督信号并不强依赖某一个生成器。关键不只是生成新图，而是把“源视图—动作—目标视图”组织成几何一致、动作语义明确的转移样本。

第二部分是 bidirectional spatial supervision。作者没有只做单向的 action→future view 预测，而是同时构造 forward 和 inverse 两类任务。forward spatial reasoning 要求模型根据当前观测和动作，预测未来视角下的结果；inverse spatial reasoning 则要求模型根据前后视图恢复导致变化的动作。这个设计抓住了动态空间理解的两个面向：一是识别 latent transition，二是把 transition 向未来传播。相比只做 caption 或 QA，这种任务化监督更接近“状态转移建模”。

第三部分是两阶段 post-training。先做 SFT，让模型学会在结构化空间任务上输出稳定答案；再做 task-aware GRPO refinement，进一步优化结构化空间输出。这里的 GRPO 不是泛泛地加 RL，而是围绕空间任务的正确性信号做强化，使模型在离散动作、视角变化、结果描述上更稳。作者的立场很明确：SFT 负责把 teacher signal 写进模型，GRPO 负责 sharpen 决策边界和输出格式。

从方法取舍看，这篇工作刻意避开了 test-time coupling。原因不是 world model 没用，而是在线耦合会把推理成本、系统复杂度和误差传播都带进部署阶段。World2VLM 选择把 world model 的价值前移到训练期，用一次性蒸馏换部署时的简单性。这一点对多模态基座训练很重要。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 SAT-Real、SAT-Synthesized、VSI-Bench、MindCube 四个带明显动态或视角变化属性的 benchmark。论文主结论是：相对 base Qwen2.5-VL，World2VLM 在四个数据集上都有一致提升；在 SFT 之上再加 GRPO，还能继续提升。作者还把它和一种 MindJourney 风格的 test-time world-model-coupled baseline 做比较，结果显示离线蒸馏后的单体 VLM 不仅部署更轻，而且效果更稳。

从全文可确认的实验重点有三类。第一类是 teacher ablation：使用不同 world model 作为教师，验证 gains 不是某个生成器偶然带来的。第二类是 training recipe ablation：比较 base model、SFT-only、SFT→GRPO，说明两阶段训练各自贡献。第三类是 benchmark/category analysis：在 SAT-Real 上做细粒度类别分析，提升主要集中在 egocentric movement、action consequence、perspective taking 这些真正依赖动态空间想象的子项，而不是静态识别项。这一点很关键，因为它说明模型不是单纯靠更强视觉识别拿分。

需要说明的是，给出的全文片段没有完整表格和全部数字，因此无法可靠抄出每个 benchmark 的精确分数、样本规模和训练 token 量。能确定的硬信息包括：学生模型基座是 Qwen2.5-VL；训练包含 SFT 和 GRPO 两阶段；教师 world model 至少包含 Stable Virtual Camera 与 HY-WorldPlay；作者声称相对先前方法 proving-style 的 test-time coupling 更有效且更省部署开销。若做精读，建议直接核对主结果表、teacher ablation 表和 SAT-Real 分类结果图，把每个数据集上的绝对提升幅度补齐。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合按“问题设定—监督构造—训练配方—误差归因”来读。

先看 Introduction，重点不是任务背景，而是作者为什么否定两条常见路线：纯数据扩充缺少动作条件转移，test-time coupling 成本高。这个判断决定了整篇方法设计。

然后看 Method 里的 Figure 2 和 transition construction 部分。这里是全文最重要的地方：样本是怎么从 anchor observation、camera trajectory 和 world model generation 变成可训练的结构化 supervision 的。如果这一段设计不严，后面的提升就可能只是数据增强而不是“蒸馏空间 imagination”。

接着看 bidirectional task suite。要特别注意 forward / inverse 两类任务的定义、输入输出格式、是否共享模板、是否有动作离散化或文本化编码。这些细节决定模型学到的是空间规律，还是只是在做模板匹配。

再看 SFT→GRPO 的 reward 设计与训练细节。这里值得深挖的问题有两个：一是 GRPO 奖励是否真正对齐空间正确性，还是主要奖励格式与关键词；二是 RL 阶段是否带来分布偏移，尤其在真实图像 benchmark 上是否比合成集更敏感。

实验部分建议优先看四类内容：主表、teacher 替换实验、SFT vs GRPO 消融、SAT-Real 细粒度类别分析。阅读时间大约 30–45 分钟可以抓住主线；如果要判断它对原生多模态预训练是否有迁移价值，需要再花时间看附录里的数据构造和 prompt 模板。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific weakness of current VLMs: dynamic spatial reasoning under egocentric motion. Standard VLMs can describe a static scene, but they often fail when asked to infer how the scene changes after a camera movement, or to recover the motion that caused a viewpoint change. Prior work mainly follows two routes: scaling synthetic spatial supervision, which still lacks explicit action-conditioned transition modeling, or coupling a VLM with a world model at inference time, which improves reasoning but adds substantial runtime cost and leaves the VLM itself unchanged. The central question here is whether a world model can act as a training-time teacher so that motion-conditioned spatial imagination is internalized into the VLM parameters.
summary_en.importance: Its value is methodological rather than benchmark-centric. The paper shows a clean teacher-student recipe where a generative world model is used offline to create structured supervision for a VLM. That matters for multimodal pretraining and the pretrain/post-train interface: world models do not have to remain external inference modules; they can become supervision generators that inject transition dynamics priors into a foundation model. The contribution is not a new pretraining objective in the narrow sense, but a practical post-training framework for transferring action-conditioned spatial structure into a deployed VLM without requiring test-time world-model calls.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three main components. First, transition construction. Starting from an anchor observation s_t, the framework samples a parameterized egocentric action a_t and uses a controllable world model to synthesize a future view s_{t+1}^{WM}. The teacher is intentionally modular; the experiments instantiate it with Stable Virtual Camera and HY-WorldPlay to test whether the supervision depends on a specific generator. The key point is not image generation alone, but the creation of geometrically aligned source-action-target triples with explicit motion semantics.

Second, bidirectional spatial supervision. Instead of training only on forward prediction, the paper builds both forward and inverse tasks. Forward spatial reasoning asks the model to infer the consequence of an action given the current observation. Inverse spatial reasoning asks it to recover the action from the before/after views. This is a sensible design choice: dynamic spatial competence requires both identifying the latent transition and propagating it to unseen future states. Compared with generic VQA-style supervision, this is much closer to learning state transitions.

Third, a two-stage post-training recipe. The model is first trained with SFT on the structured spatial tasks, then refined with task-aware GRPO. The role split is clear: SFT transfers the teacher signal into the model, while GRPO sharpens structured outputs and decision boundaries for action-conditioned reasoning. The paper does not present RL as a generic add-on; it is used to improve correctness on spatially grounded outputs.

A notable design choice is the deliberate avoidance of test-time coupling. The authors are not arguing that world models are unnecessary; rather, they move the world-model benefit into training so deployment remains a standard single-model VLM inference pipeline. That trade-off is important for scalable multimodal systems.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers SAT-Real, SAT-Synthesized, VSI-Bench, and MindCube, all of which contain substantial viewpoint-conditioned or dynamic spatial reasoning components. The main empirical claim is consistent improvement over the base Qwen2.5-VL model on all four benchmarks. The GRPO stage further improves over the SFT checkpoint. The paper also compares against a MindJourney-style test-time world-model-coupled baseline and reports that the distilled standalone VLM is both more effective and cheaper at deployment.

The most informative experimental axes are threefold. First, teacher ablations: different world models are used as teachers, suggesting the gains are not tied to one specific generator. Second, training-recipe ablations: base model vs SFT-only vs SFT→GRPO, which isolates the contribution of each stage. Third, fine-grained category analysis on SAT-Real: the gains are concentrated on egocentric movement, action consequence, and perspective taking, which supports the claim that the method improves motion-conditioned reasoning rather than static recognition.

The provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete result tables, so it is not safe to fabricate exact benchmark scores, sample counts, or training-scale numbers. What can be stated reliably is that the student backbone is Qwen2.5-VL, the training recipe is SFT followed by GRPO, and the teacher side includes at least Stable Virtual Camera and HY-WorldPlay. For a careful read, the main result table, teacher ablation table, and SAT-Real category breakdown are the places to extract the exact absolute gains.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in the order of problem framing, supervision construction, training recipe, and error attribution.

Start with the introduction, especially the argument against the two common alternatives: static data scaling without explicit transition modeling, and inference-time world-model coupling with high runtime overhead. That framing explains why the method is built the way it is.

Then move to Figure 2 and the transition-construction section. This is the core of the paper. The important question is how anchor observations, camera trajectories, and world-model generations are turned into structured supervision rather than mere data augmentation.

Next, inspect the bidirectional task suite. Pay attention to the exact definitions of forward and inverse tasks, the input/output format, and whether actions are discretized or textualized. These details determine whether the model is learning spatial regularities or just matching templates.

After that, read the SFT→GRPO section carefully. Two questions matter: whether the GRPO reward truly reflects spatial correctness rather than formatting, and whether the RL stage introduces distribution shift, especially between synthetic and real-image benchmarks.

In the experiments, prioritize the main benchmark table, teacher replacement ablations, SFT vs GRPO ablations, and the fine-grained SAT-Real analysis. Around 30–45 minutes is enough to capture the main idea. If the goal is to assess transferability to native multimodal pretraining, spend extra time on the appendix sections covering data construction and prompting templates.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是“把 world model 当教师而不是外挂模块”这个接口设计；先读训练 recipe 和对比 test-time coupling 的表，别把它误当成预训练突破。
recommendation.en: The useful idea is the interface: treat the world model as a teacher rather than a runtime plug-in; read the training recipe and the comparison against test-time coupling, but don’t mistake it for a pretraining breakthrough.
